```yaml
# Semiconductor calculators. Every name is written in all 16 desktop locales; docs, variable names and warnings in
# English and German (other languages fall back to English). Rules are written out for every direction, in the order
# the solver tries them: the first alternative whose variables are all known wins. bjt_divider_bias and mosfet_losses
# are forward-only (every variable is an input, only derived quantities are results).

- id: led_resistor
  kind: calculator
  category: semiconductors
  name: {cs: "Předřadný rezistor pro LED", da: "Forkoblingsmodstand til LED", de: "LED-Vorwiderstand", el: "Αντίσταση περιορισμού ρεύματος LED", en: "LED series resistor", es: "Resistencia limitadora para LED", fr: "Résistance série pour LED", hi: "LED श्रेणी प्रतिरोधक", it: "Resistenza in serie per LED", ja: "LEDの電流制限抵抗", nl: "Voorschakelweerstand voor LED", no: "Seriemotstand for LED", pl: "Rezystor szeregowy do diody LED", pt: "Resistência em série para LED", sv: "Serieresistor för LED", zh: "LED限流电阻"}
  doc:
    en: "An LED needs a series resistor that takes up the part of the supply voltage the LEDs do not use: R = (V_S − n × V_F) / I_F for a string of n LEDs in series. Parallel strings each get their own resistor, so the supply delivers m × I_F in total; never let several parallel strings share one resistor. Example with the defaults: a 12 V supply and two strings of three red LEDs (V_F ≈ 2 V) at 20 mA need 300 Ω per string; the supply delivers 40 mA (0.48 W), and half of that power is lost in the resistors. Take V_F from the datasheet for the chosen current; it varies with colour, current and temperature."
    de: "Eine LED braucht einen Vorwiderstand, der den Teil der Versorgungsspannung aufnimmt, den die LEDs nicht benötigen: R = (V_S − n · V_F) / I_F für einen Strang aus n LEDs in Reihe. Parallele Stränge erhalten je einen eigenen Widerstand, die Versorgung liefert dann insgesamt m · I_F; mehrere parallele Stränge nie an einem gemeinsamen Widerstand betreiben. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: Bei 12 V Versorgung brauchen zwei Stränge aus je drei roten LEDs (V_F ≈ 2 V) mit 20 mA je 300 Ω; die Versorgung liefert 40 mA (0,48 W), die Hälfte dieser Leistung geht in den Widerständen verloren. V_F dem Datenblatt für den gewählten Strom entnehmen; er hängt von Farbe, Strom und Temperatur ab."
  tags: [led, series resistor, current limiting resistor, forward voltage, led resistor, vorwiderstand, led-vorwiderstand, flussspannung, strombegrenzung, leuchtdiode]
  source: "Kirchhoff's voltage law and Ohm's law for an LED string (the LED as a diode with a forward voltage); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed. (LEDs and diode circuits)"
  vars:
    vs: {dim: voltage, label: V_S, name: {en: "Supply voltage", de: "Versorgungsspannung"}, default: "12 V"}
    vf: {dim: voltage, label: V_F, name: {en: "Forward voltage per LED", de: "Flussspannung je LED"}, default: "2 V"}
    n: {dim: number, label: n, name: {en: "LEDs per string", de: "LEDs je Strang"}, default: 3}
    m: {dim: number, label: m, name: {en: "Parallel strings", de: "Parallele Stränge"}, default: 2}
    i: {dim: current, label: I_F, name: {en: "Current per LED", de: "Strom je LED"}, default: "20 mA"}
    r: {dim: resistance, label: R, name: {en: "Series resistor per string", de: "Vorwiderstand je Strang"}, eseries: true}
  dof: 5
  rules:
    r: ["(vs-n*vf)/i"]
    i: ["(vs-n*vf)/r"]
    vs: ["i*r+n*vf"]
    vf: ["(vs-i*r)/n"]
    n: ["(vs-i*r)/vf"]
  derived:
    vr: {dim: voltage, label: V_R, name: {en: "Voltage across the resistor", de: "Spannung am Vorwiderstand"}, expr: ["vs-n*vf", "i*r"]}
    itot: {dim: current, label: I_tot, name: {en: "Total current (all strings)", de: "Gesamtstrom (alle Stränge)"}, expr: "m*i"}
    pr: {dim: power, label: P_R, name: {en: "Power in each resistor", de: "Verlustleistung je Widerstand"}, expr: ["i^2*r", "vr*i"]}
    pled: {dim: power, label: P_LED, name: {en: "Power in each LED", de: "Leistung je LED"}, expr: "vf*i"}
    ptot: {dim: power, label: P_tot, name: {en: "Total power from the supply", de: "Gesamtleistung aus der Versorgung"}, expr: ["vs*itot", "m*(pr+n*pled)"]}
    eta: {dim: ratio, label: η, name: {en: "Share of the power in the LEDs", de: "Leistungsanteil in den LEDs"}, expr: "n*vf/vs", unit: pct}
  checks:
    - {when: "vs <= n*vf", warn: {en: "The supply voltage does not exceed the forward voltage of the string: no resistor can set the current.", de: "Die Versorgungsspannung liegt nicht über der Flussspannung des Strangs: Kein Vorwiderstand kann den Strom einstellen."}}
    - {when: "(abs(n-round(n)) > 0.000001) + (abs(m-round(m)) > 0.000001) > 0", warn: {en: "The number of LEDs per string and the number of strings must be whole numbers.", de: "Die Anzahl der LEDs je Strang und die Anzahl der Stränge müssen ganze Zahlen sein."}}
    - {when: "pr > 0.25", warn: {en: "The resistor dissipates more than 0.25 W: use a resistor with a higher power rating.", de: "Der Vorwiderstand setzt mehr als 0,25 W um: einen Widerstand mit höherer Nennleistung verwenden."}}
  formula: ["r = (vs - n * vf) / i", "itot = m * i", "ptot = vs * itot"]
  schematic: led_resistor

- id: zener_regulator
  kind: calculator
  category: semiconductors
  name: {cs: "Stabilizátor se Zenerovou diodou", da: "Zener-spændingsregulator", de: "Z-Dioden-Stabilisierung", el: "Σταθεροποιητής με δίοδο Zener", en: "Zener regulator", es: "Regulador con diodo Zener", fr: "Régulateur à diode Zener", hi: "ज़ेनर रेगुलेटर", it: "Regolatore con diodo Zener", ja: "ツェナーダイオード定電圧回路", nl: "Zenerdiode-stabilisator", no: "Zenerregulator", pl: "Stabilizator z diodą Zenera", pt: "Regulador com díodo Zener", sv: "Zenerregulator", zh: "齐纳稳压电路"}
  doc:
    en: "A shunt regulator: a series resistor R feeds a Zener diode in parallel with the load. R must pass the maximum load current I_L plus the minimum Zener current I_Z(min) that keeps the Zener in regulation: R = (V_in − V_Z) / (I_L + I_Z(min)). Without load the whole current flows through the Zener, so its power is V_Z × I_R at no load, the worst case. The Zener is treated as ideal (dynamic resistance neglected). Use the lowest input voltage to size R and check the powers with the highest. Example with the defaults: 12 V to 5.1 V at 20 mA load and 5 mA minimum Zener current needs 276 Ω (270 Ω is the nearest E24 value); the Zener then dissipates about 0.13 W without load."
    de: "Ein Parallelregler: Ein Vorwiderstand R speist eine Z-Diode parallel zur Last. R muss den maximalen Laststrom I_L plus den minimalen Z-Strom I_Z(min) führen, der die Z-Diode in der Regelung hält: R = (V_in − V_Z) / (I_L + I_Z(min)). Ohne Last fließt der gesamte Strom durch die Z-Diode, ihre Leistung ist dann V_Z · I_R, der ungünstigste Fall. Die Z-Diode wird als ideal behandelt (differenzieller Widerstand vernachlässigt). R mit der kleinsten Eingangsspannung bemessen und die Leistungen mit der größten prüfen. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: Von 12 V auf 5,1 V bei 20 mA Last und 5 mA minimalem Z-Strom braucht man 276 Ω (270 Ω ist der nächste E24-Wert); die Z-Diode setzt ohne Last dann etwa 0,13 W um."
  tags: [zener, zener diode, shunt regulator, voltage regulator, regulator, voltage reference, z-diode, spannungsstabilisierung, parallelregler, stabilisierung, vorwiderstand]
  source: "Zener shunt regulator (series resistor R = (V_in − V_Z) / (I_L + I_Z) with an ideal Zener); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed. (Zener diode regulators)"
  vars:
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "Input voltage", de: "Eingangsspannung"}, default: "12 V"}
    vz: {dim: voltage, label: V_Z, name: {en: "Zener voltage", de: "Z-Spannung"}, default: "5.1 V"}
    il: {dim: current, label: I_L, name: {en: "Maximum load current", de: "Maximaler Laststrom"}, default: "20 mA"}
    izmin: {dim: current, label: I_Zmin, name: {en: "Minimum Zener current", de: "Minimaler Z-Strom"}, default: "5 mA"}
    r: {dim: resistance, label: R, name: {en: "Series resistor", de: "Vorwiderstand"}, eseries: true}
  dof: 4
  rules:
    r: ["(vin-vz)/(il+izmin)"]
    il: ["(vin-vz)/r-izmin"]
    izmin: ["(vin-vz)/r-il"]
    vin: ["r*(il+izmin)+vz"]
    vz: ["vin-r*(il+izmin)"]
  derived:
    ir: {dim: current, label: I_R, name: {en: "Resistor current (Zener current without load)", de: "Widerstandsstrom (Z-Strom ohne Last)"}, expr: ["il+izmin", "(vin-vz)/r"]}
    pz: {dim: power, label: P_Z, name: {en: "Zener power without load", de: "Z-Dioden-Leistung ohne Last"}, expr: ["vz*ir", "vin*ir-pr"]}
    pr: {dim: power, label: P_R, name: {en: "Resistor power", de: "Leistung im Vorwiderstand"}, expr: ["(vin-vz)*ir", "ir^2*r"]}
    pl: {dim: power, label: P_L, name: {en: "Load power", de: "Lastleistung"}, expr: "vz*il"}
    eta: {dim: ratio, label: η, name: {en: "Efficiency at full load", de: "Wirkungsgrad bei Volllast"}, expr: "pl/(vin*ir)", unit: pct}
  checks:
    - {when: "vin <= vz", warn: {en: "V_in must be above V_Z: otherwise no current flows through the series resistor.", de: "V_in muss über V_Z liegen: Sonst fließt kein Strom durch den Vorwiderstand."}}
    - {when: "(il < 0) + (izmin < 0) > 0", warn: {en: "The resistor cannot supply the load current plus the minimum Zener current (one of the currents comes out negative).", de: "Der Widerstand kann Laststrom und minimalen Z-Strom nicht liefern (einer der Ströme wird negativ)."}}
    - {when: "pz > 0.5", warn: {en: "The Zener dissipates more than 0.5 W without load: a 500 mW Zener is not enough.", de: "Die Z-Diode setzt ohne Last mehr als 0,5 W um: Eine 500-mW-Diode reicht nicht."}}
    - {when: "pr > 0.25", warn: {en: "The series resistor dissipates more than 0.25 W: use a resistor with a higher power rating.", de: "Der Vorwiderstand setzt mehr als 0,25 W um: einen Widerstand mit höherer Nennleistung verwenden."}}
  formula: ["r = (vin - vz) / (il + izmin)", "pz = vz * ir"]
  schematic: zener_regulator

- id: transistor_switch
  kind: calculator
  category: semiconductors
  name: {cs: "Tranzistor jako spínač", da: "Transistor som kontakt", de: "Transistor als Schalter", el: "Τρανζίστορ ως διακόπτης", en: "Transistor switch", es: "Transistor como interruptor", fr: "Transistor en commutation", hi: "ट्रांजिस्टर स्विच", it: "Transistor come interruttore", ja: "トランジスタスイッチ", nl: "Transistor als schakelaar", no: "Transistor som bryter", pl: "Tranzystor jako przełącznik", pt: "Transístor como interruptor", sv: "Transistor som brytare", zh: "晶体管开关"}
  doc:
    en: "An NPN transistor as a saturated low-side switch: the base resistor must pass enough base current to drive the collector current I_C into saturation. The minimum base current is I_C / h_FE; the overdrive factor multiplies it (a factor of 2 to 10 is common) so that the transistor stays saturated despite spread and temperature: I_B = overdrive × I_C / h_FE and R_B = (V_in − V_BE) / I_B. Use the minimum h_FE from the datasheet at this collector current, not the typical value. Example with the defaults: a 5 V logic output switching 100 mA with h_FE = 100 and an overdrive of 5 needs 5 mA of base current and R_B = 860 Ω. The forced gain h_FE / overdrive is the ratio I_C / I_B the circuit actually uses."
    de: "Ein NPN-Transistor als gesättigter Low-Side-Schalter: Der Basiswiderstand muss genug Basisstrom führen, um den Kollektorstrom I_C in die Sättigung zu treiben. Der Mindest-Basisstrom ist I_C / h_FE; der Übersteuerungsfaktor vergrößert ihn (üblich sind Faktoren von 2 bis 10), damit der Transistor trotz Streuung und Temperatur gesättigt bleibt: I_B = Übersteuerung · I_C / h_FE und R_B = (V_in − V_BE) / I_B. Den Mindestwert von h_FE aus dem Datenblatt bei diesem Kollektorstrom verwenden, nicht den typischen. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: Ein 5-V-Logikausgang, der 100 mA schaltet, braucht bei h_FE = 100 und 5-facher Übersteuerung 5 mA Basisstrom und R_B = 860 Ω. Die Zwangsstromverstärkung h_FE / Übersteuerung ist das Verhältnis I_C / I_B, das die Schaltung tatsächlich nutzt."
  tags: [transistor, bjt, npn, switch, saturation, base resistor, overdrive, hfe, forced beta, transistor schalter, basiswiderstand, sättigung, übersteuerung, stromverstärkung]
  source: "Saturated BJT switch (R_B = (V_in − V_BE) / I_B with I_B = overdrive × I_C / h_FE); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 2"
  vars:
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "Drive voltage", de: "Ansteuerspannung"}, default: "5 V"}
    vbe: {dim: voltage, label: V_BE, name: {en: "Base-emitter voltage", de: "Basis-Emitter-Spannung"}, default: "0.7 V"}
    ic: {dim: current, label: I_C, name: {en: "Collector current", de: "Kollektorstrom"}, default: "100 mA"}
    hfe: {dim: number, label: h_FE, name: {en: "Current gain (minimum)", de: "Stromverstärkung (Minimum)"}, default: 100}
    od: {dim: number, label: k, name: {en: "Overdrive factor", de: "Übersteuerungsfaktor"}, default: 5}
    rb: {dim: resistance, label: R_B, name: {en: "Base resistor", de: "Basiswiderstand"}, eseries: true}
  dof: 5
  rules:
    rb: ["(vin-vbe)*hfe/(od*ic)"]
    ic: ["(vin-vbe)*hfe/(od*rb)"]
    hfe: ["od*ic*rb/(vin-vbe)"]
    od: ["(vin-vbe)*hfe/(ic*rb)"]
    vin: ["od*ic*rb/hfe+vbe"]
    vbe: ["vin-od*ic*rb/hfe"]
  derived:
    ib: {dim: current, label: I_B, name: {en: "Base current", de: "Basisstrom"}, expr: "od*ic/hfe"}
    vrb: {dim: voltage, label: V_RB, name: {en: "Voltage across the base resistor", de: "Spannung am Basiswiderstand"}, expr: ["vin-vbe", "ib*rb"]}
    betaf: {dim: number, label: β_forced, name: {en: "Forced gain I_C / I_B", de: "Zwangsstromverstärkung I_C / I_B"}, expr: ["hfe/od", "ic/ib"]}
    prb: {dim: power, label: P_RB, name: {en: "Base resistor power", de: "Leistung im Basiswiderstand"}, expr: ["ib^2*rb", "vrb*ib"]}
  checks:
    - {when: "vin <= vbe", warn: {en: "V_in does not exceed V_BE: no base current can flow.", de: "V_in liegt nicht über V_BE: Es kann kein Basisstrom fließen."}}
    - {when: "od < 1", warn: {en: "Overdrive below 1: the base current is smaller than I_C / h_FE, so the transistor does not saturate.", de: "Übersteuerung unter 1: Der Basisstrom ist kleiner als I_C / h_FE, der Transistor sättigt nicht."}}
  formula: ["rb = (vin - vbe) / ib", "ib = od * ic / hfe"]
  schematic: transistor_switch

- id: bjt_divider_bias
  kind: calculator
  category: semiconductors
  name: {cs: "Nastavení pracovního bodu tranzistoru děličem", da: "Transistorarbejdspunkt med spændingsdeler", de: "Transistor-Arbeitspunkt mit Basisspannungsteiler", el: "Πόλωση BJT με διαιρέτη τάσης", en: "BJT divider bias", es: "Polarización de BJT por divisor de tensión", fr: "Polarisation de transistor par pont diviseur", hi: "BJT विभाजक बायस", it: "Polarizzazione BJT con partitore", ja: "BJTの分圧バイアス回路", nl: "BJT-instelling met spanningsdeler", no: "BJT-forspenning med spenningsdeler", pl: "Polaryzacja tranzystora dzielnikiem napięcia", pt: "Polarização de TBJ com divisor de tensão", sv: "BJT-förspänning med spänningsdelare", zh: "BJT分压偏置"}
  doc:
    en: "DC operating point of a common-emitter stage with voltage-divider bias (four resistors). The divider R1 / R2 is replaced by its Thevenin equivalent, V_TH = V_CC × R2 / (R1 + R2) with R_TH = R1 ∥ R2, and the base current is taken into account: I_B = (V_TH − V_BE) / (R_TH + (β + 1) × R_E), I_C = β × I_B, I_E = (β + 1) × I_B, V_E = I_E × R_E, V_B = V_E + V_BE and V_CE = V_CC − I_C × R_C − I_E × R_E. The model assumes the forward-active region; this calculator is forward-only (enter all seven values). Example with the defaults: 12 V, R1 = 47 kΩ, R2 = 10 kΩ, R_E = 1 kΩ, R_C = 4.7 kΩ and β = 100 give I_C ≈ 1.29 mA and V_CE ≈ 4.66 V. The warning for a soft divider appears when R_TH exceeds a tenth of (β + 1) × R_E: then I_C depends noticeably on β."
    de: "Gleichstrom-Arbeitspunkt einer Emitterschaltung mit Basisspannungsteiler (vier Widerstände). Der Teiler R1 / R2 wird durch seine Thevenin-Ersatzquelle ersetzt, V_TH = V_CC · R2 / (R1 + R2) mit R_TH = R1 ∥ R2, und der Basisstrom wird berücksichtigt: I_B = (V_TH − V_BE) / (R_TH + (β + 1) · R_E), I_C = β · I_B, I_E = (β + 1) · I_B, V_E = I_E · R_E, V_B = V_E + V_BE und V_CE = V_CC − I_C · R_C − I_E · R_E. Das Modell setzt den Normalbetrieb (aktiver Bereich) voraus; der Rechner arbeitet nur vorwärts (alle sieben Werte eingeben). Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: 12 V, R1 = 47 kΩ, R2 = 10 kΩ, R_E = 1 kΩ, R_C = 4,7 kΩ und β = 100 ergeben I_C ≈ 1,29 mA und V_CE ≈ 4,66 V. Die Warnung vor einem weichen Teiler erscheint, wenn R_TH größer als ein Zehntel von (β + 1) · R_E ist: Dann hängt I_C merklich von β ab."
  tags: [bjt, transistor, bias, operating point, voltage divider bias, common emitter, thevenin, q point, arbeitspunkt, basisspannungsteiler, emitterschaltung, transistor, vorspannung]
  source: "Voltage-divider bias with the Thevenin base circuit and (β + 1) × R_E; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 2; A. S. Sedra, K. C. Smith: Microelectronic Circuits (BJT biasing)"
  vars:
    vcc: {dim: voltage, label: V_CC, name: {en: "Supply voltage", de: "Versorgungsspannung"}, default: "12 V"}
    r1: {dim: resistance, label: R_1, name: {en: "Upper divider resistor", de: "Oberer Teilerwiderstand"}, default: "47k", eseries: true}
    r2: {dim: resistance, label: R_2, name: {en: "Lower divider resistor", de: "Unterer Teilerwiderstand"}, default: "10k", eseries: true}
    re: {dim: resistance, label: R_E, name: {en: "Emitter resistor", de: "Emitterwiderstand"}, default: "1k", eseries: true}
    rc: {dim: resistance, label: R_C, name: {en: "Collector resistor", de: "Kollektorwiderstand"}, default: "4k7", eseries: true}
    vbe: {dim: voltage, label: V_BE, name: {en: "Base-emitter voltage", de: "Basis-Emitter-Spannung"}, default: "0.7 V"}
    beta: {dim: number, label: β, name: {en: "Current gain", de: "Stromverstärkung"}, default: 100}
  dof: 7
  derived:
    vth: {dim: voltage, label: V_TH, name: {en: "Thevenin base voltage", de: "Thevenin-Basisspannung"}, expr: "vcc*r2/(r1+r2)"}
    rth: {dim: resistance, label: R_TH, name: {en: "Thevenin base resistance", de: "Thevenin-Basiswiderstand"}, expr: "r1*r2/(r1+r2)"}
    ib: {dim: current, label: I_B, name: {en: "Base current", de: "Basisstrom"}, expr: "(vth-vbe)/(rth+(beta+1)*re)"}
    ic: {dim: current, label: I_C, name: {en: "Collector current", de: "Kollektorstrom"}, expr: "beta*ib"}
    ie: {dim: current, label: I_E, name: {en: "Emitter current", de: "Emitterstrom"}, expr: "(beta+1)*ib"}
    ve: {dim: voltage, label: V_E, name: {en: "Emitter voltage", de: "Emitterspannung"}, expr: "ie*re"}
    vb: {dim: voltage, label: V_B, name: {en: "Base voltage", de: "Basisspannung"}, expr: "ve+vbe"}
    vce: {dim: voltage, label: V_CE, name: {en: "Collector-emitter voltage", de: "Kollektor-Emitter-Spannung"}, expr: "vcc-ic*rc-ve"}
    ptr: {dim: power, label: P_tr, name: {en: "Transistor power", de: "Verlustleistung des Transistors"}, expr: "vce*ic+vbe*ib"}
  checks:
    - {when: "vth <= vbe", warn: {en: "V_TH does not exceed V_BE: the transistor is off and the model does not apply.", de: "V_TH liegt nicht über V_BE: Der Transistor sperrt, das Modell gilt nicht."}}
    - {when: "vce < 0.2", warn: {en: "V_CE is below 0.2 V, a typical saturation voltage: the transistor is saturated and the active-region result is not valid.", de: "V_CE liegt unter 0,2 V, einer typischen Sättigungsspannung: Der Transistor ist gesättigt, das Ergebnis des aktiven Bereichs gilt nicht."}}
    - {when: "rth > 0.1*(beta+1)*re", warn: {en: "The base divider is soft: R_TH is more than a tenth of (β + 1) × R_E, so I_C depends noticeably on β.", de: "Der Basisteiler ist weich: R_TH ist größer als ein Zehntel von (β + 1) · R_E, I_C hängt daher merklich von β ab."}}
  formula: ["vth = vcc * r2 / (r1 + r2)", "ib = (vth - vbe) / (rth + (beta + 1) * re)", "vce = vcc - ic * rc - ve"]
  schematic: bjt_divider_bias

- id: mosfet_losses
  kind: calculator
  category: semiconductors
  name: {cs: "Ztráty MOSFETu", da: "MOSFET-tab", de: "MOSFET-Verluste", el: "Απώλειες MOSFET", en: "MOSFET losses", es: "Pérdidas de un MOSFET", fr: "Pertes d'un MOSFET", hi: "MOSFET हानियाँ", it: "Perdite del MOSFET", ja: "MOSFETの損失", nl: "MOSFET-verliezen", no: "MOSFET-tap", pl: "Straty mocy w MOSFET", pt: "Perdas num MOSFET", sv: "MOSFET-förluster", zh: "MOSFET损耗"}
  doc:
    en: "Estimated losses of a MOSFET that switches the current I_D against the voltage V_DS at the frequency f_sw with the duty cycle D. Conduction loss: P_cond = D × I_D² × R_DS(on). Switching loss with linear, overlapping voltage and current transitions: P_sw = ½ × V_DS × I_D × (t_r + t_f) × f_sw. Gate-drive loss, output-capacitance loss, reverse-recovery and body-diode loss are not included, and R_DS(on) rises with temperature, so enter the value at operating temperature from the datasheet. The calculator is forward-only. Example with the defaults: 10 A at 12 V, R_DS(on) = 10 mΩ, D = 50 %, t_r = t_f = 20 ns and 200 kHz give 0.5 W conduction plus 0.48 W switching, 0.98 W in total."
    de: "Geschätzte Verluste eines MOSFETs, der den Strom I_D gegen die Spannung V_DS mit der Frequenz f_sw und dem Tastgrad D schaltet. Durchlassverlust: P_cond = D · I_D² · R_DS(on). Schaltverlust bei linearen, sich überlappenden Spannungs- und Stromflanken: P_sw = ½ · V_DS · I_D · (t_r + t_f) · f_sw. Gate-Treiber-Verluste, Verluste der Ausgangskapazität sowie Sperrverzögerungs- und Body-Dioden-Verluste sind nicht enthalten; R_DS(on) steigt mit der Temperatur, daher den Wert bei Betriebstemperatur aus dem Datenblatt eingeben. Der Rechner arbeitet nur vorwärts. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: 10 A bei 12 V, R_DS(on) = 10 mΩ, D = 50 %, t_r = t_f = 20 ns und 200 kHz ergeben 0,5 W Durchlassverlust plus 0,48 W Schaltverlust, zusammen 0,98 W."
  tags: [mosfet, losses, conduction loss, switching loss, rds on, power loss, switching, buck, durchlassverlust, schaltverlust, verlustleistung, mosfet-verluste, schaltnetzteil]
  source: "Conduction loss D·I²·R_DS(on) and the linear-transition switching loss ½·V·I·(t_r + t_f)·f_sw; R. W. Erickson, D. Maksimović: Fundamentals of Power Electronics (switching loss); N. Mohan, T. M. Undeland, W. P. Robbins: Power Electronics (power MOSFET losses)"
  vars:
    i_d: {dim: current, label: I_D, name: {en: "Drain current (on-state)", de: "Drainstrom (eingeschaltet)"}, default: "10 A"}
    rds: {dim: resistance, label: R_DS(on), name: {en: "On-resistance", de: "Einschaltwiderstand"}, default: "10 mΩ"}
    duty: {dim: ratio, label: D, name: {en: "Duty cycle", de: "Tastgrad"}, default: "50 %", unit: pct, units: [pct, ""]}
    vds: {dim: voltage, label: V_DS, name: {en: "Drain-source voltage (off-state)", de: "Drain-Source-Spannung (ausgeschaltet)"}, default: "12 V"}
    tr: {dim: time, label: t_r, name: {en: "Rise time", de: "Anstiegszeit"}, default: "20 ns", units: [""]}
    tf: {dim: time, label: t_f, name: {en: "Fall time", de: "Abfallzeit"}, default: "20 ns", units: [""]}
    fsw: {dim: frequency, label: f_sw, name: {en: "Switching frequency", de: "Schaltfrequenz"}, default: "200 kHz"}
  dof: 7
  derived:
    vdson: {dim: voltage, label: V_DS(on), name: {en: "On-state voltage drop", de: "Durchlassspannung"}, expr: "i_d*rds"}
    pcond: {dim: power, label: P_cond, name: {en: "Conduction loss", de: "Durchlassverlust"}, expr: ["duty*i_d^2*rds", "duty*i_d*vdson"]}
    psw: {dim: power, label: P_sw, name: {en: "Switching loss", de: "Schaltverlust"}, expr: "vds*i_d*(tr+tf)*fsw/2"}
    ptot: {dim: power, label: P_tot, name: {en: "Total loss", de: "Gesamtverlust"}, expr: "pcond+psw"}
  checks:
    - {when: "(duty < 0) + (duty > 1) > 0", warn: {en: "The duty cycle must be between 0 % and 100 %.", de: "Der Tastgrad muss zwischen 0 % und 100 % liegen."}}
    - {when: "(tr+tf)*fsw > 0.5", warn: {en: "The switching times take more than half of the period: the linear switching-loss model does not apply.", de: "Die Schaltzeiten nehmen mehr als die halbe Periode ein: Das lineare Schaltverlustmodell gilt nicht."}}
  formula: ["pcond = duty * i_d^2 * rds", "psw = vds * i_d * (tr + tf) * fsw / 2", "ptot = pcond + psw"]
  schematic: mosfet_losses

- id: heatsink
  kind: calculator
  category: semiconductors
  name: {cs: "Chladič", da: "Køleplade", de: "Kühlkörper", el: "Ψύκτρα", en: "Heatsink", es: "Disipador de calor", fr: "Dissipateur thermique", hi: "हीटसिंक", it: "Dissipatore di calore", ja: "ヒートシンク", nl: "Koellichaam", no: "Kjøleribbe", pl: "Radiator", pt: "Dissipador de calor", sv: "Kylfläns", zh: "散热器"}
  doc:
    en: "Steady-state thermal model of a power device: a chain of thermal resistances from the junction to the ambient air, T_J = T_A + P × (R_thJC + R_thCS + R_thSA), with junction-to-case, case-to-heatsink (insulator, grease) and heatsink-to-ambient resistance. Every stage drops P × R degrees. Enter the maximum junction temperature of the datasheet as T_J (for example 125 °C or 150 °C) together with the power and the other resistances to find the heatsink resistance R_thSA you need; a result of zero or below means no heatsink is good enough. Example with the defaults: 10 W at 25 °C ambient with 1.5 + 0.5 + 3 °C/W gives a junction temperature of 75 °C."
    de: "Thermisches Gleichgewichtsmodell eines Leistungsbauteils: eine Kette von Wärmewiderständen von der Sperrschicht zur Umgebungsluft, T_J = T_A + P · (R_thJC + R_thCS + R_thSA), mit den Widerständen Sperrschicht–Gehäuse, Gehäuse–Kühlkörper (Isolierfolie, Wärmeleitpaste) und Kühlkörper–Umgebung. Jede Stufe verursacht einen Temperaturabfall von P · R. T_J (die maximale Sperrschichttemperatur aus dem Datenblatt, zum Beispiel 125 °C oder 150 °C) zusammen mit Leistung und den übrigen Widerständen eingeben, um den benötigten Kühlkörperwiderstand R_thSA zu erhalten; ein Ergebnis von null oder darunter bedeutet, dass kein Kühlkörper ausreicht. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: 10 W bei 25 °C Umgebung mit 1,5 + 0,5 + 3 °C/W ergeben eine Sperrschichttemperatur von 75 °C."
  tags: [heatsink, heat sink, thermal resistance, junction temperature, cooling, power dissipation, rth, kühlkörper, wärmewiderstand, sperrschichttemperatur, kühlung, verlustleistung]
  source: "Steady-state thermal resistance network (the thermal analogue of Ohm's law: ΔT = P × R_th); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed. (heat and power design)"
  vars:
    ta: {dim: temperature, label: T_A, name: {en: "Ambient temperature", de: "Umgebungstemperatur"}, default: "25 °C", unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
    p: {dim: power, label: P, name: {en: "Power dissipation", de: "Verlustleistung"}, default: "10 W"}
    rjc: {dim: thermal_resistance, label: R_thJC, name: {en: "Junction to case", de: "Sperrschicht–Gehäuse"}, default: "1.5 °C/W", unit: degCW, units: [degCW, ""]}
    rcs: {dim: thermal_resistance, label: R_thCS, name: {en: "Case to heatsink", de: "Gehäuse–Kühlkörper"}, default: "0.5 °C/W", unit: degCW, units: [degCW, ""]}
    rsa: {dim: thermal_resistance, label: R_thSA, name: {en: "Heatsink to ambient", de: "Kühlkörper–Umgebung"}, default: "3 °C/W", unit: degCW, units: [degCW, ""]}
    tj: {dim: temperature, label: T_J, name: {en: "Junction temperature", de: "Sperrschichttemperatur"}, unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
  dof: 5
  rules:
    tj: ["ta+p*(rjc+rcs+rsa)"]
    ta: ["tj-p*(rjc+rcs+rsa)"]
    p: ["(tj-ta)/(rjc+rcs+rsa)"]
    rsa: ["(tj-ta)/p-rjc-rcs"]
    rcs: ["(tj-ta)/p-rjc-rsa"]
    rjc: ["(tj-ta)/p-rcs-rsa"]
  derived:
    rtot: {dim: thermal_resistance, label: R_thJA, name: {en: "Total junction to ambient", de: "Gesamt Sperrschicht–Umgebung"}, expr: ["rjc+rcs+rsa", "(tj-ta)/p"], unit: degCW, units: [degCW, ""]}
    dtj: {dim: tempdiff, label: ΔT_J, name: {en: "Junction temperature rise", de: "Sperrschicht-Übertemperatur"}, expr: ["tj-ta", "p*rtot"], unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
    dtjc: {dim: tempdiff, label: ΔT_JC, name: {en: "Drop junction to case", de: "Abfall Sperrschicht–Gehäuse"}, expr: "p*rjc", unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
    dtcs: {dim: tempdiff, label: ΔT_CS, name: {en: "Drop case to heatsink", de: "Abfall Gehäuse–Kühlkörper"}, expr: "p*rcs", unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
    dtsa: {dim: tempdiff, label: ΔT_SA, name: {en: "Drop heatsink to ambient", de: "Abfall Kühlkörper–Umgebung"}, expr: "p*rsa", unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
    tc: {dim: temperature, label: T_C, name: {en: "Case temperature", de: "Gehäusetemperatur"}, expr: ["ta+p*(rcs+rsa)", "tj-p*rjc"], unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
    ts: {dim: temperature, label: T_S, name: {en: "Heatsink temperature", de: "Kühlkörpertemperatur"}, expr: ["ta+p*rsa", "tc-p*rcs"], unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
  checks:
    - {when: "tj > 423.15", warn: {en: "The junction temperature is above 150 °C, a common absolute maximum for silicon power devices: check the datasheet limit.", de: "Die Sperrschichttemperatur liegt über 150 °C, einem üblichen Höchstwert für Silizium-Leistungsbauteile: Den Grenzwert im Datenblatt prüfen."}}
  formula: ["tj = ta + p * (rjc + rcs + rsa)"]
  schematic: heatsink
```

### Task C3.2: Op-amps (7 calculators)

**Files:**
- Create: `internal/ecalc/catalog/calculators/opamps.yaml`
- Create: `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/opamp_inverting.json`
- Create: `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/opamp_noninverting.json`
- Create: `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/opamp_difference.json`
- Create: `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/opamp_summing.json`
- Create: `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/opamp_integrator.json`
- Create: `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/schmitt_trigger.json`
- Create: `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/instrumentation_amp.json`
- Modify (replace the empty wrapper): `ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-schematics-opamps.js`
- Regenerate: `internal/ecalc/testdata/catalog.en.json` (never edit by hand, never merge by hand)

No existing function, type or schema is touched (new content files and one wrapper file only), so there is no GitNexus impact analysis to record for this task.

Seven op-amp calculators, all for an ideal op-amp. `opamp_inverting` carries the (negative) gain in the `ratio` dimension with `units: [""]` because the `number` dimension is positive-only. `opamp_summing` takes a list of input voltages (a list variable cannot be a rule target, so it is part of every solvable set). `schmitt_trigger` derives the feedback fraction `k` with four alternatives so that the design directions (thresholds to resistor and reference) are solvable. `instrumentation_amp` is the three-op-amp topology, `G = 1 + 2R / R_G`.

| id | variables | dof | solvable sets | default example (the default inputs are one of the solvable sets) | vectors (sets / solve) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opamp_inverting` | R_in, R_f, A_v, V_in, V_out | 3 | 8 | 10k, 100k, 0.1 V gives A_v = −10, V_out = −1 V | 4 / 12 |
| `opamp_noninverting` | R_f, R_g, G, V_in, V_out | 3 | 8 | 10k, 1k, 0.1 V gives G = 11, V_out = 1.1 V | 4 / 14 |
| `opamp_difference` | R_1 (= R_3), R_2 (= R_4), G, V_1, V_2, V_out | 4 | 11 | 10k, 100k, 1 V, 1.2 V gives G = 10, V_out = 2 V | 4 / 13 |
| `opamp_summing` | V_k (list), R, R_f, V_out | 3 | 3 (the list is always an input) | 1 V, 0.5 V, 0.25 V, 10k, 10k gives V_out = −1.75 V | 4 / 10 |
| `opamp_integrator` | V_in, R, C, t, V_out | 4 | 5 | 1 V, 10k, 100 nF, 2 ms gives V_out = −2 V, f_u = 159.15 Hz | 3 / 12 |
| `schmitt_trigger` | V_ref, V_OH, V_OL, R_1, R_2, V_TH, V_TL | 5 | 18 | 2.5 V, 5 V, 0 V, 10k, 100k gives V_TH = 2.727 V, V_TL = 2.273 V, V_H = 0.455 V | 4 / 16 |
| `instrumentation_amp` | R, R_G, G, V_diff, V_out | 3 | 8 | 25k, 500 Ω, 10 mV gives G = 101, V_out = 1.01 V | 4 / 12 |

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the vector files first**

Every set is a complete consistent value set (all variables and derived quantities) that the test replays through every rule alternative and through `Solve` from every solvable input set; every solve vector is one `Solve` call with the exact error map and the exact list of fired checks (indexes of the `checks` list, counted from 0). The expected numbers were computed by hand and cross-checked with an independent exact-fraction script (never with the solver); each `ref` writes the arithmetic out.

Create `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/opamp_inverting.json` with exactly this content:

```json
{
  "calc": "opamp_inverting",
  "sets": [
    {"values": {"rin": 10000, "rf": 100000, "av": -10, "vin": 0.1, "vout": -1, "iin": 1e-05, "adb": 20, "ngain": 11}, "ref": "hand: A_v = -100k / 10k = -10; V_out = -10 * 0.1 V = -1 V; I_in = 0.1 V / 10k = 10 uA (= -(-1 V) / 100k); gain magnitude 20 * log10(10) = 20 dB; noise gain 1 + 100k / 10k = 11 = 1 - (-10)"},
    {"values": {"rin": 1000, "rf": 4700, "av": -4.7, "vin": 0.5, "vout": -2.35, "iin": 0.0005, "adb": 13.44195715871435, "ngain": 5.7}, "ref": "hand: A_v = -4.7k / 1k = -4.7; V_out = -4.7 * 0.5 V = -2.35 V; I_in = 0.5 V / 1k = 0.5 mA (= 2.35 V / 4.7k); 20 * log10(4.7) = 13.442 dB (hand, independent script: log10 4.7 = 0.6720979); noise gain 1 + 4.7 = 5.7"},
    {"values": {"rin": 22000, "rf": 22000, "av": -1, "vin": 2, "vout": -2, "iin": 9.09090909090909e-05, "adb": 0, "ngain": 2}, "ref": "hand: A_v = -22k / 22k = -1; V_out = -1 * 2 V = -2 V; I_in = 2 V / 22k = 90.909 uA; gain magnitude 20 * log10(1) = 0 dB; noise gain 1 + 1 = 2"},
    {"values": {"rin": 2200, "rf": 33000, "av": -15, "vin": -0.2, "vout": 3, "iin": -9.09090909090909e-05, "adb": 23.521825181113627, "ngain": 16}, "ref": "hand: A_v = -33k / 2.2k = -15; V_out = -15 * (-0.2 V) = +3 V; I_in = -0.2 V / 2.2k = -90.909 uA (= -3 V / 33k); 20 * log10(15) = 23.522 dB (hand, independent script: log10 15 = 1.1760913); noise gain 1 + 15 = 16"}
  ],
  "solve": [
    {"inputs": {"rin": 10000, "rf": 100000, "vin": 0.1}, "expect": {"av": -10, "vout": -1, "iin": 1e-05, "adb": 20, "ngain": 11}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: A_v = -100k / 10k = -10 (20 dB), V_out = -10 * 0.1 V = -1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rin": 1000, "rf": 4700, "vin": 0.5}, "expect": {"av": -4.7, "vout": -2.35}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: A_v = -4.7k / 1k = -4.7, V_out = -4.7 * 0.5 V = -2.35 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rin": 1000, "av": -4.7, "vin": 0.5}, "expect": {"rf": 4700, "vout": -2.35}, "ref": "hand: R_f = -A_v * R_in = 4.7 * 1k = 4.7k; V_out = -4.7 * 0.5 V = -2.35 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rin": 10000, "av": -10, "vout": -1}, "expect": {"rf": 100000, "vin": 0.1}, "ref": "hand: R_f = 10 * 10k = 100k; V_in = V_out / A_v = -1 V / -10 = 0.1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 100000, "av": -10, "vin": 0.1}, "expect": {"rin": 10000, "vout": -1}, "ref": "hand: R_in = -R_f / A_v = 100k / 10 = 10k; V_out = -10 * 0.1 V = -1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 33000, "av": -15, "vout": 3}, "expect": {"rin": 2200, "vin": -0.2}, "ref": "hand: R_in = 33k / 15 = 2.2k; V_in = 3 V / -15 = -0.2 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rin": 10000, "rf": 100000, "vout": -1}, "expect": {"av": -10, "vin": 0.1}, "ref": "hand: A_v = -100k / 10k = -10; V_in = -1 V / -10 = 0.1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rin": 2200, "rf": 33000, "vout": 3}, "expect": {"av": -15, "vin": -0.2}, "ref": "hand: A_v = -33k / 2.2k = -15; V_in = 3 V / -15 = -0.2 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rin": 10000, "vin": 0.1, "vout": -1}, "expect": {"av": -10, "rf": 100000}, "ref": "hand: A_v = V_out / V_in = -1 V / 0.1 V = -10; R_f = 10 * 10k = 100k"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 4700, "vin": 0.5, "vout": -2.35}, "expect": {"av": -4.7, "rin": 1000}, "ref": "hand: A_v = -2.35 V / 0.5 V = -4.7; R_in = 4.7k / 4.7 = 1k"},
    {"inputs": {"rin": 10000, "av": 10, "vin": 0.1}, "expect": {"vout": 1}, "errors": {"rf": "range"}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: a positive gain 10 would need R_f = -10 * 10k = -100k, out of range; the positive-gain check fires"},
    {"inputs": {"rin": 10000, "rf": 100000}, "expect": {"av": -10}, "errors": {"vin": "undetermined", "vout": "undetermined"}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: the gain -10 follows from the two resistors, the input and output voltages are undetermined"}
  ]
}
```

```json
{
  "calc": "opamp_noninverting",
  "sets": [
    {"values": {"rf": 10000, "rg": 1000, "g": 11, "vin": 0.1, "vout": 1.1, "ifb": 0.0001, "adb": 20.827853703164504}, "ref": "hand: G = 1 + 10k / 1k = 11; V_out = 11 * 0.1 V = 1.1 V; I_fb = 0.1 V / 1k = 0.1 mA (= 1.1 V / 11k); 20 * log10(11) = 20.828 dB (hand, independent script: log10 11 = 1.0413927)"},
    {"values": {"rf": 47000, "rg": 10000, "g": 5.7, "vin": 0.2, "vout": 1.14, "ifb": 2e-05, "adb": 15.11749711344983}, "ref": "hand: G = 1 + 47k / 10k = 5.7; V_out = 5.7 * 0.2 V = 1.14 V; I_fb = 0.2 V / 10k = 20 uA (= 1.14 V / 57k); 20 * log10(5.7) = 15.117 dB (hand, independent script: log10 5.7 = 0.7558749)"},
    {"values": {"rf": 20000, "rg": 10000, "g": 3, "vin": -0.5, "vout": -1.5, "ifb": -5e-05, "adb": 9.542425094393248}, "ref": "hand: G = 1 + 20k / 10k = 3; V_out = 3 * (-0.5 V) = -1.5 V; I_fb = -0.5 V / 10k = -50 uA (= -1.5 V / 30k); 20 * log10(3) = 9.542 dB (log10 3 = 0.4771213)"},
    {"values": {"rf": 3300, "rg": 1000, "g": 4.3, "vin": 1, "vout": 4.3, "ifb": 0.001, "adb": 12.669369111591731}, "ref": "hand: G = 1 + 3.3k / 1k = 4.3; V_out = 4.3 * 1 V = 4.3 V; I_fb = 1 V / 1k = 1 mA (= 4.3 V / 4.3k); 20 * log10(4.3) = 12.669 dB (hand, independent script: log10 4.3 = 0.6334685)"}
  ],
  "solve": [
    {"inputs": {"rf": 10000, "rg": 1000, "vin": 0.1}, "expect": {"g": 11, "vout": 1.1, "ifb": 0.0001}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: G = 1 + 10k / 1k = 11, V_out = 1.1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 20000, "rg": 10000, "vin": -0.5}, "expect": {"g": 3, "vout": -1.5}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: G = 1 + 2 = 3, V_out = 3 * (-0.5 V) = -1.5 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rg": 10000, "g": 2, "vin": 0.5}, "expect": {"rf": 10000, "vout": 1}, "ref": "hand: R_f = (G - 1) * R_g = 1 * 10k = 10k; V_out = 2 * 0.5 V = 1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rg": 1000, "g": 11, "vout": 1.1}, "expect": {"rf": 10000, "vin": 0.1}, "ref": "hand: R_f = 10 * 1k = 10k; V_in = 1.1 V / 11 = 0.1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 10000, "g": 11, "vin": 0.1}, "expect": {"rg": 1000, "vout": 1.1}, "ref": "hand: R_g = R_f / (G - 1) = 10k / 10 = 1k; V_out = 11 * 0.1 V = 1.1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 20000, "g": 3, "vout": -1.5}, "expect": {"rg": 10000, "vin": -0.5}, "ref": "hand: R_g = 20k / 2 = 10k; V_in = -1.5 V / 3 = -0.5 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 10000, "rg": 1000, "vout": 1.1}, "expect": {"g": 11, "vin": 0.1}, "ref": "hand: G = 1 + 10 = 11; V_in = 1.1 V / 11 = 0.1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 3300, "rg": 1000, "vout": 4.3}, "expect": {"g": 4.3, "vin": 1}, "ref": "hand: G = 1 + 3.3 = 4.3; V_in = 4.3 V / 4.3 = 1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 20000, "vin": -0.5, "vout": -1.5}, "expect": {"g": 3, "rg": 10000}, "ref": "hand: G = V_out / V_in = -1.5 V / -0.5 V = 3; R_g = 20k / (3 - 1) = 10k"},
    {"inputs": {"rg": 1000, "vin": 1, "vout": 4.3}, "expect": {"g": 4.3, "rf": 3300}, "ref": "hand: G = 4.3 V / 1 V = 4.3; R_f = 3.3 * 1k = 3.3k"},
    {"inputs": {"rg": 10000, "g": 1, "vin": 0.1}, "expect": {"vout": 0.1}, "errors": {"rf": "range"}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: G = 1 needs R_f = (1 - 1) * 10k = 0, which is out of range for a resistor; the gain check fires (use a voltage follower)"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 10000, "g": 1, "vin": 0.1}, "expect": {"vout": 0.1}, "errors": {"rg": "nonfinite"}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: G = 1 needs R_g = 10k / (1 - 1) = infinity (no resistor to ground); the gain check fires"},
    {"inputs": {"rg": 10000, "g": 0.5, "vin": 0.1}, "expect": {"vout": 0.05}, "errors": {"rf": "range"}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: G = 0.5 would need R_f = (0.5 - 1) * 10k = -5k, out of range; the gain check fires"},
    {"inputs": {"rf": 10000, "rg": 1000}, "expect": {"g": 11}, "errors": {"vin": "undetermined", "vout": "undetermined"}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: the gain 11 follows from the two resistors, the input and output voltages are undetermined"}
  ]
}
```

```json
{
  "calc": "opamp_difference",
  "sets": [
    {"values": {"r1": 10000, "r2": 100000, "g": 10, "v1": 1, "v2": 1.2, "vout": 2, "vdiff": 0.2, "vcm": 1.1, "rid": 20000}, "ref": "hand: G = 100k / 10k = 10; V_2 - V_1 = 0.2 V; V_out = 10 * 0.2 V = 2 V; common mode (1 V + 1.2 V) / 2 = 1.1 V; R_id = 2 * 10k = 20k"},
    {"values": {"r1": 4700, "r2": 4700, "g": 1, "v1": 3, "v2": 2.5, "vout": -0.5, "vdiff": -0.5, "vcm": 2.75, "rid": 9400}, "ref": "hand: G = 4.7k / 4.7k = 1; V_2 - V_1 = -0.5 V; V_out = -0.5 V; common mode (3 V + 2.5 V) / 2 = 2.75 V; R_id = 9.4k"},
    {"values": {"r1": 1000, "r2": 22000, "g": 22, "v1": 0.05, "v2": 0, "vout": -1.1, "vdiff": -0.05, "vcm": 0.025, "rid": 2000}, "ref": "hand: G = 22k / 1k = 22; V_2 - V_1 = -0.05 V; V_out = 22 * (-0.05 V) = -1.1 V; common mode 0.025 V; R_id = 2k"},
    {"values": {"r1": 2200, "r2": 6600, "g": 3, "v1": -1, "v2": 0.5, "vout": 4.5, "vdiff": 1.5, "vcm": -0.25, "rid": 4400}, "ref": "hand: G = 6.6k / 2.2k = 3; V_2 - V_1 = 0.5 V - (-1 V) = 1.5 V; V_out = 3 * 1.5 V = 4.5 V; common mode (-1 V + 0.5 V) / 2 = -0.25 V; R_id = 4.4k"}
  ],
  "solve": [
    {"inputs": {"r1": 10000, "r2": 100000, "v1": 1, "v2": 1.2}, "expect": {"g": 10, "vout": 2, "vdiff": 0.2}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: G = 10, V_out = 10 * (1.2 V - 1 V) = 2 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r1": 4700, "r2": 4700, "v1": 3, "v2": 2.5}, "expect": {"g": 1, "vout": -0.5}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: G = 1, V_out = 2.5 V - 3 V = -0.5 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r1": 1000, "g": 22, "v1": 0.05, "v2": 0}, "expect": {"r2": 22000, "vout": -1.1}, "ref": "hand: R_2 = G * R_1 = 22 * 1k = 22k; V_out = 22 * (0 - 0.05 V) = -1.1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r1": 10000, "g": 10, "v1": 1, "vout": 2}, "expect": {"r2": 100000, "v2": 1.2}, "ref": "hand: R_2 = 10 * 10k = 100k; V_2 = V_1 + V_out / G = 1 V + 0.2 V = 1.2 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r2": 22000, "g": 22, "v1": 0.05, "v2": 0}, "expect": {"r1": 1000, "vout": -1.1}, "ref": "hand: R_1 = R_2 / G = 22k / 22 = 1k; V_out = 22 * (-0.05 V) = -1.1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r2": 6600, "g": 3, "v2": 0.5, "vout": 4.5}, "expect": {"r1": 2200, "v1": -1}, "ref": "hand: R_1 = 6.6k / 3 = 2.2k; V_1 = V_2 - V_out / G = 0.5 V - 1.5 V = -1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r1": 10000, "r2": 100000, "v1": 1, "vout": 2}, "expect": {"g": 10, "v2": 1.2}, "ref": "hand: G = 100k / 10k = 10; V_2 = 1 V + 2 V / 10 = 1.2 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r1": 2200, "r2": 6600, "v1": -1, "vout": 4.5}, "expect": {"g": 3, "v2": 0.5}, "ref": "hand: G = 6.6k / 2.2k = 3; V_2 = -1 V + 4.5 V / 3 = 0.5 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r1": 10000, "r2": 100000, "v2": 1.2, "vout": 2}, "expect": {"g": 10, "v1": 1}, "ref": "hand: G = 10; V_1 = V_2 - V_out / G = 1.2 V - 0.2 V = 1 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r1": 1000, "r2": 22000, "v2": 0, "vout": -1.1}, "expect": {"g": 22, "v1": 0.05}, "ref": "hand: G = 22; V_1 = 0 V - (-1.1 V) / 22 = 0.05 V"},
    {"inputs": {"r1": 10000, "v1": 1, "v2": 1.2, "vout": 2}, "expect": {"g": 10, "r2": 100000}, "ref": "hand: G = V_out / (V_2 - V_1) = 2 V / 0.2 V = 10; R_2 = 10 * 10k = 100k"},
    {"inputs": {"r2": 6600, "v1": -1, "v2": 0.5, "vout": 4.5}, "expect": {"g": 3, "r1": 2200}, "ref": "hand: G = 4.5 V / 1.5 V = 3; R_1 = 6.6k / 3 = 2.2k"},
    {"inputs": {"r1": 10000, "v1": 1, "v2": 1, "vout": 0.5}, "expect": {"vdiff": 0, "vcm": 1}, "errors": {"g": "nonfinite", "r2": "nonfinite"}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: V_2 = V_1 leaves a 0.5 V output unexplained: G = 0.5 V / 0 V = infinity, and so is R_2 = G * R_1"}
  ]
}
```

```json
{
  "calc": "opamp_summing",
  "sets": [
    {"values": {"vs": [1, 0.5, 0.25], "r": 10000, "rf": 10000, "vout": -1.75, "vsum": 1.75, "gi": 1, "ifb": 0.000175}, "ref": "hand: V_1 + V_2 + V_3 = 1 + 0.5 + 0.25 = 1.75 V; gain per input = 10k / 10k = 1; V_out = -1.75 V; I_fb = 1.75 V / 10k = 175 uA (= 1.75 V / 10k through R_f)"},
    {"values": {"vs": [0.1, 0.2], "r": 1000, "rf": 10000, "vout": -3, "vsum": 0.3, "gi": 10, "ifb": 0.0003}, "ref": "hand: 0.1 V + 0.2 V = 0.3 V; gain per input = 10k / 1k = 10; V_out = -10 * 0.3 V = -3 V; I_fb = 0.3 V / 1k = 0.3 mA (= 3 V / 10k)"},
    {"values": {"vs": [2, -1, 0.5, 1], "r": 22000, "rf": 33000, "vout": -3.75, "vsum": 2.5, "gi": 1.5, "ifb": 0.00011363636363636364}, "ref": "hand: 2 V - 1 V + 0.5 V + 1 V = 2.5 V; gain per input = 33k / 22k = 1.5; V_out = -1.5 * 2.5 V = -3.75 V; I_fb = 2.5 V / 22k = 113.64 uA (= 3.75 V / 33k)"},
    {"values": {"vs": [0.3], "r": 10000, "rf": 47000, "vout": -1.41, "vsum": 0.3, "gi": 4.7, "ifb": 3e-05}, "ref": "hand: a single input is the inverting amplifier: gain 47k / 10k = 4.7; V_out = -4.7 * 0.3 V = -1.41 V; I_fb = 0.3 V / 10k = 30 uA (= 1.41 V / 47k)"}
  ],
  "solve": [
    {"inputs": {"vs": [1, 0.5, 0.25], "r": 10000, "rf": 10000}, "expect": {"vout": -1.75, "vsum": 1.75, "gi": 1}, "ref": "hand: V_out = -(10k / 10k) * 1.75 V = -1.75 V"},
    {"inputs": {"vs": [0.1, 0.2], "r": 1000, "rf": 10000}, "expect": {"vout": -3, "vsum": 0.3}, "ref": "hand: V_out = -(10k / 1k) * 0.3 V = -3 V"},
    {"inputs": {"vs": [1, 0.5, 0.25], "r": 10000, "vout": -1.75}, "expect": {"rf": 10000}, "ref": "hand: R_f = -V_out * R / sum = 1.75 V * 10k / 1.75 V = 10k"},
    {"inputs": {"vs": [0.1, 0.2], "r": 1000, "vout": -3}, "expect": {"rf": 10000}, "ref": "hand: R_f = 3 V * 1k / 0.3 V = 10k"},
    {"inputs": {"vs": [1, 0.5, 0.25], "rf": 10000, "vout": -1.75}, "expect": {"r": 10000}, "ref": "hand: R = -R_f * sum / V_out = 10k * 1.75 V / 1.75 V = 10k"},
    {"inputs": {"vs": [2, -1, 0.5, 1], "rf": 33000, "vout": -3.75}, "expect": {"r": 22000}, "ref": "hand: R = 33k * 2.5 V / 3.75 V = 22k"},
    {"inputs": {"vs": [1, 0.5], "r": 10000, "vout": 1.5}, "expect": {"vsum": 1.5}, "errors": {"rf": "range"}, "ref": "hand: a positive output for positive inputs would need R_f = -1.5 V * 10k / 1.5 V = -10k, out of range"},
    {"inputs": {"vs": [1, -1], "r": 10000, "vout": 1}, "expect": {"vsum": 0}, "errors": {"rf": "nonfinite"}, "ref": "hand: the inputs cancel (sum 0 V) but the output is 1 V: R_f = -1 V * 10k / 0 V = -infinity"},
    {"inputs": {"vs": [0.3], "r": 10000, "rf": 47000}, "expect": {"vout": -1.41, "gi": 4.7}, "ref": "hand: one input, gain 4.7, V_out = -4.7 * 0.3 V = -1.41 V"},
    {"inputs": {"vs": [1], "r": 10000}, "errors": {"rf": "undetermined", "vout": "undetermined"}, "ref": "the feedback resistor and the output are missing: neither is determined"}
  ]
}
```

```json
    {"inputs": {"vin": 1, "r": 10000, "t": 0.002, "vout": -2}, "expect": {"c": 1e-07}, "ref": "hand: C = -V_in * t / (V_out * R) = 1 V * 2 ms / (2 V * 10k) = 100 nF"},
    {"inputs": {"vin": -3, "r": 4700, "t": 0.002068, "vout": 6}, "expect": {"c": 2.2e-07}, "ref": "hand: C = 3 V * 2.068 ms / (6 V * 4.7k) = 6.204e-3 / 28200 = 220 nF"},
    {"inputs": {"vin": 1, "r": 10000, "c": 1e-07, "vout": -2}, "expect": {"t": 0.002}, "ref": "hand: t = -V_out * R * C / V_in = 2 V * 1 ms / 1 V = 2 ms"},
    {"inputs": {"vin": -3, "r": 4700, "c": 2.2e-07, "vout": 6}, "expect": {"t": 0.002068}, "ref": "hand: t = -6 V * 1.034 ms / -3 V = 2.068 ms"},
    {"inputs": {"vin": 1, "c": 1e-07, "t": 0.002, "vout": 2}, "errors": {"r": "range"}, "ref": "hand: a positive output for a positive input needs R = -1 V * 2 ms / (2 V * 100 nF) = -10k, out of range"},
    {"inputs": {"vin": 10, "r": 1000, "c": 1e-08, "t": 0.005}, "expect": {"vout": -5000, "tau": 1e-05}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: R * C = 1k * 10 nF = 10 us; V_out = -10 V * 5 ms / 10 us = -5000 V, far above 15 V, so the saturation check fires"}
  ]
}
```

```bash
go test ./internal/ecalc -run 'TestCalculatorVectors/(opamp_inverting|opamp_noninverting|opamp_difference|opamp_summing|opamp_integrator|schmitt_trigger|instrumentation_amp)$' -count=1 -v 2>&1 | grep -c -- '--- PASS: TestCalculatorVectors/'
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the calculators**

Create `internal/ecalc/catalog/calculators/opamps.yaml` with exactly this content:

```yaml
# Op-amp calculators. All of them assume an ideal op-amp (infinite gain, no input current, output limited only by the
# supply rails). Every name is written in all 16 desktop locales; docs, variable names and warnings in English and
# German (other languages fall back to English). Rules are written out for every direction, in the order the solver
# tries them: the first alternative whose variables are all known wins.

- id: opamp_inverting
  kind: calculator
  category: opamps
  name: {cs: "Invertující zesilovač", da: "Inverterende forstærker", de: "Invertierender Verstärker", el: "Αναστρέφων ενισχυτής", en: "Inverting amplifier", es: "Amplificador inversor", fr: "Amplificateur inverseur", hi: "इन्वर्टिंग एम्पलीफायर", it: "Amplificatore invertente", ja: "反転増幅回路", nl: "Inverterende versterker", no: "Inverterende forsterker", pl: "Wzmacniacz odwracający", pt: "Amplificador inversor", sv: "Inverterande förstärkare", zh: "反相放大器"}
  doc:
    en: "The inverting op-amp amplifier: the input signal V_in reaches the inverting input through R_in, and the feedback resistor R_f returns part of the output to the same node. With an ideal op-amp this node is a virtual ground, so the gain is A_v = −R_f / R_in and V_out = A_v × V_in. The input resistance of the stage is R_in. Example with the defaults: R_in = 10 kΩ and R_f = 100 kΩ give a gain of −10 (20 dB), so 0.1 V in gives −1 V out. The noise gain 1 + R_f / R_in = 11 sets the usable bandwidth (gain-bandwidth product divided by the noise gain). The output cannot exceed the supply rails."
    de: "Der invertierende Operationsverstärker: Das Eingangssignal V_in gelangt über R_in an den invertierenden Eingang, der Rückkopplungswiderstand R_f führt einen Teil des Ausgangs an denselben Knoten zurück. Beim idealen Operationsverstärker ist dieser Knoten eine virtuelle Masse, die Verstärkung beträgt daher A_v = −R_f / R_in und V_out = A_v · V_in. Der Eingangswiderstand der Stufe ist R_in. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: R_in = 10 kΩ und R_f = 100 kΩ ergeben die Verstärkung −10 (20 dB); 0,1 V am Eingang ergeben −1 V am Ausgang. Die Rauschverstärkung 1 + R_f / R_in = 11 bestimmt die nutzbare Bandbreite (Verstärkungs-Bandbreite-Produkt geteilt durch die Rauschverstärkung). Der Ausgang kann die Versorgungsspannungen nicht überschreiten."
  tags: [opamp, op-amp, operational amplifier, inverting, inverting amplifier, gain, virtual ground, operationsverstärker, invertierend, verstärkung, virtuelle masse, rückkopplung]
  source: "Inverting amplifier with an ideal op-amp (virtual ground): A_v = −R_f / R_in; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 4"
  vars:
    rin: {dim: resistance, label: R_in, name: {en: "Input resistor", de: "Eingangswiderstand"}, default: "10k", eseries: true}
    rf: {dim: resistance, label: R_f, name: {en: "Feedback resistor", de: "Rückkopplungswiderstand"}, default: "100k", eseries: true}
    av: {dim: ratio, label: A_v, name: {en: "Voltage gain", de: "Spannungsverstärkung"}, units: [""]}
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "Input voltage", de: "Eingangsspannung"}, default: "0.1 V"}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    av: ["-rf/rin", "vout/vin"]
    rf: ["-av*rin"]
    rin: ["-rf/av"]
    vout: ["av*vin"]
    vin: ["vout/av"]
  derived:
    iin: {dim: current, label: I_in, name: {en: "Input current", de: "Eingangsstrom"}, expr: ["vin/rin", "-vout/rf"]}
    adb: {dim: gain, label: A_dB, name: {en: "Gain magnitude in dB", de: "Betrag der Verstärkung in dB"}, expr: "20*log10(abs(av))"}
    ngain: {dim: number, label: G_n, name: {en: "Noise gain 1 + R_f / R_in", de: "Rauschverstärkung 1 + R_f / R_in"}, expr: ["1+rf/rin", "1-av"]}
  checks:
    - {when: "av > 0", warn: {en: "An inverting amplifier has a negative gain (−R_f / R_in): a positive gain is not possible with this circuit.", de: "Ein invertierender Verstärker hat eine negative Verstärkung (−R_f / R_in): Eine positive Verstärkung ist mit dieser Schaltung nicht möglich."}}
  formula: ["av = -rf / rin", "vout = av * vin"]
  schematic: opamp_inverting

- id: opamp_noninverting
  kind: calculator
  category: opamps
  name: {cs: "Neinvertující zesilovač", da: "Ikke-inverterende forstærker", de: "Nichtinvertierender Verstärker", el: "Μη αναστρέφων ενισχυτής", en: "Non-inverting amplifier", es: "Amplificador no inversor", fr: "Amplificateur non inverseur", hi: "नॉन-इन्वर्टिंग एम्पलीफायर", it: "Amplificatore non invertente", ja: "非反転増幅回路", nl: "Niet-inverterende versterker", no: "Ikke-inverterende forsterker", pl: "Wzmacniacz nieodwracający", pt: "Amplificador não inversor", sv: "Icke-inverterande förstärkare", zh: "同相放大器"}
  doc:
    en: "The non-inverting op-amp amplifier: the signal drives the non-inverting input, and the divider R_f / R_g in the feedback path sets the gain G = 1 + R_f / R_g, which is always 1 or more (V_out = G × V_in, same sign as the input). The input resistance is that of the op-amp input and very high. Example with the defaults: R_f = 10 kΩ and R_g = 1 kΩ give a gain of 11 (20.8 dB), so 0.1 V in gives 1.1 V out. For a gain of exactly 1 leave out R_g and replace R_f by a wire (voltage follower)."
    de: "Der nichtinvertierende Operationsverstärker: Das Signal liegt am nichtinvertierenden Eingang, der Teiler R_f / R_g im Rückkopplungszweig legt die Verstärkung G = 1 + R_f / R_g fest, die immer mindestens 1 beträgt (V_out = G · V_in, gleiches Vorzeichen wie der Eingang). Der Eingangswiderstand ist der des Operationsverstärkereingangs und sehr hoch. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: R_f = 10 kΩ und R_g = 1 kΩ ergeben die Verstärkung 11 (20,8 dB); 0,1 V am Eingang ergeben 1,1 V am Ausgang. Für genau die Verstärkung 1 R_g weglassen und R_f durch eine Drahtbrücke ersetzen (Spannungsfolger)."
  tags: [opamp, op-amp, operational amplifier, non-inverting, noninverting, amplifier, gain, voltage follower, operationsverstärker, nichtinvertierend, verstärkung, spannungsfolger, rückkopplung]
  source: "Non-inverting amplifier with an ideal op-amp: G = 1 + R_f / R_g; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 4"
  vars:
    rf: {dim: resistance, label: R_f, name: {en: "Feedback resistor", de: "Rückkopplungswiderstand"}, default: "10k", eseries: true}
    rg: {dim: resistance, label: R_g, name: {en: "Resistor to ground", de: "Widerstand nach Masse"}, default: "1k", eseries: true}
    g: {dim: number, label: G, name: {en: "Voltage gain", de: "Spannungsverstärkung"}}
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "Input voltage", de: "Eingangsspannung"}, default: "0.1 V"}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    g: ["1+rf/rg", "vout/vin"]
    rf: ["(g-1)*rg"]
    rg: ["rf/(g-1)"]
    vout: ["g*vin"]
    vin: ["vout/g"]
  derived:
    ifb: {dim: current, label: I_fb, name: {en: "Current through the feedback divider", de: "Strom durch den Rückkopplungsteiler"}, expr: ["vin/rg", "vout/(rf+rg)"]}
    adb: {dim: gain, label: G_dB, name: {en: "Gain in dB", de: "Verstärkung in dB"}, expr: "20*log10(g)"}
  checks:
    - {when: "g <= 1", warn: {en: "The gain must be above 1: a non-inverting amplifier cannot attenuate. For a gain of exactly 1 use a voltage follower (no R_g, R_f replaced by a wire).", de: "Die Verstärkung muss über 1 liegen: Ein nichtinvertierender Verstärker kann nicht abschwächen. Für genau die Verstärkung 1 einen Spannungsfolger verwenden (kein R_g, R_f durch eine Drahtbrücke ersetzt)."}}
  formula: ["g = 1 + rf / rg", "vout = g * vin"]
  schematic: opamp_noninverting

- id: opamp_difference
  kind: calculator
  category: opamps
  name: {cs: "Rozdílový zesilovač", da: "Differensforstærker", de: "Differenzverstärker", el: "Διαφορικός ενισχυτής", en: "Difference amplifier", es: "Amplificador diferencial", fr: "Amplificateur différentiel", hi: "डिफरेंस एम्पलीफायर", it: "Amplificatore differenziale", ja: "差動増幅回路", nl: "Verschilversterker", no: "Differanseforsterker", pl: "Wzmacniacz różnicowy", pt: "Amplificador diferencial", sv: "Differensförstärkare", zh: "差分放大器"}
  doc:
    en: "The classic op-amp difference amplifier with four resistors, R_3 = R_1 and R_4 = R_2: the signal V_1 reaches the inverting input through R_1, the signal V_2 reaches the non-inverting input through R_3 (which forms a divider with R_4 to ground), and R_2 is the feedback resistor. The output is V_out = (R_2 / R_1) × (V_2 − V_1): only the difference is amplified and a common-mode voltage is rejected, but only as well as the resistor ratios R_2 / R_1 and R_4 / R_3 match. The differential input resistance is 2 × R_1. Example with the defaults: R_1 = 10 kΩ and R_2 = 100 kΩ give a gain of 10, so V_2 − V_1 = 0.2 V gives 2 V out."
    de: "Der klassische Differenzverstärker mit vier Widerständen, R_3 = R_1 und R_4 = R_2: Das Signal V_1 gelangt über R_1 an den invertierenden Eingang, das Signal V_2 über R_3 an den nichtinvertierenden Eingang (der mit R_4 nach Masse einen Teiler bildet), R_2 ist der Rückkopplungswiderstand. Die Ausgangsspannung ist V_out = (R_2 / R_1) · (V_2 − V_1): Nur die Differenz wird verstärkt und Gleichtaktspannung wird unterdrückt, allerdings nur so gut, wie die Widerstandsverhältnisse R_2 / R_1 und R_4 / R_3 übereinstimmen. Der differenzielle Eingangswiderstand beträgt 2 · R_1. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: R_1 = 10 kΩ und R_2 = 100 kΩ ergeben die Verstärkung 10; V_2 − V_1 = 0,2 V ergibt 2 V am Ausgang."
  tags: [opamp, op-amp, difference amplifier, differential amplifier, subtractor, common mode, cmrr, differenzverstärker, subtrahierer, gleichtaktunterdrückung, operationsverstärker]
  source: "Difference amplifier with R_3 = R_1 and R_4 = R_2 (ideal op-amp): V_out = (R_2 / R_1) × (V_2 − V_1); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 4; A. S. Sedra, K. C. Smith: Microelectronic Circuits (operational amplifiers)"
  vars:
    r1: {dim: resistance, label: R_1, name: {en: "Input resistors R_1 = R_3", de: "Eingangswiderstände R_1 = R_3"}, default: "10k", eseries: true}
    r2: {dim: resistance, label: R_2, name: {en: "Feedback resistors R_2 = R_4", de: "Rückkopplungswiderstände R_2 = R_4"}, default: "100k", eseries: true}
    g: {dim: number, label: G, name: {en: "Differential gain R_2 / R_1", de: "Differenzverstärkung R_2 / R_1"}}
    v1: {dim: voltage, label: V_1, name: {en: "Inverting-side input voltage", de: "Eingangsspannung invertierende Seite"}, default: "1 V"}
    v2: {dim: voltage, label: V_2, name: {en: "Non-inverting-side input voltage", de: "Eingangsspannung nichtinvertierende Seite"}, default: "1.2 V"}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}}
  dof: 4
  rules:
    g: ["r2/r1", "vout/(v2-v1)"]
    r2: ["g*r1"]
    r1: ["r2/g"]
    vout: ["g*(v2-v1)"]
    v2: ["v1+vout/g"]
    v1: ["v2-vout/g"]
  derived:
    vdiff: {dim: voltage, label: V_d, name: {en: "Differential input voltage V_2 − V_1", de: "Differenzeingangsspannung V_2 − V_1"}, expr: ["v2-v1", "vout/g"]}
    vcm: {dim: voltage, label: V_cm, name: {en: "Common-mode input voltage", de: "Gleichtaktspannung am Eingang"}, expr: "(v1+v2)/2"}
    rid: {dim: resistance, label: R_id, name: {en: "Differential input resistance 2 × R_1", de: "Differenzieller Eingangswiderstand 2 · R_1"}, expr: "2*r1"}
  formula: ["g = r2 / r1", "vout = g * (v2 - v1)"]
  schematic: opamp_difference

- id: opamp_summing
  kind: calculator
  category: opamps
  name: {cs: "Sumační zesilovač", da: "Sumforstærker", de: "Summierverstärker", el: "Αθροιστικός ενισχυτής", en: "Summing amplifier", es: "Amplificador sumador", fr: "Amplificateur sommateur", hi: "समिंग एम्पलीफायर", it: "Amplificatore sommatore", ja: "加算回路", nl: "Sommeerversterker", no: "Summeforsterker", pl: "Wzmacniacz sumujący", pt: "Amplificador somador", sv: "Summerande förstärkare", zh: "加法放大器"}
  doc:
    en: "The inverting summing amplifier with equal input resistors R: every input V_k reaches the summing node through its own resistor R, the currents add, and the output is V_out = −(R_f / R) × (V_1 + V_2 + … + V_n). Every input has the same gain −R_f / R, and the inputs do not influence each other because the summing node is a virtual ground. With R_f = R / n the output is the inverted average of the n inputs. Enter the input voltages as a list, for example 1 V, 0.5 V, 0.25 V. Example with the defaults: inputs of 1 V, 0.5 V and 0.25 V with R = R_f = 10 kΩ give −1.75 V."
    de: "Der invertierende Summierverstärker mit gleichen Eingangswiderständen R: Jeder Eingang V_k gelangt über einen eigenen Widerstand R an den Summationspunkt, die Ströme addieren sich, und die Ausgangsspannung ist V_out = −(R_f / R) · (V_1 + V_2 + … + V_n). Jeder Eingang hat dieselbe Verstärkung −R_f / R, und die Eingänge beeinflussen sich nicht, weil der Summationspunkt eine virtuelle Masse ist. Mit R_f = R / n ist der Ausgang der invertierte Mittelwert der n Eingänge. Die Eingangsspannungen als Liste eingeben, zum Beispiel 1 V, 0,5 V, 0,25 V. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: Eingänge mit 1 V, 0,5 V und 0,25 V bei R = R_f = 10 kΩ ergeben −1,75 V."
  tags: [opamp, op-amp, summing amplifier, summer, adder, mixer, summing junction, summierverstärker, addierer, mischer, summationspunkt, operationsverstärker]
  source: "Inverting summing amplifier with an ideal op-amp: V_out = −R_f × Σ(V_k / R); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 4"
  vars:
    vs: {dim: voltage, label: V_k, name: {en: "Input voltages", de: "Eingangsspannungen"}, list: true, default: ["1 V", "0.5 V", "0.25 V"]}
    r: {dim: resistance, label: R, name: {en: "Input resistor (each)", de: "Eingangswiderstand (je Eingang)"}, default: "10k", eseries: true}
    rf: {dim: resistance, label: R_f, name: {en: "Feedback resistor", de: "Rückkopplungswiderstand"}, default: "10k", eseries: true}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    vout: ["-rf/r*sum(vs)"]
    rf: ["-vout*r/sum(vs)"]
    r: ["-rf*sum(vs)/vout"]
  derived:
    vsum: {dim: voltage, label: V_sum, name: {en: "Sum of the input voltages", de: "Summe der Eingangsspannungen"}, expr: "sum(vs)"}
    gi: {dim: number, label: G_k, name: {en: "Gain magnitude per input R_f / R", de: "Verstärkungsbetrag je Eingang R_f / R"}, expr: "rf/r"}
    ifb: {dim: current, label: I_fb, name: {en: "Current through the feedback resistor", de: "Strom durch den Rückkopplungswiderstand"}, expr: ["vsum/r", "-vout/rf"]}
  formula: ["vout = -rf / r * sum(vs)"]
  schematic: opamp_summing

- id: opamp_integrator
  kind: calculator
  category: opamps
  name: {cs: "Integrátor", da: "Integrator", de: "Integrierer", el: "Ολοκληρωτής", en: "Integrator", es: "Integrador", fr: "Intégrateur", hi: "इंटीग्रेटर", it: "Integratore", ja: "積分回路", nl: "Integrator", no: "Integrator", pl: "Integrator", pt: "Integrador", sv: "Integrator", zh: "积分器"}
  doc:
    en: "The ideal inverting integrator: a constant input V_in through R charges the feedback capacitor C with the current V_in / R, so the output ramps linearly, V_out = −V_in × t / (R × C), starting from zero at t = 0. For sine signals the gain falls as 1 / (2π f R C) and is 1 at the unity-gain frequency f = 1 / (2π R C). A real circuit needs a resistor in parallel with C or a reset switch, otherwise offset voltage and bias current drive the output into the supply rails. Example with the defaults: 1 V into R = 10 kΩ and C = 100 nF (R × C = 1 ms) gives −2 V after 2 ms."
    de: "Der ideale invertierende Integrierer: Eine konstante Eingangsspannung V_in lädt über R den Rückkopplungskondensator C mit dem Strom V_in / R, daher steigt der Ausgang linear an, V_out = −V_in · t / (R · C), ausgehend von null bei t = 0. Bei Sinussignalen fällt die Verstärkung mit 1 / (2π f R C) und ist bei der Transitfrequenz f = 1 / (2π R C) gleich 1. Eine reale Schaltung braucht einen Widerstand parallel zu C oder einen Rücksetzschalter, sonst treiben Offsetspannung und Eingangsruhestrom den Ausgang an die Versorgungsgrenzen. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: 1 V an R = 10 kΩ und C = 100 nF (R · C = 1 ms) ergeben nach 2 ms −2 V."
  tags: [opamp, op-amp, integrator, ramp, integrating amplifier, capacitor, unity gain frequency, integrierer, integrator, rampe, operationsverstärker, transitfrequenz]
  source: "Ideal inverting integrator: V_out = −(1 / RC) ∫ V_in dt; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 4"
  vars:
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "Input voltage (constant)", de: "Eingangsspannung (konstant)"}, default: "1 V"}
    r: {dim: resistance, label: R, name: {en: "Input resistor", de: "Eingangswiderstand"}, default: "10k", eseries: true}
    c: {dim: capacitance, label: C, name: {en: "Feedback capacitor", de: "Rückkopplungskondensator"}, default: "100 nF"}
    t: {dim: time, label: t, name: {en: "Time since the start", de: "Zeit seit dem Start"}, default: "2 ms", units: [""]}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}}
  dof: 4
  rules:
    vout: ["-vin*t/(r*c)"]
    vin: ["-vout*r*c/t"]
    r: ["-vin*t/(vout*c)"]
    c: ["-vin*t/(vout*r)"]
    t: ["-vout*r*c/vin"]
  derived:
    tau: {dim: time, label: τ, name: {en: "Time constant R × C", de: "Zeitkonstante R · C"}, expr: "r*c", units: [""]}
    fu: {dim: frequency, label: f_u, name: {en: "Unity-gain frequency 1 / (2π R C)", de: "Transitfrequenz 1 / (2π R C)"}, expr: "1/(2*pi*r*c)"}
    iin: {dim: current, label: I_in, name: {en: "Charging current V_in / R", de: "Ladestrom V_in / R"}, expr: ["vin/r", "-vout*c/t"]}
  checks:
    - {when: "abs(vout) > 15", warn: {en: "|V_out| is above 15 V: a real op-amp saturates at its supply rails long before this time.", de: "|V_out| liegt über 15 V: Ein realer Operationsverstärker läuft lange vorher an seinen Versorgungsgrenzen in die Begrenzung."}}
  formula: ["vout = -vin * t / (r * c)", "fu = 1 / (2 * pi * r * c)"]
  schematic: opamp_integrator

- id: schmitt_trigger
  kind: calculator
  category: opamps
  name: {cs: "Schmittův klopný obvod", da: "Schmitt-trigger", de: "Schmitt-Trigger", el: "Σκανδαλιστής Schmitt", en: "Schmitt trigger", es: "Disparador Schmitt", fr: "Trigger de Schmitt", hi: "श्मिट ट्रिगर", it: "Trigger di Schmitt", ja: "シュミットトリガ回路", nl: "Schmitt-trigger", no: "Schmitt-trigger", pl: "Przerzutnik Schmitta", pt: "Disparador de Schmitt", sv: "Schmitt-trigger", zh: "施密特触发器"}
  doc:
    en: "Inverting Schmitt trigger with a reference: the input signal drives the inverting input, the non-inverting input sits between the reference V_ref (through R_1) and the output (through R_2, positive feedback). The output is at V_OH or V_OL, its saturation levels close to the supply rails (read them from the datasheet or measure them). The threshold at the non-inverting input is V_TH = V_ref + (V_OH − V_ref) × k with the output high and V_TL = V_ref + (V_OL − V_ref) × k with the output low, where k = R_1 / (R_1 + R_2). The output switches low when the input rises above V_TH and high when it falls below V_TL; the hysteresis is V_TH − V_TL = k × (V_OH − V_OL). For a design enter the four voltages and R_1 (or R_2) to get the other resistor and V_ref. Example with the defaults: a 5 V supply (V_OH = 5 V, V_OL = 0 V), V_ref = 2.5 V, R_1 = 10 kΩ and R_2 = 100 kΩ give V_TH ≈ 2.73 V, V_TL ≈ 2.27 V and a hysteresis of about 0.45 V."
    de: "Invertierender Schmitt-Trigger mit Referenz: Das Eingangssignal liegt am invertierenden Eingang, der nichtinvertierende Eingang hängt zwischen der Referenz V_ref (über R_1) und dem Ausgang (über R_2, Mitkopplung). Der Ausgang steht auf V_OH oder V_OL, seinen Sättigungspegeln nahe den Versorgungsspannungen (dem Datenblatt entnehmen oder messen). Die Schwelle am nichtinvertierenden Eingang ist V_TH = V_ref + (V_OH − V_ref) · k bei hohem Ausgang und V_TL = V_ref + (V_OL − V_ref) · k bei niedrigem Ausgang mit k = R_1 / (R_1 + R_2). Der Ausgang kippt nach niedrig, wenn der Eingang über V_TH steigt, und nach hoch, wenn er unter V_TL fällt; die Hysterese ist V_TH − V_TL = k · (V_OH − V_OL). Für einen Entwurf die vier Spannungen und R_1 (oder R_2) eingeben, um den anderen Widerstand und V_ref zu erhalten. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: 5 V Versorgung (V_OH = 5 V, V_OL = 0 V), V_ref = 2,5 V, R_1 = 10 kΩ und R_2 = 100 kΩ ergeben V_TH ≈ 2,73 V, V_TL ≈ 2,27 V und eine Hysterese von etwa 0,45 V."
  tags: [schmitt trigger, schmitt, hysteresis, comparator, threshold, opamp, op-amp, positive feedback, schmitt-trigger, hysterese, komparator, schwelle, mitkopplung, operationsverstärker]
  source: "Inverting Schmitt trigger with positive feedback through R_2 and a reference at R_1: V_TH, V_TL = V_ref + (V_O − V_ref) × R_1 / (R_1 + R_2); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 4; A. S. Sedra, K. C. Smith: Microelectronic Circuits (bistable circuits)"
  vars:
    vref: {dim: voltage, label: V_ref, name: {en: "Reference voltage", de: "Referenzspannung"}, default: "2.5 V"}
    voh: {dim: voltage, label: V_OH, name: {en: "Output high level", de: "Ausgangspegel high"}, default: "5 V"}
    vol: {dim: voltage, label: V_OL, name: {en: "Output low level", de: "Ausgangspegel low"}, default: "0 V"}
    r1: {dim: resistance, label: R_1, name: {en: "Reference resistor", de: "Referenzwiderstand"}, default: "10k", eseries: true}
    r2: {dim: resistance, label: R_2, name: {en: "Feedback resistor", de: "Rückkopplungswiderstand"}, default: "100k", eseries: true}
    vth: {dim: voltage, label: V_TH, name: {en: "Upper threshold", de: "Obere Schwelle"}}
    vtl: {dim: voltage, label: V_TL, name: {en: "Lower threshold", de: "Untere Schwelle"}}
  dof: 5
  rules:
    vth: ["vref+(voh-vref)*k"]
    vtl: ["vref+(vol-vref)*k"]
    r2: ["r1*(1-k)/k"]
    r1: ["r2*k/(1-k)"]
    vref: ["(vth-voh*k)/(1-k)", "(vtl-vol*k)/(1-k)"]
    voh: ["vref+(vth-vref)/k"]
    vol: ["vref+(vtl-vref)/k"]
  derived:
    k: {dim: ratio, label: k, name: {en: "Feedback fraction R_1 / (R_1 + R_2)", de: "Rückkopplungsanteil R_1 / (R_1 + R_2)"}, expr: ["r1/(r1+r2)", "(vth-vtl)/(voh-vol)", "(vth-vref)/(voh-vref)", "(vtl-vref)/(vol-vref)"], unit: pct, units: [pct, ""]}
    vh: {dim: voltage, label: V_H, name: {en: "Hysteresis V_TH − V_TL", de: "Hysterese V_TH − V_TL"}, expr: ["vth-vtl", "k*(voh-vol)"]}
    vc: {dim: voltage, label: V_C, name: {en: "Centre of the thresholds", de: "Mitte der Schwellen"}, expr: "(vth+vtl)/2"}
  checks:
    - {when: "voh <= vol", warn: {en: "V_OH must be above V_OL.", de: "V_OH muss über V_OL liegen."}}
  formula: ["k = r1 / (r1 + r2)", "vth = vref + (voh - vref) * k", "vtl = vref + (vol - vref) * k"]
  schematic: schmitt_trigger

- id: instrumentation_amp
  kind: calculator
  category: opamps
  name: {cs: "Přístrojový zesilovač", da: "Instrumenteringsforstærker", de: "Instrumentenverstärker", el: "Ενισχυτής οργανολογίας", en: "Instrumentation amplifier", es: "Amplificador de instrumentación", fr: "Amplificateur d'instrumentation", hi: "इंस्ट्रूमेंटेशन एम्पलीफायर", it: "Amplificatore da strumentazione", ja: "計装アンプ", nl: "Instrumentatieversterker", no: "Instrumentasjonsforsterker", pl: "Wzmacniacz instrumentalny", pt: "Amplificador de instrumentação", sv: "Instrumentationsförstärkare", zh: "仪表放大器"}
  doc:
    en: "The classic instrumentation amplifier in the three-op-amp topology: two input buffer stages share one gain resistor R_G between their inverting inputs, and a unity-gain difference amplifier (four equal resistors) forms the output stage. The differential gain is G = 1 + 2R / R_G, where R is each of the two feedback resistors of the input stage (integrated types state the sum: G = 1 + 50 kΩ / R_G for the Texas Instruments INA128, G = 1 + 49.4 kΩ / R_G for the Analog Devices AD620). Only the differential input V_diff = V+ − V− is amplified by G; a common-mode voltage passes the input stage with a gain of 1 and is rejected by the output stage. Without R_G the gain is 1. Example with the defaults: R = 25 kΩ and R_G = 500 Ω give G = 101 (40.1 dB), so 10 mV differential input gives 1.01 V."
    de: "Der klassische Instrumentenverstärker in der Drei-Operationsverstärker-Schaltung: Zwei Eingangspufferstufen teilen sich einen Verstärkungswiderstand R_G zwischen ihren invertierenden Eingängen, ein Differenzverstärker mit der Verstärkung 1 (vier gleiche Widerstände) bildet die Ausgangsstufe. Die Differenzverstärkung ist G = 1 + 2R / R_G, wobei R jeder der beiden Rückkopplungswiderstände der Eingangsstufe ist (integrierte Typen geben die Summe an: G = 1 + 50 kΩ / R_G beim INA128 von Texas Instruments, G = 1 + 49,4 kΩ / R_G beim AD620 von Analog Devices). Nur die Differenzeingangsspannung V_diff = V+ − V− wird mit G verstärkt; eine Gleichtaktspannung passiert die Eingangsstufe mit der Verstärkung 1 und wird von der Ausgangsstufe unterdrückt. Ohne R_G ist die Verstärkung 1. Beispiel mit den Vorgaben: R = 25 kΩ und R_G = 500 Ω ergeben G = 101 (40,1 dB); 10 mV Differenzeingang ergeben 1,01 V."
  tags: [instrumentation amplifier, ina, in-amp, three op-amp, differential amplifier, sensor, bridge amplifier, gain resistor, ina128, ad620, instrumentenverstärker, messverstärker, differenzverstärker, verstärkungswiderstand, brückenverstärker]
  source: "Three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier, G = 1 + 2R / R_G (ideal op-amps, equal output-stage resistors); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed. (instrumentation amplifiers); gain equations of the INA128 (Texas Instruments) and AD620 (Analog Devices) data sheets"
  vars:
    r: {dim: resistance, label: R, name: {en: "Input-stage feedback resistor (each)", de: "Rückkopplungswiderstand der Eingangsstufe (je)"}, default: "25k", eseries: true}
    rg: {dim: resistance, label: R_G, name: {en: "Gain resistor", de: "Verstärkungswiderstand"}, default: "500", eseries: true}
    g: {dim: number, label: G, name: {en: "Differential gain", de: "Differenzverstärkung"}}
    vdiff: {dim: voltage, label: V_diff, name: {en: "Differential input voltage", de: "Differenzeingangsspannung"}, default: "10 mV"}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    g: ["1+2*r/rg", "vout/vdiff"]
    r: ["(g-1)*rg/2"]
    rg: ["2*r/(g-1)"]
    vout: ["g*vdiff"]
    vdiff: ["vout/g"]
  derived:
    adb: {dim: gain, label: G_dB, name: {en: "Gain in dB", de: "Verstärkung in dB"}, expr: "20*log10(g)"}
    rsum: {dim: resistance, label: 2R, name: {en: "Sum of the two feedback resistors 2R", de: "Summe der beiden Rückkopplungswiderstände 2R"}, expr: "2*r"}
  checks:
    - {when: "g <= 1", warn: {en: "The gain must be above 1: without R_G (open) the gain is exactly 1.", de: "Die Verstärkung muss über 1 liegen: Ohne R_G (offen) beträgt sie genau 1."}}
  formula: ["g = 1 + 2 * r / rg", "vout = g * vdiff"]
  schematic: instrumentation_amp
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the vector and round-trip tests and watch them pass**

```bash
go test ./internal/ecalc -run 'TestCalculatorVectors/(opamp_inverting|opamp_noninverting|opamp_difference|opamp_summing|opamp_integrator|schmitt_trigger|instrumentation_amp)$' -count=1 -v 2>&1 | grep -c -- '--- PASS: TestCalculatorVectors/'
go test ./internal/ecalc -run 'TestCalculatorVectors|TestRoundTripAllCalculators' -count=1
```

Expected: **`7`**, then **PASS** (`ok  aurago/internal/ecalc`). The round trip solves the defaults and every solvable input set of all 7 calculators.

- [ ] **Step 5: Write the schematics (the UI test is red first)**

```bash
go test ./ui -run "ECalcSchematic" -count=1
```

Expected: **FAIL**, one line per calculator: `the catalog names the schematic "<id>" but the ecalc-schematics-*.js files have no entry for it`.

Replace `ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-schematics-opamps.js` with exactly this content (keep the wrapper line; the object is strict JSON):

```js
window.ECalcSchematics = Object.assign(window.ECalcSchematics || {}, {
 "opamp_inverting": {
  "w": 30, "h": 14,
  "parts": [
   {"sym": "resistor", "x": 11, "y": 7},
   {"sym": "resistor", "x": 17, "y": 4},
   {"sym": "opamp", "x": 17, "y": 8},
   {"sym": "ground", "x": 15, "y": 9}
  ],
  "wires": [[[8, 7], [11, 7]], [[14, 7], [17, 7]], [[16, 7], [16, 4], [17, 4]], [[20, 4], [24, 4], [24, 8]], [[22, 8], [27, 8]], [[15, 9], [17, 9]]],
  "dots": [[16, 7], [24, 8]],
  "terminals": [[8, 7], [27, 8]],
```
