## Part C4 — Power supply and wiring calculators (tasks C4.1 and C4.2)


**Goal:** Add the 14 calculators of the categories **power** (10) and **wiring** (4) to the ECalc catalog: the YAML items with names in all 16 locales, hand-checked vector files, and the six schematics of the circuit calculators.

**Architecture:** One declarative YAML file per category (`power.yaml`, `wiring.yaml`) in `internal/ecalc/catalog/calculators/`, one vector file per calculator in `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/` (shared by the Go harness `TestCalculatorVectors` / `TestRoundTripAllCalculators` and the JavaScript parity test), and the drawings in `ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-schematics-power.js`. No Go or JavaScript engine code changes.

**Depends on:** Part A (engine: `floor`, the dimensions `capacitance` … `integer`, `units`, `ignore`, AWG/oz/mil units) and Part U (the ten `ecalc-schematics-<category>.js` files, the `switch` symbol, the page). Both must be applied before this part.

---

### How this part was made and verified

Every file below was built and run in the scratch worktree `wc4` (parts A and U applied, nothing committed) and the code blocks were generated from those files by a script, not retyped. The vector values were computed by an independent Python script (`decimal` with 60 digits and `fractions`; it implements each formula separately and never calls the Go solver); the Go engine then reproduced every expected value to 1e-9 (the only first-run failures were three cable solve vectors that gave too few inputs, not disagreeing values; they were fixed in the vectors). Verification commands and results are at the end of this part.

Files this part owns: `power.yaml`, `wiring.yaml`, 14 vector files, `ecalc-schematics-power.js`. `ecalc-schematics-wiring.js` stays the empty wrapper Part U creates (deviation 1). `internal/ecalc/testdata/catalog.en.json` is generated: never hand-edit it, regenerate it (the controller regenerates it once more when all parts are assembled).

No existing function or symbol is modified (new files and the empty wrapper only), so there is no GitNexus impact analysis to record for this part.

### Contract deviations

1. **Wiring has no schematics.** `ipc2221_trace_width`, `trace_resistance`, `via_current` and `awg_conversion` are formulas on geometry, not circuits, so `schematic` is empty for all four and `ecalc-schematics-wiring.js` is not edited. The same holds for the pure arithmetic items `battery_runtime`, `battery_charge_time`, `battery_pack` and for `cable_voltage_drop` (a wire-sizing formula, not a circuit). The six power items that are circuits have a drawing: `lm317_voltage`, `lm317_current`, `linear_regulator_loss`, `buck_converter`, `boost_converter`, `smoothing_capacitor`.
2. **The "expected FAIL" of the vector step is a count, not a red test.** `TestCalculatorVectors` iterates over the calculators of the catalog, so vector files without a calculator pass vacuously (the phase 1 plan notes the same). Step 2 of each task therefore counts the passing subtests of the new calculators (expected `0`) and Step 4 counts them again (expected `10` and `4`). The schematic step has a real red-green pair (`TestECalcSchematicsMatchTheCatalog`).
3. **`cable_voltage_drop` computes with resistivity and a conductor temperature, not with a table conductivity κ.** The contract asks for κ per DIN VDE 0100-520. The values of that table were not available to the drafter with the certainty the content rules require, so the item uses the material constants of the conductor standards instead: copper ρ₂₀ = 1/58 Ω·mm²/m with α = 0.00393 /K (IEC 60028), hard-drawn aluminium ρ₂₀ = 0.028264 Ω·mm²/m with α = 0.00403 /K (both IEC 60889; a conductivity of 61 % of the copper standard), at a conductor temperature `theta` (default 70 °C, so ρ and the drop are about 20 % above the 20 °C value). κ is simply 1/ρ. Consequences: one more input than the contract lists (`theta`, `dof` 6, so `U_n` is always an input as well), a derived `ρ_θ` and the conductor power loss. The cable reactance is neglected (stated in the doc). `source` cites IEC 60364-5-52 / DIN VDE 0100-520 only for the voltage-drop formula in general, without clause or table numbers.
4. **Buck and boost cannot solve their own output/input voltage from the ripple.** The ripple formula is symmetric (two voltages give the same ΔI_L), so only one direction is unique: the buck solves `V_in` (V_out is always an input), the boost solves `V_out` (V_in is always an input). `I_out` has no rule at all and is always an input. The docs say so.
5. **`battery_pack` solves in both directions through alternatives.** `U_pack` and `Q_pack` have two alternatives each (`N × cell` and `E / the other`), so any four consistent values of the seven give the rest; two checks flag non-integer cell counts (`floor`).
6. **`lm317_voltage` has no `vin` anchor** because the calculator has no `V_in` variable (a drawing may only anchor variables of its calculator); the source is drawn unlabelled. The drawings are at most 32 grid units wide (Part U limit 33).
7. **Two tests of Part A pin the number of catalog items** and fail as soon as any content part adds calculators: `TestPhaseOneCalculators` in `internal/ecalc/basics_test.go` (`catalog has 26 calculators, want 12` in the drafting worktree) and `TestLocalizedJSONLanguagesAndFallback` in `internal/ecalc/localize_test.go` (`len(en.Items) != 12`). They are outside this part's file ownership; the controller must relax them (for example to "the first 12 items are the basics, in this order" and a minimum item count) when the parts are assembled. This part runs only the named tests that do not depend on the count.
8. **Uncertain constants are flagged in the item docs and in the report, not hidden:** the validity range of the IPC-2221 curves (about 10 °C to 100 °C rise, up to about 35 A) is quoted from memory of the standard's charts and only used for two "extrapolation" warnings; the aluminium pair ρ₂₀ = 0.028264 Ω·mm²/m and α = 0.00403 /K is cited to IEC 60889 (controller check 2026-11-02: the HD 532 S1 text of IEC 60889:1987 and GB/T 17048-2017 give 0.028264 Ω·mm²/m maximum resistivity at 20 °C and a constant-mass temperature coefficient of 0.004 03 /°C) (the resistivity is consistent with 61 % IACS, 0.017241 / 0.61), and the same pair is used by C1's `wire_resistance`.

### Execution order

C4.1 (power) then C4.2 (wiring); the tasks are independent of each other and only share the generated snapshot. Run every command from the repository root with `GOTMPDIR` set to a short backslash path on Windows (for example `C:\tmp\go-build-ecalc`).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the vector files**

Every set is a consistent full solution (all variables and derived quantities, for every option of every choice at least two); every rule alternative and every solvable input set must reproduce it. Every set and solve vector carries a `ref`. The numbers were computed with exact arithmetic, a definition or a published constant, never with the Go solver.

Create `internal/ecalc/testdata/vectors/calculators/lm317_voltage.json` with exactly this content:

```json
{
  "calc": "lm317_voltage",
  "sets": [
    {"values": {"vref": 1.25, "iadj": 5e-05, "r1": 240, "r2": 720, "vout": 5.036, "i1": 0.005208333333333333}, "ref": "hand: V_out = 1.25 * (1 + 720/240) + 50e-6 * 720 = 1.25 * 4 + 0.036 = 5.036 V; I_1 = 1.25 / 240 = 5.2083 mA"},
    {"values": {"vref": 1.25, "iadj": 5e-05, "r1": 240, "r2": 2400, "vout": 13.87, "i1": 0.005208333333333333}, "ref": "hand: V_out = 1.25 * (1 + 2400/240) + 50e-6 * 2400 = 1.25 * 11 + 0.12 = 13.87 V; I_1 = 1.25 / 240 = 5.2083 mA"},
    {"values": {"vref": 1.2, "iadj": 0.0001, "r1": 120, "r2": 360, "vout": 4.836, "i1": 0.01}, "ref": "hand: datasheet extremes V_ref = 1.2 V and I_adj = 100 uA: V_out = 1.2 * (1 + 360/120) + 100e-6 * 360 = 4.8 + 0.036 = 4.836 V; I_1 = 1.2 / 120 = 10 mA"}
  ],
  "solve": [
    {"inputs": {"vref": 1.25, "iadj": 5e-05, "r1": 240, "r2": 720}, "expect": {"vout": 5.036, "i1": 0.005208333333333333}, "ref": "hand: the defaults, V_out = 1.25 * 4 + 0.036 = 5.036 V; I_1 = 1.25 / 240 A"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 1.25, "iadj": 5e-05, "r1": 240, "vout": 5}, "expect": {"r2": 713.1537242472266}, "ref": "hand (independent script): R_2 = (V_out - V_ref) / (V_ref / R_1 + I_adj) = 3.75 / (1.25/240 + 50e-6) = 3.75 / 0.00525833333 = 713.1537242 ohm"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 1.25, "iadj": 5e-05, "r2": 720, "vout": 5.036}, "expect": {"r1": 240}, "ref": "hand: R_1 = V_ref * R_2 / (V_out - V_ref - I_adj * R_2) = 1.25 * 720 / (5.036 - 1.25 - 0.036) = 900 / 3.75 = 240 ohm"},
    {"inputs": {"iadj": 5e-05, "r1": 240, "r2": 720, "vout": 5.036}, "expect": {"vref": 1.25}, "ref": "hand: V_ref = (V_out - I_adj * R_2) / (1 + R_2 / R_1) = (5.036 - 0.036) / 4 = 1.25 V"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 1.25, "r1": 240, "r2": 720, "vout": 5.036}, "expect": {"iadj": 5e-05}, "ref": "hand: I_adj = (V_out - V_ref * (1 + R_2 / R_1)) / R_2 = (5.036 - 5) / 720 = 50 uA"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 1.25, "iadj": 5e-05, "r1": 240, "vout": 1}, "errors": {"r2": "range"}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: V_out = 1 V is below V_ref, so R_2 = (1 - 1.25) / (1.25/240 + 50e-6) = -47.5 ohm is out of range; the V_out < V_ref check fires"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 1.25, "iadj": 5e-05, "r1": 240}, "errors": {"r2": "undetermined", "vout": "undetermined"}, "ref": "neither R_2 nor V_out is known"}
  ]
}
```

    {"inputs": {"ns": 10, "qpack": 43200, "vcell": 3.6, "qcell": 10800}, "expect": {"np": 4, "vpack": 36, "e": 1555200}, "ref": "hand: N_p = Q_pack / Q_cell = 43200 / 10800 = 4; U_pack = 10 * 3.6 = 36 V"},
    {"inputs": {"ns": 4, "vpack": 12.8, "np": 1, "qcell": 72000}, "expect": {"vcell": 3.2, "qpack": 72000, "e": 921600}, "ref": "hand: U_cell = U_pack / N_s = 12.8 / 4 = 3.2 V; Q_pack = 72000 C; E = 12.8 * 72000 = 921600 J"},
    {"inputs": {"ns": 4, "vcell": 3.2, "np": 1, "e": 921600}, "expect": {"vpack": 12.8, "qpack": 72000, "qcell": 72000}, "ref": "hand: U_pack = 4 * 3.2 = 12.8 V; Q_pack = E / U_pack = 921600 / 12.8 = 72000 C; Q_cell = 72000 / 1 = 72000 C"},
    {"inputs": {"ns": 3.5, "np": 2, "vcell": 3.7, "qcell": 9000}, "expect": {"vpack": 12.95}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: 3.5 cells in series is no real pack, U_pack = 3.5 * 3.7 = 12.95 V; the first check fires"},
    {"inputs": {"ns": 3, "np": 2.5, "vcell": 3.7, "qcell": 9000}, "expect": {"qpack": 22500}, "warnings": [1], "ref": "hand: 2.5 strings in parallel is no real pack, Q_pack = 2.5 * 9000 = 22500 C; the second check fires"}
  ]
}

Create `internal/ecalc/catalog/calculators/power.yaml` with exactly this content:

```yaml
# Power supply calculators. Every name is written in all 16 desktop locales; docs, variable names and warnings in
# English and German (other languages fall back to English). Rules are written out for every direction, in the order the
# solver tries them: the first alternative whose variables are all known wins.

- id: lm317_voltage
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "LM317 – výstupní napětí", da: "LM317 – udgangsspænding", de: "LM317 Ausgangsspannung", el: "LM317 – τάση εξόδου", en: "LM317 output voltage", es: "LM317: tensión de salida", fr: "LM317 : tension de sortie", hi: "LM317 आउटपुट वोल्टेज", it: "LM317: tensione di uscita", ja: "LM317 出力電圧", nl: "LM317-uitgangsspanning", no: "LM317 utgangsspenning", pl: "LM317 – napięcie wyjściowe", pt: "LM317: tensão de saída", sv: "LM317 utspänning", zh: "LM317 输出电压"}
  doc:
    en: "The adjustable regulator LM317 holds its reference voltage V_ref (about 1.25 V) between the OUT and ADJ pins. R_1 from OUT to ADJ and R_2 from ADJ to ground set the output voltage: V_out = V_ref × (1 + R_2 / R_1) + I_adj × R_2. The adjustment-pin current I_adj (typically 50 µA) also flows through R_2. About 240 Ω is the usual value for R_1. V_ref and I_adj are typical datasheet values and vary from part to part (V_ref from 1.2 V to 1.3 V). The defaults R_1 = 240 Ω and R_2 = 720 Ω give 5.036 V. The input voltage must stay above V_out by at least the dropout voltage of the regulator."
    de: "Der einstellbare Spannungsregler LM317 hält seine Referenzspannung V_ref (etwa 1,25 V) zwischen den Anschlüssen OUT und ADJ. R_1 von OUT nach ADJ und R_2 von ADJ nach Masse legen die Ausgangsspannung fest: V_out = V_ref · (1 + R_2 / R_1) + I_adj · R_2. Der Strom des Einstellanschlusses I_adj (typisch 50 µA) fließt zusätzlich durch R_2. Für R_1 sind etwa 240 Ω üblich. V_ref und I_adj sind typische Datenblattwerte und streuen von Exemplar zu Exemplar (V_ref von 1,2 V bis 1,3 V). Mit den Vorgaben R_1 = 240 Ω und R_2 = 720 Ω ergeben sich 5,036 V. Die Eingangsspannung muss mindestens um die Dropout-Spannung des Reglers über V_out liegen."
  tags: [lm317, adjustable regulator, linear regulator, voltage regulator, output voltage, reference voltage, einstellbarer spannungsregler, spannungsregler, linearregler, ausgangsspannung, referenzspannung]
  source: "LM317 datasheets (Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics): V_OUT = V_REF × (1 + R2 / R1) + I_ADJ × R2 with the typical V_REF = 1.25 V and I_ADJ = 50 µA"
  vars:
    vref: {dim: voltage, label: V_ref, name: {en: "Reference voltage", de: "Referenzspannung"}, default: "1.25 V"}
    iadj: {dim: current, label: I_adj, name: {en: "Adjustment-pin current", de: "Strom des Einstellanschlusses"}, default: "50 µA"}
    r1: {dim: resistance, label: R_1, name: {en: "Resistor OUT to ADJ", de: "Widerstand OUT nach ADJ"}, default: "240", eseries: true}
    r2: {dim: resistance, label: R_2, name: {en: "Resistor ADJ to ground", de: "Widerstand ADJ nach Masse"}, default: "720", eseries: true}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}}
  dof: 4
  rules:
    vout: ["vref*(1+r2/r1)+iadj*r2"]
    r2: ["(vout-vref)/(vref/r1+iadj)"]
    r1: ["vref*r2/(vout-vref-iadj*r2)"]
    vref: ["(vout-iadj*r2)/(1+r2/r1)"]
    iadj: ["(vout-vref*(1+r2/r1))/r2"]
  derived:
    i1: {dim: current, label: I_1, name: {en: "Current through R1", de: "Strom durch R1"}, expr: "vref/r1"}
  checks:
    - {when: "vout < vref", warn: {en: "V_out is below the reference voltage: the LM317 cannot regulate lower than about 1.25 V.", de: "V_out liegt unter der Referenzspannung: Der LM317 kann nicht tiefer als etwa 1,25 V regeln."}}
  formula: ["vout = vref * (1 + r2 / r1) + iadj * r2"]
  schematic: lm317_voltage

- id: lm317_current
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "LM317 – zdroj konstantního proudu", da: "LM317 – konstantstrømkilde", de: "LM317 Konstantstromquelle", el: "LM317 – πηγή σταθερού ρεύματος", en: "LM317 constant-current source", es: "LM317: fuente de corriente constante", fr: "LM317 : source de courant constant", hi: "LM317 स्थिर धारा स्रोत", it: "LM317: generatore di corrente costante", ja: "LM317 定電流源", nl: "LM317-constantestroombron", no: "LM317 konstantstrømkilde", pl: "LM317 – źródło prądu stałego", pt: "LM317: fonte de corrente constante", sv: "LM317 konstantströmkälla", zh: "LM317 恒流源"}
  doc:
    en: "The LM317 as a constant-current source: the regulator keeps V_ref (about 1.25 V) across the resistor R between its OUT and ADJ pins, so R carries V_ref / R. The load sits between the ADJ pin and ground and also receives the adjustment-pin current I_adj (typically 50 µA): I = V_ref / R + I_adj. The resistor dissipates V_ref² / R. The default R = 10 Ω gives 125 mA with about 156 mW in the resistor. The input voltage must exceed the load voltage plus V_ref plus the dropout voltage of the regulator."
    de: "Der LM317 als Konstantstromquelle: Der Regler hält V_ref (etwa 1,25 V) am Widerstand R zwischen seinen Anschlüssen OUT und ADJ, R führt also V_ref / R. Die Last liegt zwischen dem ADJ-Anschluss und Masse und erhält zusätzlich den Strom des Einstellanschlusses I_adj (typisch 50 µA): I = V_ref / R + I_adj. Der Widerstand setzt V_ref² / R um. Mit dem Vorgabewert R = 10 Ω fließen 125 mA, im Widerstand werden etwa 156 mW umgesetzt. Die Eingangsspannung muss größer sein als Lastspannung plus V_ref plus Dropout-Spannung des Reglers."
  tags: [lm317, constant current, current source, current regulator, led driver, konstantstrom, konstantstromquelle, stromquelle, led treiber]
  source: "LM317 datasheets (Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics): constant-current connection with the resistor between OUT and ADJ, I = V_REF / R + I_ADJ (V_REF = 1.25 V and I_ADJ = 50 µA typical)"
  vars:
    vref: {dim: voltage, label: V_ref, name: {en: "Reference voltage", de: "Referenzspannung"}, default: "1.25 V"}
    iadj: {dim: current, label: I_adj, name: {en: "Adjustment-pin current", de: "Strom des Einstellanschlusses"}, default: "50 µA"}
    r: {dim: resistance, label: R, name: {en: "Current-setting resistor", de: "Stromeinstellender Widerstand"}, default: "10", eseries: true}
    i: {dim: current, label: I, name: {en: "Load current", de: "Laststrom"}}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    i: ["vref/r+iadj"]
    r: ["vref/(i-iadj)"]
    vref: ["(i-iadj)*r"]
    iadj: ["i-vref/r"]
  derived:
    pr: {dim: power, label: P_R, name: {en: "Resistor power", de: "Verlustleistung im Widerstand"}, expr: "vref^2/r"}
  checks:
    - {when: "i > 1.5", warn: {en: "The load current is above the rated output current of the LM317 (1.5 A).", de: "Der Laststrom liegt über dem Nennausgangsstrom des LM317 (1,5 A)."}}
    - {when: "i <= iadj", warn: {en: "The load current must be larger than the adjustment-pin current I_adj; no resistor can set it.", de: "Der Laststrom muss größer sein als der Strom des Einstellanschlusses I_adj; kein Widerstand kann ihn einstellen."}}
  formula: ["i = vref / r + iadj", "pr = vref^2 / r"]
  schematic: lm317_current

- id: linear_regulator_loss
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "Ztráty lineárního stabilizátoru", da: "Tab i lineær regulator", de: "Verlustleistung Linearregler", el: "Απώλειες γραμμικού ρυθμιστή", en: "Linear regulator power loss", es: "Pérdidas del regulador lineal", fr: "Pertes d'un régulateur linéaire", hi: "रैखिक रेगुलेटर की हानि", it: "Perdite del regolatore lineare", ja: "リニアレギュレータの損失", nl: "Verlies van een lineaire regelaar", no: "Tap i lineær regulator", pl: "Straty stabilizatora liniowego", pt: "Perdas do regulador linear", sv: "Förlusteffekt i linjär regulator", zh: "线性稳压器功耗"}
  doc:
    en: "A linear regulator turns the voltage difference between input and output into heat: P = (V_in − V_out) × I_out + V_in × I_q, where I_q is the quiescent current the regulator draws from the input in addition to the load current. The efficiency is η = V_out × I_out / (V_in × (I_out + I_q)). The defaults (12 V to 5 V at 500 mA with 5 mA quiescent current) dissipate 3.56 W at an efficiency of 41 %; this heat has to be removed with a heat sink, or the input voltage has to be lowered."
    de: "Ein Linearregler wandelt die Spannungsdifferenz zwischen Eingang und Ausgang in Wärme um: P = (V_in − V_out) · I_out + V_in · I_q; I_q ist der Ruhestrom, den der Regler zusätzlich zum Laststrom aus dem Eingang zieht. Der Wirkungsgrad ist η = V_out · I_out / (V_in · (I_out + I_q)). Die Vorgaben (12 V auf 5 V bei 500 mA und 5 mA Ruhestrom) erzeugen 3,56 W Verlustleistung bei 41 % Wirkungsgrad; diese Wärme muss über einen Kühlkörper abgeführt oder die Eingangsspannung gesenkt werden."
  tags: [linear regulator, ldo, 7805, dropout, dissipation, heat, efficiency, quiescent current, linearregler, spannungsregler, verlustleistung, wirkungsgrad, ruhestrom, wärme]
  source: "Power balance of a series (linear) regulator: P = (V_in − V_out) × I_out + V_in × I_q; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 9"
  vars:
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "Input voltage", de: "Eingangsspannung"}, default: "12 V"}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}, default: "5 V"}
    iout: {dim: current, label: I_out, name: {en: "Output current", de: "Ausgangsstrom"}, default: "500 mA"}
    iq: {dim: current, label: I_q, name: {en: "Quiescent current", de: "Ruhestrom"}, default: "5 mA"}
    p: {dim: power, label: P, name: {en: "Power dissipated in the regulator", de: "Verlustleistung im Regler"}}
  dof: 4
  rules:
    p: ["(vin-vout)*iout+vin*iq"]
    vin: ["(p+vout*iout)/(iout+iq)"]
    vout: ["(vin*(iout+iq)-p)/iout"]
    iout: ["(p-vin*iq)/(vin-vout)"]
    iq: ["(p-(vin-vout)*iout)/vin"]
  derived:
    pin: {dim: power, label: P_in, name: {en: "Input power", de: "Eingangsleistung"}, expr: "vin*(iout+iq)"}
    pout: {dim: power, label: P_out, name: {en: "Output power", de: "Ausgangsleistung"}, expr: "vout*iout"}
    eta: {dim: ratio, label: η, name: {en: "Efficiency", de: "Wirkungsgrad"}, expr: "vout*iout/(vin*(iout+iq))", unit: pct}
  checks:
    - {when: "vout >= vin", warn: {en: "V_out is not below V_in: a linear regulator needs an input voltage above the output voltage (plus its dropout voltage).", de: "V_out liegt nicht unter V_in: Ein Linearregler braucht eine Eingangsspannung über der Ausgangsspannung (plus Dropout-Spannung)."}}
  formula: ["p = (vin - vout) * iout + vin * iq", "eta = vout * iout / (vin * (iout + iq))"]
  schematic: linear_regulator_loss

- id: buck_converter
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "Snižující měnič (buck)", da: "Buck-konverter (step-down)", de: "Tiefsetzsteller (Buck)", el: "Μετατροπέας υποβιβασμού (buck)", en: "Buck converter (step-down)", es: "Convertidor reductor (buck)", fr: "Convertisseur abaisseur (buck)", hi: "बक कन्वर्टर (स्टेप-डाउन)", it: "Convertitore buck (step-down)", ja: "降圧コンバータ（バック）", nl: "Buck-omzetter (step-down)", no: "Buck-omformer (nedtrapping)", pl: "Przetwornica obniżająca (buck)", pt: "Conversor abaixador (buck)", sv: "Buck-omvandlare (nedtrappning)", zh: "降压变换器（Buck）"}
  doc:
    en: "An ideal step-down (buck) converter in continuous conduction: the duty cycle is D = V_out / V_in and the peak-to-peak inductor ripple current is ΔI_L = V_out × (V_in − V_out) / (V_in × f_sw × L). The inductor current swings between I_out − ΔI_L / 2 and I_out + ΔI_L / 2, so the inductor and the switch must handle the peak current I_pk = I_out + ΔI_L / 2. Assumptions: lossless components, constant input and output voltages, continuous conduction (the valley current stays above zero); I_out is the average output current. A ripple of 20 % to 40 % of I_out is a common design target. The defaults (12 V to 5 V, 1 A, 100 kHz, 100 µH) give D = 41.7 %, ΔI_L = 0.29 A and I_pk = 1.15 A. V_out and I_out are always inputs (V_out cannot be solved from the ripple current, because two output voltages give the same ripple)."
    de: "Ein idealer Tiefsetzsteller (Buck) im lückfreien Betrieb: Das Tastverhältnis ist D = V_out / V_in und der Spitze-Spitze-Rippelstrom der Spule ΔI_L = V_out · (V_in − V_out) / (V_in · f_sw · L). Der Spulenstrom pendelt zwischen I_out − ΔI_L / 2 und I_out + ΔI_L / 2; Spule und Schalter müssen daher den Spitzenstrom I_pk = I_out + ΔI_L / 2 verkraften. Annahmen: verlustfreie Bauteile, konstante Ein- und Ausgangsspannung, lückfreier Betrieb (der Talstrom bleibt über null); I_out ist der mittlere Ausgangsstrom. Ein Rippel von 20 % bis 40 % von I_out ist ein gängiges Auslegungsziel. Die Vorgaben (12 V auf 5 V, 1 A, 100 kHz, 100 µH) ergeben D = 41,7 %, ΔI_L = 0,29 A und I_pk = 1,15 A. V_out und I_out sind immer Eingaben (V_out lässt sich nicht aus dem Rippelstrom bestimmen, weil zwei Ausgangsspannungen denselben Rippel ergeben)."
  tags: [buck, step-down, dc-dc, switching regulator, inductor ripple, duty cycle, peak current, tiefsetzsteller, abwärtswandler, schaltregler, spule, rippelstrom, tastverhältnis, spitzenstrom]
  source: "Ideal continuous-conduction buck converter (D = V_out / V_in, ΔI_L = (V_in − V_out) × D / (f_sw × L)); R. W. Erickson, D. Maksimović: Fundamentals of Power Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 2; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 9"
  vars:
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "Input voltage", de: "Eingangsspannung"}, default: "12 V"}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}, default: "5 V"}
    iout: {dim: current, label: I_out, name: {en: "Output current", de: "Ausgangsstrom"}, default: "1 A"}
    f: {dim: frequency, label: f_sw, name: {en: "Switching frequency", de: "Schaltfrequenz"}, default: "100 kHz"}
    l: {dim: inductance, label: L, name: {en: "Inductance", de: "Induktivität"}, default: "100 µH"}
    dil: {dim: current, label: ΔI_L, name: {en: "Inductor ripple current (peak to peak)", de: "Spulen-Rippelstrom (Spitze-Spitze)"}}
  dof: 5
  rules:
    dil: ["vout*(vin-vout)/(vin*f*l)"]
    l: ["vout*(vin-vout)/(vin*f*dil)"]
    f: ["vout*(vin-vout)/(vin*l*dil)"]
    vin: ["vout^2/(vout-dil*f*l)"]
  derived:
    duty: {dim: ratio, label: D, name: {en: "Duty cycle", de: "Tastverhältnis"}, expr: "vout/vin", unit: pct}
    ipk: {dim: current, label: I_pk, name: {en: "Peak inductor current", de: "Spitzenstrom der Spule"}, expr: "iout+dil/2"}
    ival: {dim: current, label: I_valley, name: {en: "Valley inductor current", de: "Talstrom der Spule"}, expr: "iout-dil/2"}
  checks:
    - {when: "vout >= vin", warn: {en: "V_out is not below V_in: a buck converter can only step down.", de: "V_out liegt nicht unter V_in: Ein Tiefsetzsteller kann nur herunterwandeln."}}
    - {when: "dil > 2*iout", warn: {en: "The ripple current exceeds twice the output current: the inductor current falls to zero and the converter leaves continuous conduction, so these formulas no longer apply.", de: "Der Rippelstrom übersteigt den doppelten Ausgangsstrom: Der Spulenstrom fällt auf null, der Wandler verlässt den lückfreien Betrieb und diese Formeln gelten nicht mehr."}}
  formula: ["duty = vout / vin", "dil = vout * (vin - vout) / (vin * f * l)", "ipk = iout + dil / 2"]
  schematic: buck_converter

- id: boost_converter
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "Zvyšující měnič (boost)", da: "Boost-konverter (step-up)", de: "Hochsetzsteller (Boost)", el: "Μετατροπέας ανύψωσης (boost)", en: "Boost converter (step-up)", es: "Convertidor elevador (boost)", fr: "Convertisseur élévateur (boost)", hi: "बूस्ट कन्वर्टर (स्टेप-अप)", it: "Convertitore boost (step-up)", ja: "昇圧コンバータ（ブースト）", nl: "Boost-omzetter (step-up)", no: "Boost-omformer (opptrapping)", pl: "Przetwornica podwyższająca (boost)", pt: "Conversor elevador (boost)", sv: "Boost-omvandlare (uppstegning)", zh: "升压变换器（Boost）"}
  doc:
    en: "An ideal step-up (boost) converter in continuous conduction: the duty cycle is D = 1 − V_in / V_out, the average inductor current (equal to the input current) is I_L = I_out × V_out / V_in, and the peak-to-peak ripple current is ΔI_L = V_in × (V_out − V_in) / (V_out × f_sw × L). The inductor and the switch must handle the peak current I_pk = I_L + ΔI_L / 2. Assumptions: lossless components, constant input and output voltages, continuous conduction (the valley current stays above zero); I_out is the average output current. The defaults (5 V to 12 V, 0.5 A, 100 kHz, 100 µH) give D = 58.3 %, I_L = 1.2 A, ΔI_L = 0.29 A and I_pk = 1.35 A. V_in and I_out are always inputs (V_in cannot be solved from the ripple current, because two input voltages give the same ripple)."
    de: "Ein idealer Hochsetzsteller (Boost) im lückfreien Betrieb: Das Tastverhältnis ist D = 1 − V_in / V_out, der mittlere Spulenstrom (gleich dem Eingangsstrom) I_L = I_out · V_out / V_in und der Spitze-Spitze-Rippelstrom ΔI_L = V_in · (V_out − V_in) / (V_out · f_sw · L). Spule und Schalter müssen den Spitzenstrom I_pk = I_L + ΔI_L / 2 verkraften. Annahmen: verlustfreie Bauteile, konstante Ein- und Ausgangsspannung, lückfreier Betrieb (der Talstrom bleibt über null); I_out ist der mittlere Ausgangsstrom. Die Vorgaben (5 V auf 12 V, 0,5 A, 100 kHz, 100 µH) ergeben D = 58,3 %, I_L = 1,2 A, ΔI_L = 0,29 A und I_pk = 1,35 A. V_in und I_out sind immer Eingaben (V_in lässt sich nicht aus dem Rippelstrom bestimmen, weil zwei Eingangsspannungen denselben Rippel ergeben)."
  tags: [boost, step-up, dc-dc, switching regulator, inductor ripple, duty cycle, peak current, hochsetzsteller, aufwärtswandler, schaltregler, spule, rippelstrom, tastverhältnis, spitzenstrom]
  source: "Ideal continuous-conduction boost converter (D = 1 − V_in / V_out, I_L = I_out / (1 − D), ΔI_L = V_in × D / (f_sw × L)); R. W. Erickson, D. Maksimović: Fundamentals of Power Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 2; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 9"
  vars:
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "Input voltage", de: "Eingangsspannung"}, default: "5 V"}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}, default: "12 V"}
    iout: {dim: current, label: I_out, name: {en: "Output current", de: "Ausgangsstrom"}, default: "500 mA"}
    f: {dim: frequency, label: f_sw, name: {en: "Switching frequency", de: "Schaltfrequenz"}, default: "100 kHz"}
    l: {dim: inductance, label: L, name: {en: "Inductance", de: "Induktivität"}, default: "100 µH"}
    dil: {dim: current, label: ΔI_L, name: {en: "Inductor ripple current (peak to peak)", de: "Spulen-Rippelstrom (Spitze-Spitze)"}}
  dof: 5
  rules:
    dil: ["vin*(vout-vin)/(vout*f*l)"]
    l: ["vin*(vout-vin)/(vout*f*dil)"]
    f: ["vin*(vout-vin)/(vout*l*dil)"]
    vout: ["vin^2/(vin-dil*f*l)"]
  derived:
    duty: {dim: ratio, label: D, name: {en: "Duty cycle", de: "Tastverhältnis"}, expr: "1-vin/vout", unit: pct}
    il: {dim: current, label: I_L, name: {en: "Average inductor current", de: "Mittlerer Spulenstrom"}, expr: "iout*vout/vin"}
    ipk: {dim: current, label: I_pk, name: {en: "Peak inductor current", de: "Spitzenstrom der Spule"}, expr: "il+dil/2"}
    ival: {dim: current, label: I_valley, name: {en: "Valley inductor current", de: "Talstrom der Spule"}, expr: "il-dil/2"}
  checks:
    - {when: "vout <= vin", warn: {en: "V_out is not above V_in: a boost converter can only step up.", de: "V_out liegt nicht über V_in: Ein Hochsetzsteller kann nur heraufwandeln."}}
    - {when: "dil > 2*il", warn: {en: "The ripple current exceeds twice the average inductor current: the inductor current falls to zero and the converter leaves continuous conduction, so these formulas no longer apply.", de: "Der Rippelstrom übersteigt den doppelten mittleren Spulenstrom: Der Spulenstrom fällt auf null, der Wandler verlässt den lückfreien Betrieb und diese Formeln gelten nicht mehr."}}
  formula: ["duty = 1 - vin / vout", "dil = vin * (vout - vin) / (vout * f * l)", "ipk = il + dil / 2"]
  schematic: boost_converter

- id: smoothing_capacitor
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "Filtrační kondenzátor (usměrňovač)", da: "Udjævningskondensator (ensretter)", de: "Glättungskondensator (Gleichrichter)", el: "Πυκνωτής εξομάλυνσης (ανορθωτής)", en: "Smoothing capacitor", es: "Condensador de filtrado (rectificador)", fr: "Condensateur de lissage (redresseur)", hi: "स्मूदिंग संधारित्र (दिष्टकारी)", it: "Condensatore di livellamento (raddrizzatore)", ja: "平滑コンデンサ（整流）", nl: "Afvlakcondensator (gelijkrichter)", no: "Utjevningskondensator (likeretter)", pl: "Kondensator filtrujący (prostownik)", pt: "Capacitor de filtragem (retificador)", sv: "Utjämningskondensator (likriktare)", zh: "整流滤波电容"}
  doc:
    en: "The capacitor behind a rectifier supplies the load between the charging peaks. The peak-to-peak ripple is approximately ΔV = I / (m × f × C), where f is the mains frequency and m the number of charging peaks per mains cycle: 1 for a half-wave rectifier, 2 for a full-wave (bridge) rectifier. The estimate takes the whole period between the peaks as the discharge time and neglects the short charging time, so the real ripple is slightly lower. The defaults (1 A, 50 Hz, 1 V ripple, full wave) need 10 mF (10 000 µF). The drawing shows the bridge; for half-wave use a single diode."
    de: "Der Kondensator hinter einem Gleichrichter versorgt die Last zwischen den Ladespitzen. Der Spitze-Spitze-Rippel ist näherungsweise ΔV = I / (m · f · C); f ist die Netzfrequenz und m die Zahl der Ladespitzen pro Netzperiode: 1 beim Einweggleichrichter, 2 beim Zweiweg- (Brücken-)Gleichrichter. Die Näherung setzt die ganze Zeit zwischen den Spitzen als Entladezeit an und vernachlässigt die kurze Ladezeit, der tatsächliche Rippel ist daher etwas kleiner. Die Vorgaben (1 A, 50 Hz, 1 V Rippel, Zweiweg) erfordern 10 mF (10 000 µF). Die Zeichnung zeigt die Brücke; für Einweg genügt eine einzelne Diode."
  tags: [smoothing, filter capacitor, reservoir capacitor, rectifier, ripple, power supply, bridge rectifier, glättung, siebkondensator, ladekondensator, gleichrichter, brummspannung, welligkeit, netzteil]
  source: "Capacitor-input filter ripple estimate ΔV = I / (m × f × C) with m = 1 (half-wave) or 2 (full-wave), charging time neglected; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 9"
  vars:
    i: {dim: current, label: I, name: {en: "Load current", de: "Laststrom"}, default: "1 A"}
    f: {dim: frequency, label: f, name: {en: "Mains frequency", de: "Netzfrequenz"}, default: "50 Hz"}
    dv: {dim: voltage, label: ΔV, name: {en: "Ripple voltage (peak to peak)", de: "Rippelspannung (Spitze-Spitze)"}, default: "1 V"}
    c: {dim: capacitance, label: C, name: {en: "Smoothing capacitance", de: "Glättungskapazität"}}
  choices:
    rect:
      name: {cs: "Usměrnění", da: "Ensretning", de: "Gleichrichtung", el: "Ανόρθωση", en: "Rectification", es: "Rectificación", fr: "Redressement", hi: "दिष्टकरण", it: "Raddrizzamento", ja: "整流方式", nl: "Gelijkrichting", no: "Likeretting", pl: "Prostowanie", pt: "Retificação", sv: "Likriktning", zh: "整流方式"}
      default: full
      options:
        half:
          name: {cs: "Jednocestné", da: "Enkeltvejs", de: "Einweg", el: "Απλή ανόρθωση (μισού κύματος)", en: "Half-wave", es: "Media onda", fr: "Simple alternance", hi: "अर्ध-तरंग", it: "Semionda", ja: "半波", nl: "Enkelzijdig (halve golf)", no: "Enveis", pl: "Jednopołówkowe", pt: "Meia onda", sv: "Enkelriktad (halvvåg)", zh: "半波"}
          consts: {m: 1}
        full:
          name: {cs: "Dvoucestné (můstek)", da: "Tovejs (bro)", de: "Zweiweg (Brücke)", el: "Πλήρους κύματος (γέφυρα)", en: "Full-wave (bridge)", es: "Onda completa (puente)", fr: "Double alternance (pont)", hi: "पूर्ण-तरंग (ब्रिज)", it: "Onda intera (ponte)", ja: "全波（ブリッジ）", nl: "Dubbelzijdig (brug)", no: "Tovegs (bro)", pl: "Dwupołówkowe (mostek)", pt: "Onda completa (ponte)", sv: "Helvåg (brygga)", zh: "全波（桥式）"}
          consts: {m: 2}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    c: ["i/(m*f*dv)"]
    i: ["c*m*f*dv"]
    f: ["i/(m*c*dv)"]
    dv: ["i/(m*f*c)"]
  derived:
    fr: {dim: frequency, label: f_r, name: {en: "Ripple frequency", de: "Rippelfrequenz"}, expr: "m*f"}
  formula: ["c = i / (m * f * dv)"]
  schematic: smoothing_capacitor

- id: battery_runtime
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "Doba provozu na baterii", da: "Batteritid", de: "Akku-Laufzeit", el: "Διάρκεια λειτουργίας μπαταρίας", en: "Battery runtime", es: "Autonomía de la batería", fr: "Autonomie de la batterie", hi: "बैटरी चलने का समय", it: "Autonomia della batteria", ja: "バッテリー駆動時間", nl: "Batterijduur", no: "Batteritid", pl: "Czas pracy na baterii", pt: "Autonomia da bateria", sv: "Batteritid", zh: "电池续航时间"}
  doc:
    en: "The runtime of a battery follows from its capacity and the load current: t = Q × usable fraction / I. The usable fraction is the part of the rated capacity you can actually draw; the cut-off voltage, ageing, low temperature and high discharge currents reduce it. The defaults (a 2500 mAh cell, 250 mA load, 80 % usable) run for 8 hours. The calculation assumes a constant load current; the rated capacity is only valid for the discharge rate stated in the cell's datasheet."
    de: "Die Laufzeit eines Akkus folgt aus seiner Kapazität und dem Laststrom: t = Q · nutzbarer Anteil / I. Der nutzbare Anteil ist der Teil der Nennkapazität, den man tatsächlich entnehmen kann; Abschaltspannung, Alterung, niedrige Temperatur und hohe Entladeströme verringern ihn. Die Vorgaben (eine Zelle mit 2500 mAh, 250 mA Last, 80 % nutzbar) laufen 8 Stunden. Die Rechnung nimmt einen konstanten Laststrom an; die Nennkapazität gilt nur für den im Datenblatt der Zelle genannten Entladestrom."
  tags: [battery, runtime, capacity, discharge, mah, ah, lifetime, autonomy, akku, batterie, laufzeit, kapazität, entladung, betriebsdauer]
  source: "Definition of charge Q = I × t (1 Ah = 3600 C, SI Brochure, BIPM) with a usable-capacity fraction; background: D. Linden, T. B. Reddy (eds.): Handbook of Batteries, 3rd ed. (capacity depends on discharge rate and temperature)"
  vars:
    cap: {dim: charge, label: Q, name: {en: "Battery capacity", de: "Akkukapazität"}, default: "2500 mAh", unit: mAh, units: [mAh, Ah]}
    i: {dim: current, label: I, name: {en: "Load current", de: "Laststrom"}, default: "250 mA"}
    use: {dim: ratio, label: k, name: {en: "Usable fraction of the capacity", de: "Nutzbarer Anteil der Kapazität"}, default: 0.8, unit: pct}
    t: {dim: time, label: t, name: {en: "Runtime", de: "Laufzeit"}, unit: h, units: ["", min, h]}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    t: ["cap*use/i"]
    cap: ["t*i/use"]
    i: ["cap*use/t"]
    use: ["t*i/cap"]
  checks:
    - {when: "use > 1", warn: {en: "A usable fraction above 100 % is not possible: more energy is drawn than the battery holds.", de: "Ein nutzbarer Anteil über 100 % ist nicht möglich: Es würde mehr entnommen, als der Akku enthält."}}
  formula: ["t = cap * use / i"]

- id: battery_charge_time
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "Doba nabíjení baterie", da: "Opladningstid", de: "Akku-Ladezeit", el: "Χρόνος φόρτισης μπαταρίας", en: "Battery charge time", es: "Tiempo de carga de la batería", fr: "Durée de charge de la batterie", hi: "बैटरी चार्ज होने का समय", it: "Tempo di ricarica della batteria", ja: "バッテリー充電時間", nl: "Oplaadtijd batterij", no: "Ladetid for batteri", pl: "Czas ładowania baterii", pt: "Tempo de carga da bateria", sv: "Laddtid för batteri", zh: "电池充电时间"}
  doc:
    en: "The charge time follows from the capacity and the charge current: t = Q / (I × η). The charge efficiency η is the share of the supplied charge that ends up stored; the rest is lost. With a constant-current/constant-voltage charger the current also tapers off near the end, which lengthens the real time further. The default of 80 % is a planning assumption, not a datasheet value; use the charge figure of the battery's datasheet where there is one. The defaults (2500 mAh, 1 A, 80 %) give 3.125 h (3 h 7.5 min)."
    de: "Die Ladezeit folgt aus der Kapazität und dem Ladestrom: t = Q / (I · η). Der Ladewirkungsgrad η ist der Anteil der zugeführten Ladung, der tatsächlich gespeichert wird; der Rest geht verloren. Bei einem Lader mit Konstantstrom-/Konstantspannungs-Kennlinie sinkt der Strom gegen Ende zusätzlich, was die reale Zeit weiter verlängert. Der Vorgabewert von 80 % ist eine Planungsannahme, kein Datenblattwert; wo das Datenblatt des Akkus eine Angabe enthält, diese verwenden. Die Vorgaben (2500 mAh, 1 A, 80 %) ergeben 3,125 h (3 h 7,5 min)."
  tags: [battery, charge time, charging, charge current, capacity, efficiency, akku, batterie, ladezeit, laden, ladestrom, kapazität, wirkungsgrad]
  source: "Definition of charge Q = I × t (1 Ah = 3600 C, SI Brochure, BIPM) with a charge efficiency; background: D. Linden, T. B. Reddy (eds.): Handbook of Batteries, 3rd ed. (charging of secondary cells)"
  vars:
    cap: {dim: charge, label: Q, name: {en: "Battery capacity", de: "Akkukapazität"}, default: "2500 mAh", unit: mAh, units: [mAh, Ah]}
    i: {dim: current, label: I, name: {en: "Charge current", de: "Ladestrom"}, default: "1 A"}
    eta: {dim: ratio, label: η, name: {en: "Charge efficiency", de: "Ladewirkungsgrad"}, default: 0.8, unit: pct}
    t: {dim: time, label: t, name: {en: "Charge time", de: "Ladezeit"}, unit: h, units: ["", min, h]}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    t: ["cap/(i*eta)"]
    cap: ["t*i*eta"]
    i: ["cap/(t*eta)"]
    eta: ["cap/(t*i)"]
  checks:
    - {when: "eta > 1", warn: {en: "A charge efficiency above 100 % is not possible: more charge would be stored than supplied.", de: "Ein Ladewirkungsgrad über 100 % ist nicht möglich: Es würde mehr Ladung gespeichert als zugeführt."}}
  formula: ["t = cap / (i * eta)"]

- id: battery_pack
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "Bateriový balíček (sériově/paralelně)", da: "Batteripakke (serie/parallel)", de: "Akkupack (Reihe/parallel)", el: "Πακέτο μπαταριών (σειρά/παράλληλα)", en: "Battery pack (series/parallel)", es: "Paquete de baterías (serie/paralelo)", fr: "Pack de batteries (série/parallèle)", hi: "बैटरी पैक (श्रेणी/समानांतर)", it: "Pacco batterie (serie/parallelo)", ja: "バッテリーパック（直列/並列）", nl: "Accupakket (serie/parallel)", no: "Batteripakke (serie/parallell)", pl: "Pakiet ogniw (szeregowo/równolegle)", pt: "Pacote de baterias (série/paralelo)", sv: "Batteripack (serie/parallell)", zh: "电池组（串联/并联）"}
  doc:
    en: "A pack of N_s cells in series and N_p such strings in parallel: the pack voltage is N_s × the cell voltage, the pack capacity is N_p × the cell capacity, and the stored energy is the product of both. The defaults (3S2P with 3.7 V, 2500 mAh cells) give 11.1 V, 5 Ah and 55.5 Wh. The cell voltage is the nominal voltage: a fully charged lithium-ion cell is higher (about 4.2 V), an empty one lower. Real packs also need cell balancing and protection."
    de: "Ein Pack aus N_s in Reihe geschalteten Zellen und N_p solchen Strängen parallel: Die Packspannung ist N_s · Zellspannung, die Packkapazität N_p · Zellkapazität, und die gespeicherte Energie ist das Produkt beider. Die Vorgaben (3S2P mit Zellen zu 3,7 V und 2500 mAh) ergeben 11,1 V, 5 Ah und 55,5 Wh. Die Zellspannung ist die Nennspannung: Eine voll geladene Lithium-Ionen-Zelle liegt höher (etwa 4,2 V), eine leere niedriger. Reale Packs brauchen außerdem Zellenausgleich und Schutzschaltung."
  tags: [battery pack, series, parallel, cells, voltage, capacity, energy, 3s2p, lithium, akkupack, reihenschaltung, parallelschaltung, zellen, spannung, kapazität, energie]
  source: "Series connection adds voltages, parallel connection adds capacities, E = U × Q (1 Wh = 3600 J); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed., ch. 1 and 9"
  vars:
    ns: {dim: number, label: N_s, name: {en: "Cells in series", de: "Zellen in Reihe"}, default: 3}
    np: {dim: number, label: N_p, name: {en: "Strings in parallel", de: "Stränge parallel"}, default: 2}
    vcell: {dim: voltage, label: U_cell, name: {en: "Cell voltage", de: "Zellspannung"}, default: "3.7 V"}
    qcell: {dim: charge, label: Q_cell, name: {en: "Cell capacity", de: "Zellkapazität"}, default: "2500 mAh", unit: mAh, units: [mAh, Ah]}
    vpack: {dim: voltage, label: U_pack, name: {en: "Pack voltage", de: "Packspannung"}}
    qpack: {dim: charge, label: Q_pack, name: {en: "Pack capacity", de: "Packkapazität"}, unit: Ah, units: [mAh, Ah]}
    e: {dim: energy, label: E, name: {en: "Pack energy", de: "Packenergie"}, unit: Wh, units: [mWh, Wh, kWh]}
  dof: 4
  rules:
    vpack: ["ns*vcell", "e/qpack"]
    qpack: ["np*qcell", "e/vpack"]
    e: ["vpack*qpack"]
    ns: ["vpack/vcell"]
    np: ["qpack/qcell"]
    vcell: ["vpack/ns"]
    qcell: ["qpack/np"]
  derived:
    cells: {dim: number, label: N, name: {en: "Total number of cells", de: "Gesamtzahl der Zellen"}, expr: "ns*np"}
  checks:
    - {when: "ns != floor(ns)", warn: {en: "The number of cells in series must be a whole number.", de: "Die Zahl der Zellen in Reihe muss eine ganze Zahl sein."}}
    - {when: "np != floor(np)", warn: {en: "The number of strings in parallel must be a whole number.", de: "Die Zahl der parallelen Stränge muss eine ganze Zahl sein."}}
  formula: ["vpack = ns * vcell", "qpack = np * qcell", "e = vpack * qpack"]

- id: cable_voltage_drop
  kind: calculator
  category: power
  name: {cs: "Úbytek napětí na kabelu", da: "Spændingsfald i kabel", de: "Spannungsfall im Kabel", el: "Πτώση τάσης σε καλώδιο", en: "Cable voltage drop", es: "Caída de tensión en cable", fr: "Chute de tension dans un câble", hi: "केबल में वोल्टेज ड्रॉप", it: "Caduta di tensione nel cavo", ja: "ケーブルの電圧降下", nl: "Spanningsval in kabel", no: "Spenningsfall i kabel", pl: "Spadek napięcia na kablu", pt: "Queda de tensão no cabo", sv: "Spänningsfall i kabel", zh: "电缆压降"}
  doc:
    en: "Voltage drop of a copper or aluminium cable: ΔU = b × ρ × L × I × cos φ / A with the resistivity ρ at the conductor temperature, the one-way cable length L and the conductor cross-section A. b is 2 for direct current and single-phase AC (outgoing and return conductor) and √3 for three-phase AC (drop between the lines); cos φ does not apply to DC. The percentage is related to the nominal voltage U_n. Resistivity at 20 °C: copper 1/58 Ω·mm²/m (IEC 60028), aluminium 0.028264 Ω·mm²/m (IEC 60889); it rises with the temperature coefficient 0.00393 /K for copper (IEC 60028) and 0.00403 /K for aluminium (IEC 60889). The cable reactance is neglected, which is acceptable for small cross-sections; it adds to the drop at large cross-sections. The defaults (copper, single-phase 230 V, 20 m, 16 A, 2.5 mm², cos φ = 1, 70 °C) give about 5.3 V (2.3 %). Safety: mains voltage is dangerous. The results are guide values only; the design of a mains installation must follow the installation standard (for example DIN VDE 0100-520 or IEC 60364-5-52) and the local rules, and must be done and checked by a qualified electrician."
    de: "Spannungsfall eines Kupfer- oder Aluminiumkabels: ΔU = b · ρ · L · I · cos φ / A mit dem spezifischen Widerstand ρ bei Leitertemperatur, der einfachen Kabellänge L und dem Leiterquerschnitt A. b ist 2 für Gleichstrom und einphasigen Wechselstrom (Hin- und Rückleiter) und √3 für Drehstrom (Spannungsfall zwischen den Außenleitern); cos φ gilt nicht für Gleichstrom. Die Prozentangabe bezieht sich auf die Nennspannung U_n. Spezifischer Widerstand bei 20 °C: Kupfer 1/58 Ω·mm²/m (IEC 60028), Aluminium 0,028264 Ω·mm²/m (IEC 60889); er steigt mit dem Temperaturkoeffizienten 0,00393 /K bei Kupfer (IEC 60028) und 0,00403 /K bei Aluminium (IEC 60889). Der Blindwiderstand des Kabels wird vernachlässigt, was bei kleinen Querschnitten zulässig ist; bei großen Querschnitten erhöht er den Spannungsfall. Die Vorgaben (Kupfer, einphasig 230 V, 20 m, 16 A, 2,5 mm², cos φ = 1, 70 °C) ergeben etwa 5,3 V (2,3 %). Sicherheit: Netzspannung ist gefährlich. Die Ergebnisse sind nur Richtwerte; die Auslegung einer Netzinstallation muss der Installationsnorm (zum Beispiel DIN VDE 0100-520 oder IEC 60364-5-52) und den örtlichen Vorschriften folgen und von einer Elektrofachkraft ausgeführt und geprüft werden."
  tags: [cable, voltage drop, wire, copper, aluminium, conductor, cross-section, mains, kabel, spannungsfall, leitung, kupfer, aluminium, querschnitt, leitungsverlust, netz, vde]
  source: "Resistive voltage drop of a conductor ΔU = b × ρ × L × I × cos φ / A; cf. IEC 60364-5-52 and DIN VDE 0100-520 (voltage drop in consumers' installations); resistivity at 20 °C of annealed copper 1/58 Ω·mm²/m with α = 0.00393 /K (IEC 60028) and of hard-drawn aluminium 0.028264 Ω·mm²/m with α = 0.00403 /K (IEC 60889)"
  vars:
    l: {dim: length, label: L, name: {en: "Cable length (one way)", de: "Kabellänge (einfach)"}, default: "20 m", units: ["", ft]}
    i: {dim: current, label: I, name: {en: "Current", de: "Strom"}, default: "16 A"}
    a: {dim: area, label: A, name: {en: "Conductor cross-section", de: "Leiterquerschnitt"}, default: "2.5 mm2", unit: mm2, units: [mm2, AWG, kcmil]}
    cosphi: {dim: number, label: cos φ, name: {en: "Power factor", de: "Leistungsfaktor"}, default: 1}
    un: {dim: voltage, label: U_n, name: {en: "Nominal voltage", de: "Nennspannung"}, default: "230 V"}
    theta: {dim: temperature, label: θ, name: {en: "Conductor temperature", de: "Leitertemperatur"}, default: "70 degC", unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
    du: {dim: voltage, label: ΔU, name: {en: "Voltage drop", de: "Spannungsfall"}}
    dup: {dim: ratio, label: ΔU%, name: {en: "Voltage drop in % of U_n", de: "Spannungsfall in % von U_n"}, unit: pct}
  choices:
    material:
      name: {cs: "Materiál vodiče", da: "Ledermateriale", de: "Leitermaterial", el: "Υλικό αγωγού", en: "Conductor material", es: "Material del conductor", fr: "Matériau du conducteur", hi: "चालक सामग्री", it: "Materiale del conduttore", ja: "導体材料", nl: "Geleidermateriaal", no: "Lederens materiale", pl: "Materiał przewodu", pt: "Material do condutor", sv: "Ledarmaterial", zh: "导体材料"}
      default: copper
      options:
        copper:
          name: {cs: "Měď", da: "Kobber", de: "Kupfer", el: "Χαλκός", en: "Copper", es: "Cobre", fr: "Cuivre", hi: "तांबा", it: "Rame", ja: "銅", nl: "Koper", no: "Kobber", pl: "Miedź", pt: "Cobre", sv: "Koppar", zh: "铜"}
          consts: {rho20: 1.7241379310344827e-8, alpha: 0.00393}
        aluminium:
          name: {cs: "Hliník", da: "Aluminium", de: "Aluminium", el: "Αλουμίνιο", en: "Aluminium", es: "Aluminio", fr: "Aluminium", hi: "एल्युमीनियम", it: "Alluminio", ja: "アルミニウム", nl: "Aluminium", no: "Aluminium", pl: "Aluminium", pt: "Alumínio", sv: "Aluminium", zh: "铝"}
          consts: {rho20: 2.8264e-8, alpha: 0.00403}
    system:
      name: {cs: "Soustava", da: "System", de: "Stromart", el: "Σύστημα", en: "System", es: "Sistema", fr: "Système", hi: "प्रणाली", it: "Sistema", ja: "方式", nl: "Systeem", no: "System", pl: "Układ", pt: "Sistema", sv: "System", zh: "供电方式"}
      default: single
      options:
        dc:
          name: {cs: "Stejnosměrný", da: "Jævnstrøm", de: "Gleichstrom", el: "Συνεχές ρεύμα", en: "DC", es: "Corriente continua", fr: "Courant continu", hi: "डीसी", it: "Corrente continua", ja: "直流", nl: "Gelijkstroom", no: "Likestrøm", pl: "Prąd stały", pt: "Corrente contínua", sv: "Likström", zh: "直流"}
          consts: {b: 2, n: 2, u: 0}
          ignore: [cosphi]
        single:
          name: {cs: "Jednofázový střídavý", da: "Enfaset vekselstrøm", de: "Wechselstrom einphasig", el: "Μονοφασικό εναλλασσόμενο", en: "Single-phase AC", es: "Alterna monofásica", fr: "Alternatif monophasé", hi: "एकल-फेज़ एसी", it: "Alternata monofase", ja: "単相交流", nl: "Eenfase wisselstroom", no: "Enfase vekselstrøm", pl: "Prąd przemienny jednofazowy", pt: "Alternada monofásica", sv: "Enfas växelström", zh: "单相交流"}
          consts: {b: 2, n: 2, u: 1}
        three:
          name: {cs: "Třífázový střídavý", da: "Trefaset vekselstrøm", de: "Drehstrom dreiphasig", el: "Τριφασικό εναλλασσόμενο", en: "Three-phase AC", es: "Alterna trifásica", fr: "Alternatif triphasé", hi: "त्रि-फेज़ एसी", it: "Alternata trifase", ja: "三相交流", nl: "Driefase wisselstroom", no: "Trefase vekselstrøm", pl: "Prąd przemienny trójfazowy", pt: "Alternada trifásica", sv: "Trefas växelström", zh: "三相交流"}
          consts: {b: 1.7320508075688772, n: 3, u: 1}
  dof: 6
  rules:
    du: ["b*rho_t*l*i*(1-u+u*cosphi)/a", "dup*un"]
    dup: ["du/un"]
    a: ["b*rho_t*l*i*(1-u+u*cosphi)/du"]
    l: ["du*a/(b*rho_t*i*(1-u+u*cosphi))"]
    i: ["du*a/(b*rho_t*l*(1-u+u*cosphi))"]
    un: ["du/dup"]
  derived:
    rho_t: {dim: resistivity, label: ρ_θ, name: {en: "Resistivity at the conductor temperature", de: "Spezifischer Widerstand bei Leitertemperatur"}, expr: "rho20*(1+alpha*(theta-293.15))", unit: ohmmm2m, units: ["", ohmmm2m]}
    ploss: {dim: power, label: P_loss, name: {en: "Power loss in the conductors", de: "Verlustleistung in den Leitern"}, expr: "n*rho_t*l*i^2/a"}
  checks:
    - {when: "dup > 0.05", warn: {en: "The voltage drop is above 5 %: check the permissible value in the installation standard, and use a larger cross-section or a shorter run.", de: "Der Spannungsfall liegt über 5 %: Den zulässigen Wert in der Installationsnorm prüfen und einen größeren Querschnitt oder eine kürzere Leitung wählen."}}
    - {when: "cosphi > 1", warn: {en: "cos φ cannot be larger than 1.", de: "cos φ kann nicht größer als 1 sein."}}
  formula: ["du = b * rho_t * l * i * cosphi / a", "dup = du / un"]
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the vector files**

The IPC-2221 values use the unit constant `1 mil² = 6.4516e-10 m²` and `ΔT` in kelvin (equal to °C for a difference). The AWG values come from `d = 0.000127 m × 92^((36 − n) / 39)`; the refs name the published ASTM B258 values they round to (AWG 10: 2.588 mm and 5.261 mm²; AWG 0: 8.251 mm; AWG 36: 0.127 mm; AWG 0000: 0.4600 in).

Create `internal/ecalc/catalog/calculators/wiring.yaml` with exactly this content:

```yaml
# Wiring and PCB calculators. Every name is written in all 16 desktop locales; docs, variable names and warnings in
# English and German (other languages fall back to English). Rules are written out for every direction, in the order the
# solver tries them: the first alternative whose variables are all known wins.

- id: ipc2221_trace_width
  kind: calculator
  category: wiring
  name: {cs: "Šířka cesty na DPS (IPC-2221)", da: "Ledningsbredde på PCB (IPC-2221)", de: "Leiterbahnbreite (IPC-2221)", el: "Πλάτος αγωγού PCB (IPC-2221)", en: "PCB trace width (IPC-2221)", es: "Ancho de pista de PCB (IPC-2221)", fr: "Largeur de piste de circuit imprimé (IPC-2221)", hi: "PCB ट्रेस चौड़ाई (IPC-2221)", it: "Larghezza della pista PCB (IPC-2221)", ja: "基板パターン幅（IPC-2221）", nl: "Printbaanbreedte (IPC-2221)", no: "Sporbredde på kretskort (IPC-2221)", pl: "Szerokość ścieżki PCB (IPC-2221)", pt: "Largura da trilha de PCB (IPC-2221)", sv: "Ledarbredd på kretskort (IPC-2221)", zh: "PCB 走线宽度（IPC-2221）"}
  doc:
    en: "Current-carrying capacity of a printed-circuit trace after the IPC-2221 equation I = k × ΔT^0.44 × A^0.725, with the current I in A, the temperature rise ΔT in °C and the copper cross-section A in mil² (1 mil = 25.4 µm). The constant k is 0.048 for traces on external layers and 0.024 for internal layers. The cross-section is the copper thickness times the trace width; 1 oz copper is a layer of about 35 µm. The defaults (2 A, 10 °C rise, 1 oz, external) need a trace about 0.78 mm (31 mil) wide. The IPC-2221 curves cover temperature rises of about 10 °C to 100 °C and currents up to about 35 A. The result is a guide value for a single trace: neighbouring copper, vias and the board thickness change the real temperature rise, and the newer IPC-2152 gives more detailed data for critical designs."
    de: "Strombelastbarkeit einer Leiterbahn nach der IPC-2221-Gleichung I = k · ΔT^0,44 · A^0,725; der Strom I in A, der Temperaturanstieg ΔT in °C und der Kupferquerschnitt A in mil² (1 mil = 25,4 µm). Die Konstante k ist 0,048 für Leiterbahnen auf Außenlagen und 0,024 für Innenlagen. Der Querschnitt ist Kupferdicke mal Leiterbahnbreite; 1 oz Kupfer ist eine Schicht von etwa 35 µm. Die Vorgaben (2 A, 10 °C Anstieg, 1 oz, außen) erfordern eine Leiterbahn von etwa 0,78 mm (31 mil) Breite. Die IPC-2221-Kurven decken Temperaturanstiege von etwa 10 °C bis 100 °C und Ströme bis etwa 35 A ab. Das Ergebnis ist ein Richtwert für eine einzelne Leiterbahn: Benachbartes Kupfer, Vias und die Leiterplattendicke verändern den tatsächlichen Temperaturanstieg, und die neuere IPC-2152 liefert für kritische Entwürfe genauere Daten."
  tags: [ipc-2221, trace width, pcb, current capacity, temperature rise, copper, oz, mil, leiterbahnbreite, leiterbahn, strombelastbarkeit, leiterplatte, kupferdicke, temperaturanstieg]
  source: "IPC-2221 (generic standard on printed board design), current-carrying capacity equation I = k × ΔT^0.44 × A^0.725 with k = 0.048 (external) and k = 0.024 (internal layers); see also IPC-2152"
  vars:
    i: {dim: current, label: I, name: {en: "Current", de: "Strom"}, default: "2 A"}
    dt: {dim: tempdiff, label: ΔT, name: {en: "Temperature rise", de: "Temperaturanstieg"}, default: 10, unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
    t: {dim: length, label: T, name: {en: "Copper thickness", de: "Kupferdicke"}, default: "1 oz", unit: oz, units: [oz, "", mil]}
    w: {dim: length, label: W, name: {en: "Trace width", de: "Leiterbahnbreite"}, units: ["", mil]}
  choices:
    layer:
      name: {cs: "Vrstva", da: "Lag", de: "Lage", el: "Στρώμα", en: "Layer", es: "Capa", fr: "Couche", hi: "परत", it: "Strato", ja: "層", nl: "Laag", no: "Lag", pl: "Warstwa", pt: "Camada", sv: "Lager", zh: "层"}
      default: external
      options:
        external:
          name: {cs: "Vnější", da: "Yderlag", de: "Außenlage", el: "Εξωτερικό", en: "External", es: "Externa", fr: "Externe", hi: "बाहरी", it: "Esterno", ja: "外層", nl: "Buitenlaag", no: "Ytre lag", pl: "Zewnętrzna", pt: "Externa", sv: "Yttre lager", zh: "外层"}
          consts: {k: 0.048}
        internal:
          name: {cs: "Vnitřní", da: "Indre lag", de: "Innenlage", el: "Εσωτερικό", en: "Internal", es: "Interna", fr: "Interne", hi: "आंतरिक", it: "Interno", ja: "内層", nl: "Binnenlaag", no: "Indre lag", pl: "Wewnętrzna", pt: "Interna", sv: "Inre lager", zh: "内层"}
          consts: {k: 0.024}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    i: ["k*dt^0.44*(a/6.4516e-10)^0.725"]
    w: ["6.4516e-10*(i/(k*dt^0.44))^(1/0.725)/t"]
    t: ["6.4516e-10*(i/(k*dt^0.44))^(1/0.725)/w"]
    dt: ["(i/(k*(a/6.4516e-10)^0.725))^(1/0.44)"]
  derived:
    a: {dim: area, label: A, name: {en: "Copper cross-section", de: "Kupferquerschnitt"}, expr: "t*w", unit: mil2, units: [mil2, mm2]}
  checks:
    - {when: "i > 35", warn: {en: "The current is above the range of the IPC-2221 curves (about 35 A); the result is an extrapolation.", de: "Der Strom liegt über dem Bereich der IPC-2221-Kurven (etwa 35 A); das Ergebnis ist eine Extrapolation."}}
    - {when: "dt > 100", warn: {en: "The temperature rise is above the range of the IPC-2221 curves (about 100 °C); the result is an extrapolation.", de: "Der Temperaturanstieg liegt über dem Bereich der IPC-2221-Kurven (etwa 100 °C); das Ergebnis ist eine Extrapolation."}}
  formula: ["i = k * dt^0.44 * a^0.725", "a = t * w"]

- id: trace_resistance
  kind: calculator
  category: wiring
  name: {cs: "Odpor cesty na DPS", da: "PCB-sporets modstand", de: "Leiterbahnwiderstand", el: "Αντίσταση αγωγού PCB", en: "PCB trace resistance", es: "Resistencia de pista de PCB", fr: "Résistance d'une piste de circuit imprimé", hi: "PCB ट्रेस प्रतिरोध", it: "Resistenza della pista PCB", ja: "基板パターンの抵抗", nl: "Weerstand van een printbaan", no: "Sporresistans på kretskort", pl: "Rezystancja ścieżki PCB", pt: "Resistência da trilha de PCB", sv: "Ledarresistans på kretskort", zh: "PCB 走线电阻"}
  doc:
    en: "Resistance of a copper trace: R = ρ × L / (W × T), with the resistivity at the trace temperature ρ = ρ_20 × (1 + α × (θ − 20 °C)). For copper ρ_20 = 1/58 Ω·mm²/m (17.24 nΩ·m) and α = 0.00393 /K (annealed copper, IEC 60028). The voltage drop is R × I and the dissipated power R × I². The sheet resistance R_sq = ρ / T is the resistance of a square of any size. The defaults (0.25 mm wide, 35 µm thick, 50 mm long, 25 °C, 1 A) give about 0.1 Ω, so 0.1 V and 0.1 W. Enter the temperature of the trace, not of the room: at the temperature rise of a heavily loaded trace the resistance is noticeably higher."
    de: "Widerstand einer Kupfer-Leiterbahn: R = ρ · L / (W · T), mit dem spezifischen Widerstand bei Leiterbahntemperatur ρ = ρ_20 · (1 + α · (θ − 20 °C)). Für Kupfer gilt ρ_20 = 1/58 Ω·mm²/m (17,24 nΩ·m) und α = 0,00393 /K (weichgeglühtes Kupfer, IEC 60028). Der Spannungsfall ist R · I und die Verlustleistung R · I². Der Flächenwiderstand R_sq = ρ / T ist der Widerstand eines Quadrats beliebiger Größe. Die Vorgaben (0,25 mm breit, 35 µm dick, 50 mm lang, 25 °C, 1 A) ergeben etwa 0,1 Ω, also 0,1 V und 0,1 W. Die Temperatur der Leiterbahn eingeben, nicht die des Raums: Bei der Erwärmung einer stark belasteten Leiterbahn ist der Widerstand merklich höher."
  tags: [trace resistance, pcb, copper, resistance, sheet resistance, voltage drop, leiterbahn, leiterbahnwiderstand, kupfer, widerstand, flächenwiderstand, spannungsfall]
  source: "Resistance of a prismatic conductor R = ρ × L / A; annealed copper ρ_20 = 1/58 Ω·mm²/m and α = 0.00393 /K per IEC 60028; resistivity at temperature ρ = ρ_20 × (1 + α × (θ − 20 °C))"
  vars:
    w: {dim: length, label: W, name: {en: "Trace width", de: "Leiterbahnbreite"}, default: "0.25 mm", units: ["", mil]}
    t: {dim: length, label: T, name: {en: "Copper thickness", de: "Kupferdicke"}, default: "1 oz", unit: oz, units: [oz, "", mil]}
    l: {dim: length, label: L, name: {en: "Trace length", de: "Leiterbahnlänge"}, default: "50 mm", units: ["", mil, in]}
    temp: {dim: temperature, label: θ, name: {en: "Trace temperature", de: "Leiterbahntemperatur"}, default: "25", unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
    i: {dim: current, label: I, name: {en: "Current", de: "Strom"}, default: "1 A"}
    r: {dim: resistance, label: R, name: {en: "Trace resistance", de: "Leiterbahnwiderstand"}}
    v: {dim: voltage, label: ΔU, name: {en: "Voltage drop", de: "Spannungsfall"}}
    p: {dim: power, label: P, name: {en: "Power dissipated", de: "Verlustleistung"}}
  dof: 5
  rules:
    r: ["rho_t*l/(w*t)", "v/i", "p/i^2", "v^2/p"]
    v: ["r*i", "p/i", "sqrt(p*r)"]
    p: ["r*i^2", "v*i", "v^2/r"]
    i: ["v/r", "p/v", "sqrt(p/r)"]
    l: ["r*w*t/rho_t"]
    w: ["rho_t*l/(r*t)"]
    t: ["rho_t*l/(r*w)"]
  derived:
    rho_t: {dim: resistivity, label: ρ_θ, name: {en: "Resistivity at the trace temperature", de: "Spezifischer Widerstand bei Leiterbahntemperatur"}, expr: "1.7241379310344827e-8*(1+0.00393*(temp-293.15))", unit: ohmmm2m, units: ["", ohmmm2m]}
    rsq: {dim: resistance, label: R_sq, name: {en: "Sheet resistance (per square)", de: "Flächenwiderstand (pro Quadrat)"}, expr: "rho_t/t"}
  formula: ["r = rho_t * l / (w * t)", "v = r * i", "p = r * i^2"]

- id: via_current
  kind: calculator
  category: wiring
  name: {cs: "Proudová zatížitelnost prokovu", da: "Via – strømbelastning", de: "Strombelastbarkeit einer Durchkontaktierung", el: "Ικανότητα ρεύματος οπής διέλευσης (via)", en: "Via current capacity", es: "Capacidad de corriente de una vía", fr: "Courant admissible d'un via", hi: "वाया की धारा क्षमता", it: "Portata di corrente di un via", ja: "ビアの電流容量", nl: "Stroomdraagvermogen van een via", no: "Strømkapasitet for via", pl: "Obciążalność prądowa przelotki", pt: "Capacidade de corrente de uma via", sv: "Strömkapacitet för via", zh: "过孔载流能力"}
  doc:
    en: "Estimate for a plated through-hole via. The copper barrel is a tube of length H (the board thickness) with the finished hole diameter D and the plating thickness T_p, so its copper cross-section is A = π × T_p × (D + T_p) and its resistance at 20 °C is R = ρ × H / A with ρ = 1/58 Ω·mm²/m (IEC 60028). The IPC-2221 equation is written for traces; applying it to a via barrel is a common engineering approximation, not a rule of the standard. Here the barrel cross-section is used with the constant for internal layers: I = 0.024 × ΔT^0.44 × A^0.725 (A in mil²), which is the lower of the two IPC-2221 constants. Several vias in parallel share the current. The defaults (0.3 mm finished hole, 25 µm plating, 1.6 mm board, 10 °C rise) give A = 0.0255 mm², R = 1.08 mΩ and I = 0.95 A."
    de: "Abschätzung für eine durchkontaktierte Via. Die Kupferhülse ist ein Rohr der Länge H (Leiterplattendicke) mit dem Fertigloch-Durchmesser D und der Hülsendicke T_p; ihr Kupferquerschnitt ist A = π · T_p · (D + T_p) und ihr Widerstand bei 20 °C R = ρ · H / A mit ρ = 1/58 Ω·mm²/m (IEC 60028). Die IPC-2221-Gleichung ist für Leiterbahnen geschrieben; sie auf eine Via-Hülse anzuwenden ist eine übliche technische Näherung, keine Regel der Norm. Hier wird der Hülsenquerschnitt mit der Konstanten für Innenlagen verwendet: I = 0,024 · ΔT^0,44 · A^0,725 (A in mil²), der kleineren der beiden IPC-2221-Konstanten. Mehrere parallele Vias teilen sich den Strom. Die Vorgaben (0,3 mm Fertigloch, 25 µm Hülse, 1,6 mm Leiterplatte, 10 °C Anstieg) ergeben A = 0,0255 mm², R = 1,08 mΩ und I = 0,95 A."
  tags: [via, plated through hole, pcb, current capacity, barrel, resistance, durchkontaktierung, via, strombelastbarkeit, hülse, widerstand, leiterplatte]
  source: "Tube cross-section A = π × T_p × (D + T_p) and R = ρ × H / A with ρ = 1/58 Ω·mm²/m (IEC 60028); current from the IPC-2221 equation I = k × ΔT^0.44 × A^0.725 with the internal-layer constant k = 0.024 applied to the barrel as an approximation"
  vars:
    d: {dim: length, label: D, name: {en: "Finished hole diameter", de: "Fertigloch-Durchmesser"}, default: "0.3 mm", units: ["", mil]}
    tp: {dim: length, label: T_p, name: {en: "Plating thickness", de: "Hülsendicke (Kupfer)"}, default: "25 µm", units: ["", mil, oz]}
    h: {dim: length, label: H, name: {en: "Board thickness", de: "Leiterplattendicke"}, default: "1.6 mm", units: ["", mil]}
    dt: {dim: tempdiff, label: ΔT, name: {en: "Temperature rise", de: "Temperaturanstieg"}, default: 10, unit: degC, units: [degC, degF, ""]}
  dof: 4
  derived:
    a: {dim: area, label: A, name: {en: "Copper cross-section of the barrel", de: "Kupferquerschnitt der Hülse"}, expr: "pi*tp*(d+tp)", unit: mm2, units: [mm2, mil2]}
    rho: {dim: resistivity, label: ρ_20, name: {en: "Resistivity of copper at 20 °C", de: "Spezifischer Widerstand von Kupfer bei 20 °C"}, expr: "1.7241379310344827e-8", unit: ohmmm2m, units: ["", ohmmm2m]}
    r: {dim: resistance, label: R, name: {en: "Barrel resistance", de: "Hülsenwiderstand"}, expr: "rho*h/a"}
    i: {dim: current, label: I, name: {en: "Current for the temperature rise (IPC-2221, internal)", de: "Strom beim Temperaturanstieg (IPC-2221, innen)"}, expr: "0.024*dt^0.44*(a/6.4516e-10)^0.725"}
  checks:
    - {when: "dt > 100", warn: {en: "The temperature rise is above the range of the IPC-2221 curves (about 100 °C); the result is an extrapolation.", de: "Der Temperaturanstieg liegt über dem Bereich der IPC-2221-Kurven (etwa 100 °C); das Ergebnis ist eine Extrapolation."}}
  formula: ["a = pi * tp * (d + tp)", "r = rho * h / a", "i = 0.024 * dt^0.44 * a^0.725"]

- id: awg_conversion
  kind: calculator
  category: wiring
  name: {cs: "Převod AWG (průměr a průřez vodiče)", da: "AWG-omregning (tråddiameter og tværsnit)", de: "AWG-Umrechnung (Drahtdurchmesser und Querschnitt)", el: "Μετατροπή AWG (διάμετρος και διατομή αγωγού)", en: "AWG wire size conversion", es: "Conversión AWG (diámetro y sección del conductor)", fr: "Conversion AWG (diamètre et section du fil)", hi: "AWG तार आकार रूपांतरण", it: "Conversione AWG (diametro e sezione del filo)", ja: "AWG変換（線径と断面積）", nl: "AWG-omrekening (draaddiameter en doorsnede)", no: "AWG-omregning (trådtykkelse og tverrsnitt)", pl: "Przeliczanie AWG (średnica i przekrój przewodu)", pt: "Conversão AWG (diâmetro e secção do fio)", sv: "AWG-omräkning (tråddiameter och area)", zh: "AWG 线规换算（线径与截面积）"}
  doc:
    en: "American Wire Gauge: the diameter of the gauge n is d = 0.005 in × 92^((36 − n) / 39) (ASTM B258), a factor of about 1.123 per gauge step and about 2 for every 6 steps. The cross-section is A = π / 4 × d². Enter the diameter in AWG, mm, mil or inch, or the cross-section in AWG, mm², kcmil or mil²; a circular mil is the area of a circle 1 mil in diameter, so 1 kcmil = 0.5067 mm². The gauges 0000, 000 and 00 are −3, −2 and −1. The default AWG 10 is 2.588 mm in diameter and 5.261 mm² (ASTM B258 lists 2.588 mm). The resistance of 1 km is for annealed copper at 20 °C (1/58 Ω·mm²/m)."
    de: "American Wire Gauge: Der Durchmesser der Größe n ist d = 0,005 in · 92^((36 − n) / 39) (ASTM B258), ein Faktor von etwa 1,123 je Größenstufe und etwa 2 je 6 Stufen. Der Querschnitt ist A = π / 4 · d². Den Durchmesser in AWG, mm, mil oder Zoll eingeben, oder den Querschnitt in AWG, mm², kcmil oder mil²; ein Circular Mil ist die Fläche eines Kreises von 1 mil Durchmesser, daher gilt 1 kcmil = 0,5067 mm². Die Größen 0000, 000 und 00 sind −3, −2 und −1. Der Vorgabewert AWG 10 hat 2,588 mm Durchmesser und 5,261 mm² (ASTM B258 nennt 2,588 mm). Der Widerstand von 1 km gilt für weichgeglühtes Kupfer bei 20 °C (1/58 Ω·mm²/m)."
  tags: [awg, wire gauge, wire size, diameter, cross-section, kcmil, circular mil, mm2, drahtstärke, drahtdurchmesser, querschnitt, leitungsquerschnitt, umrechnung]
  source: "ASTM B258 (standard nominal diameters and cross-sectional areas of AWG sizes of solid round wires): d = 0.005 in × 92^((36 − n) / 39); 1 circular mil = π / 4 mil²; copper resistivity 1/58 Ω·mm²/m (IEC 60028)"
  vars:
    d: {dim: length, label: d, name: {en: "Wire diameter", de: "Drahtdurchmesser"}, default: "10", unit: AWG, units: ["", mil, in, AWG]}
    a: {dim: area, label: A, name: {en: "Cross-section", de: "Querschnitt"}, unit: mm2, units: [mm2, AWG, kcmil, mil2]}
  dof: 1
  rules:
    a: ["pi/4*d^2"]
    d: ["sqrt(4*a/pi)"]
  derived:
    rkm: {dim: resistance, label: R_km, name: {en: "Copper resistance of 1 km at 20 °C", de: "Kupferwiderstand von 1 km bei 20 °C"}, expr: "1.7241379310344827e-8*1000/a"}
  formula: ["a = pi / 4 * d^2"]
```

---

## Part C5 — RF and digital calculators (tasks C5.1 and C5.2)


**Goal:** 14 calculators for the two categories `rf` (8) and `digital` (6): their YAML items, their hand-checked vector
files and the two drawings that belong to circuits (I²C pull-ups and the resistor-divider level shifter). Nothing else in
the repository changes except the generated catalog snapshot.

**How this part was made and verified:** built for real in the scratch worktree `wc5` on top of Part A and Part U (all
uncommitted). Every code block below was generated by script from the files of that worktree. The expected values of all
vectors were computed with an independent decimal script (60 digits, the formulas written again from the cited sources,
never from the solver); every `ref` writes the arithmetic out. The final run is in the verification section at the end.
A mutation check (a wrong constant in `microstrip_impedance`, `i2c_pullup` and `uart_baud_error`) made exactly those three
vector tests fail, and was reverted.

No existing function, type or file is modified by this part, so no GitNexus impact analysis is needed (only new files plus
the regenerated snapshot).

### Contract deviations

1. **The two Part A tests that pin the catalog size go red with the first content task.** `TestPhaseOneCalculators`
   (`basics_test.go`, `len(cat.Calculators) != len(want)`, want 12) and `TestLocalizedJSONLanguagesAndFallback`
   (`localize_test.go`, `len(en.Items) != 12`) were written for a catalog that holds only the basics. They are owned by
   Part A, so this part does not edit them; every run command below uses `-skip '^(TestPhaseOneCalculators|TestLocalizedJSONLanguagesAndFallback)$'` until the assembler
   unpins them. Suggested edit for the assembler (valid for all content parts): in `TestPhaseOneCalculators` compare `want`
   with the calculators whose `Category == "basics"` only (build `basics := []*Calculator{}` in catalog order, then check
   `len(basics) != len(want)` and loop over `basics`), and in `TestLocalizedJSONLanguagesAndFallback` replace
   `len(en.Items) != 12` by `len(en.Items) != len(cat.Calculators)` (load `cat, _ := Default()` first).
2. **The red step of the vector test is "the subtests do not exist yet".** `TestCalculatorVectors` iterates the catalog, so a
   vector file without its calculator is simply not read and the test cannot fail. The expected-FAIL step therefore checks
   that no `PASS: TestCalculatorVectors/<id>` line exists yet (`testing: warning: no tests to run`). The real red step of
   C5.2 is the schematics test: the catalog names `i2c_pullup` and `level_shift_divider` before the drawings exist.
3. **The `rf` category has no drawing.** Wavelength, dipole length, microstrip and coax geometry, SWR, RF levels, free-space
   loss and skin depth are formulas or geometry, not circuits (contract §3), so `ecalc-schematics-rf.js` stays the empty
   wrapper that Part U created and is not touched. Only `i2c_pullup` and `level_shift_divider` have schematics (both 32
   grid units wide, the limit Part U measured for anchored chips). `adc` and `dac` are conversions and have none.
4. **Forward-only calculators:** `adc` and `uart_baud_error` (all inputs, only derived outputs; quantizing with `floor` or
   `round` cannot be inverted). `dac` solves forward, the nearest code for a wanted voltage (`round`) and V_ref, but not
   the bit count N (it has no rule, so N is an input in every solvable set).
5. **No binary text is pinned.** As instructed by the coordinator, neither a doc string nor a vector `ref` contains a
   formatted binary number (hex and octal text are used; binary is described in words), because the radix output of the
   engine is about to change to byte grouping. The vectors are numeric.
6. **`dB` display derived values are display-only.** `rf_power_levels` shows its power and voltage in dBm and dBµV through
   derived `p_dbm` and `v_dbuv`, whose stored values are the SI power and voltage (the same pattern as `db_levels` in
   basics); the vector sets therefore list the SI value for them.
7. **Single-entry `units` lists** are used on purpose: `[""]` on `rf_power_levels.vpp` (no dB units on a peak-to-peak value)
   and `["dec"]` / `["hex"]` / `["bin"]` / `["oct"]` on the bit count and the four number-system fields.
8. **Uncertain sources are listed in the verification section** (IPC-2141 validity range, three resistivities, the 550 pF
   limit of fast-mode plus); nothing is cited by page, URL or application-note number.

### What the 14 calculators are

| id | category | dof | defaults | default result | sets / solve vectors | schematic |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `wavelength` | rf | 2 | f 145 MHz, VF 1 | λ 2.068 m (half 1.034 m, quarter 0.517 m) | 4 / 12 | no |
| `dipole_length` | rf | 2 | f 7.1 MHz, K 0.95 | L 20.06 m (quarter 10.03 m) | 4 / 9 | no |
| `microstrip_impedance` | rf | 4 | ε_r 4.3, h 1.6 mm, w 3 mm, t 1 oz | Z_0 49.82 Ω, w/h 1.875 | 4 / 16 | no |
| `coax_impedance` | rf | 3 | ε_r 2.25, D 3.5 mm, d 1 mm | Z_0 50.08 Ω, VF 0.667 | 4 / 11 | no |
| `swr_return_loss` | rf | 1 | SWR 2 | \|Γ\| 0.3333, RL 9.542 dB, 11.11 % reflected, ML 0.5115 dB | 4 / 11 | no |
| `rf_power_levels` | rf | 2 | P 1 mW, R 50 Ω | V_rms 223.6 mV, V_pp 632.5 mV, 0 dBm = 107.0 dBµV | 4 / 12 | no |
| `fspl` | rf | 2 | d 1 km, f 2.4 GHz | FSPL 100.05 dB, λ 124.9 mm | 4 / 10 | no |
| `skin_depth` | rf | 1 | copper, f 1 MHz | δ 66.08 µm, R_s 0.2609 mΩ | 8 / 10 | no |
| `adc` | digital | 3 | V_ref 3.3 V, N 12, V_in 1 V | LSB 0.8057 mV, code 1241 (0x4D9) | 5 / 10 | no (forward-only) |
| `dac` | digital | 3 | V_ref 3.3 V, N 12, code 2048 | V_out 1.65 V | 4 / 14 | no |
| `i2c_pullup` | digital | 4 | standard-mode, 3.3 V, 0.4 V, 3 mA, 100 pF | R_min 966.7 Ω, R_max 11.80 kΩ | 6 / 23 | i2c_pullup |
| `level_shift_divider` | digital | 4 | 5 V, 1 kΩ, 2 kΩ, V_IH 2 V | V_out 3.333 V, margin 1.333 V, 1.667 mA | 4 / 12 | level_shift_divider |
| `uart_baud_error` | digital | 2 | 16× oversampling, 16 MHz, 115 200 Bd | divisor 9, 111.1 kBd, −3.549 % | 6 / 10 | no (forward-only) |
| `number_systems` | digital | 1 | dec 255 | hex 0xFF, oct 0o377 | 4 / 11 | no |

All ids are the binding ids of the contract. Every item has all 16 names, English and German `doc`, variable and derived names,
warnings and tags, a `source`, and a default input set that is one of its solvable sets (the round-trip test runs every
choice option).

Design notes that the YAML does not say by itself:

- `microstrip_impedance` has five rules (one per variable) and three checks: w/h below 0.1, above 2.0 and ε_r outside 1…15.
  The validity range is the one commonly quoted with the formula.
- `coax_impedance` uses the exact `η₀/2π = 59.95849163 Ω` (η₀ = μ₀·c with the CODATA 2018 μ₀ = 1.25663706212e-6 H/m) instead
  of the rounded 138·log10 form; the doc says the two agree.
- `swr_return_loss` has dof 1: any one of SWR, |Γ| or RL; the reflected power and the mismatch loss are derived.
- `skin_depth` has the choice `material` (copper, silver, gold, aluminium) with the resistivity `rho` as a const and μ_r = 1;
  `μ0 = 4π·10^-7 H/m` (the CODATA 2018 value differs by 6e-10 relative).
- `i2c_pullup` has a choice `mode` with the consts `tr` (1000 / 300 / 120 ns) and `cbmax` (400 / 400 / 550 pF); six rules
  (R_min, I_OL, V_DD, V_OL, R_max, C_b) and two checks (R_min ≥ R_max, C_b above the mode's limit).
- `level_shift_divider` has dof 4 because V_IH has no rule (it is an input of every solvable set); the divider rules are those of the basics voltage divider.
- `uart_baud_error` clamps the divisor to at least 1 (`max(round(...), 1)`); `round` takes ties away from zero (4 MHz, 100 kBd,
  16×: 2.5 → 3 is a vector).
- `number_systems` holds four `integer` variables with fixed radix units; every field is a rule target of the other three, so the
  values are the same number and the range error (not whole, negative, above 2^53 − 1) shows on all four.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the vector files first**

Every set and solve vector carries a `ref`. The numbers come from exact arithmetic, a definition or a published constant
("hand") or from an independent decimal script that implements the formula again ("hand (independent script)"), never from
the solver. Every rule direction has at least two solve vectors; every option of `skin_depth` has two sets.
