Create `internal/ecalc/catalog/calculators/rf.yaml` with exactly this content:

```yaml
# RF calculators. Every name is written in all 16 desktop locales; docs, variable names and warnings in English and German
# (other languages fall back to English). Rules are written out for every direction, in the order the solver tries them:
# the first alternative whose variables are all known wins. The speed of light is the exact SI value 299792458 m/s.

- id: wavelength
  kind: calculator
  category: rf
  name: {cs: "Vlnová délka", da: "Bølgelængde", de: "Wellenlänge", el: "Μήκος κύματος", en: "Wavelength", es: "Longitud de onda", fr: "Longueur d'onde", hi: "तरंगदैर्घ्य", it: "Lunghezza d'onda", ja: "波長", nl: "Golflengte", no: "Bølgelengde", pl: "Długość fali", pt: "Comprimento de onda", sv: "Våglängd", zh: "波长"}
  doc:
    en: "The wavelength of an electromagnetic wave is λ = c × VF / f, with the speed of light c = 299 792 458 m/s (exact) and the velocity factor VF of the medium (1 in free space, about 0.66 in coax with a solid polyethylene dielectric). Any two of f, VF and λ determine the third; the half and the quarter wavelength are shown too. Example: 145 MHz in free space gives λ = 2.068 m."
    de: "Die Wellenlänge einer elektromagnetischen Welle ist λ = c · VF / f mit der Lichtgeschwindigkeit c = 299 792 458 m/s (exakt) und dem Verkürzungsfaktor VF des Mediums (1 im freien Raum, etwa 0,66 im Koaxkabel mit Vollpolyethylen). Je zwei der Größen f, VF und λ bestimmen die dritte; die halbe und die viertel Wellenlänge werden mitgeliefert. Beispiel: 145 MHz im freien Raum ergeben λ = 2,068 m."
  tags: [wavelength, lambda, frequency, velocity factor, speed of light, half wave, quarter wave, antenna, radio, rf, wellenlänge, frequenz, verkürzungsfaktor, lichtgeschwindigkeit, halbwelle, viertelwelle, antenne, funk, hf]
  source: "Wave relation λ = c/f with the exact speed of light c = 299 792 458 m/s (SI Brochure, BIPM); the velocity factor VF = v/c is the ratio of the propagation speed in the medium to c"
  vars:
    f: {dim: frequency, label: f, name: {en: "Frequency", de: "Frequenz"}, default: "145 MHz"}
    vf: {dim: number, label: VF, name: {en: "Velocity factor", de: "Verkürzungsfaktor"}, default: 1}
    wl: {dim: length, label: λ, name: {en: "Wavelength", de: "Wellenlänge"}, units: ["", "ft", "in"]}
  dof: 2
  rules:
    wl: ["299792458*vf/f"]
    f: ["299792458*vf/wl"]
    vf: ["wl*f/299792458"]
  derived:
    lhalf: {dim: length, label: λ/2, name: {en: "Half wavelength", de: "Halbe Wellenlänge"}, expr: "wl/2", units: ["", "ft", "in"]}
    lquarter: {dim: length, label: λ/4, name: {en: "Quarter wavelength", de: "Viertelwellenlänge"}, expr: "wl/4", units: ["", "ft", "in"]}
  checks:
    - {when: "vf > 1", warn: {en: "A velocity factor above 1 is not physical: the wave would be faster than light in vacuum.", de: "Ein Verkürzungsfaktor über 1 ist nicht physikalisch: die Welle wäre schneller als das Licht im Vakuum."}}
  formula: ["wl = 299792458 * vf / f"]

- id: dipole_length
  kind: calculator
  category: rf
  name: {cs: "Délka půlvlnného dipólu", da: "Halvbølgedipolens længde", de: "Länge des Halbwellendipols", el: "Μήκος διπόλου μισού κύματος", en: "Half-wave dipole length", es: "Longitud del dipolo de media onda", fr: "Longueur du dipôle demi-onde", hi: "अर्धतरंग द्विध्रुव की लंबाई", it: "Lunghezza del dipolo a mezz'onda", ja: "半波長ダイポールの長さ", nl: "Lengte van een halvegolfdipool", no: "Halvbølgedipolens lengde", pl: "Długość dipola półfalowego", pt: "Comprimento do dipolo de meia onda", sv: "Halvvågsdipolens längd", zh: "半波偶极子长度"}
  doc:
    en: "A resonant half-wave dipole is slightly shorter than half a free-space wavelength because of the end effect: L = K × c / (2 f), with a shortening factor K of about 0.95 for a wire dipole (the familiar 468 / f(MHz) feet corresponds to K ≈ 0.952). The quarter-wave length is half of L: one leg of the dipole, or a quarter-wave vertical over a ground plane. Example: 7.1 MHz (40 m band) gives L = 20.06 m. Trim for the lowest SWR; height, wire diameter and surroundings shift the resonance."
    de: "Ein resonanter Halbwellendipol ist wegen des Endeffekts etwas kürzer als die halbe Freiraumwellenlänge: L = K · c / (2 f), mit einem Verkürzungsfaktor K von etwa 0,95 für einen Drahtdipol (die bekannte Faustformel 468 / f(MHz) Fuß entspricht K ≈ 0,952). Die Viertelwellenlänge ist die Hälfte von L: ein Schenkel des Dipols oder ein Viertelwellenstrahler über einer Groundplane. Beispiel: 7,1 MHz (40-m-Band) ergeben L = 20,06 m. Auf das SWR-Minimum abgleichen; Höhe, Drahtdurchmesser und Umgebung verschieben die Resonanz."
  tags: [dipole, antenna, half wave, quarter wave, 468, wire antenna, length, ham radio, amateur radio, dipol, antenne, halbwellendipol, viertelwelle, drahtantenne, länge, funkamateur, amateurfunk]
  source: "Half-wave dipole L = K·c/(2f) with the end-effect shortening factor K (about 0.95); the rule of thumb 468/f(MHz) feet is widely published, e.g. The ARRL Antenna Book (dipole antennas) and J. D. Kraus: Antennas"
  vars:
    f: {dim: frequency, label: f, name: {en: "Frequency", de: "Frequenz"}, default: "7.1 MHz"}
    k: {dim: number, label: K, name: {en: "Shortening factor", de: "Verkürzungsfaktor"}, default: 0.95}
    lhalf: {dim: length, label: L, name: {en: "Half-wave length", de: "Länge des Halbwellendipols"}, units: ["", "ft", "in"]}
  dof: 2
  rules:
    lhalf: ["k*299792458/(2*f)"]
    f: ["k*299792458/(2*lhalf)"]
    k: ["2*f*lhalf/299792458"]
  derived:
    lquarter: {dim: length, label: L/2, name: {en: "Quarter-wave length", de: "Viertelwellenlänge"}, expr: "lhalf/2", units: ["", "ft", "in"]}
  checks:
    - {when: "k > 1", warn: {en: "A shortening factor above 1 is unusual: the end effect makes a resonant dipole shorter than half the free-space wavelength.", de: "Ein Verkürzungsfaktor über 1 ist ungewöhnlich: Der Endeffekt macht einen resonanten Dipol kürzer als die halbe Freiraumwellenlänge."}}
  formula: ["lhalf = k * 299792458 / (2 * f)", "lquarter = lhalf / 2"]

- id: microstrip_impedance
  kind: calculator
  category: rf
  name: {cs: "Impedance mikropáskového vedení", da: "Mikrostrip-impedans", de: "Mikrostrip-Impedanz", el: "Αντίσταση γραμμής microstrip", en: "Microstrip impedance", es: "Impedancia de microstrip", fr: "Impédance d'une ligne microruban", hi: "माइक्रोस्ट्रिप प्रतिबाधा", it: "Impedenza della microstriscia", ja: "マイクロストリップ線路の特性インピーダンス", nl: "Microstrip-impedantie", no: "Mikrostrip-impedans", pl: "Impedancja linii mikropaskowej", pt: "Impedância de microstrip", sv: "Mikrostrip-impedans", zh: "微带线特性阻抗"}
  doc:
    en: "Characteristic impedance of a surface microstrip line on a PCB by the IPC-2141 approximation: Z_0 = 87 / √(ε_r + 1.41) × ln(5.98 h / (0.8 w + t)), with the dielectric thickness h, the trace width w and the copper thickness t. The formula is usually quoted for 0.1 < w/h < 2.0 and 1 < ε_r < 15; outside that range the result is only a rough guide and a warning appears. Use it for a first design and have critical lines checked with a field solver or the impedance data of the board maker. Example: a 3 mm trace on 1.6 mm FR-4 (ε_r ≈ 4.3, 1 oz copper) gives about 49.8 Ω. ε_r depends on the laminate and the frequency: use the datasheet value."
    de: "Wellenwiderstand einer Mikrostrip-Leitung an der Oberfläche einer Leiterplatte nach der Näherung der IPC-2141: Z_0 = 87 / √(ε_r + 1,41) · ln(5,98 h / (0,8 w + t)) mit der Dielektrikumsdicke h, der Leiterbahnbreite w und der Kupferdicke t. Die Formel wird üblicherweise für 0,1 < w/h < 2,0 und 1 < ε_r < 15 angegeben; außerhalb ist das Ergebnis nur ein grober Anhalt und eine Warnung erscheint. Für einen ersten Entwurf geeignet; kritische Leitungen mit einem Feldlöser oder den Impedanzdaten des Leiterplattenherstellers prüfen. Beispiel: 3 mm Leiterbahn auf 1,6 mm FR-4 (ε_r ≈ 4,3, 1 oz Kupfer) ergibt etwa 49,8 Ω. ε_r hängt vom Laminat und von der Frequenz ab: den Datenblattwert verwenden."
  tags: [microstrip, pcb, impedance, transmission line, trace width, 50 ohm, ipc-2141, controlled impedance, rf, mikrostrip, leiterplatte, impedanz, wellenwiderstand, leiterbahnbreite, leitung, impedanzkontrolliert, hf]
  source: "IPC-2141 (design guide for high-speed controlled impedance circuit boards), surface microstrip approximation Z0 = 87/√(εr+1.41)·ln(5.98h/(0.8w+t)), as commonly quoted for 0.1 < w/h < 2.0 and 1 < εr < 15"
  vars:
    er: {dim: number, label: ε_r, name: {en: "Relative permittivity", de: "Relative Permittivität"}, default: 4.3}
    h: {dim: length, label: h, name: {en: "Dielectric thickness", de: "Dicke des Dielektrikums"}, default: "1.6 mm", units: ["", "mil", "in"]}
    w: {dim: length, label: w, name: {en: "Trace width", de: "Leiterbahnbreite"}, default: "3 mm", units: ["", "mil", "in"]}
    t: {dim: length, label: t, name: {en: "Copper thickness", de: "Kupferdicke"}, default: "1 oz", unit: oz, units: ["", "oz", "mil"]}
    z0: {dim: resistance, label: Z_0, name: {en: "Characteristic impedance", de: "Wellenwiderstand"}}
  dof: 4
  rules:
    z0: ["87/sqrt(er+1.41)*ln(5.98*h/(0.8*w+t))"]
    er: ["(87*ln(5.98*h/(0.8*w+t))/z0)^2-1.41"]
    h: ["(0.8*w+t)*exp(z0*sqrt(er+1.41)/87)/5.98"]
    w: ["(5.98*h*exp(-z0*sqrt(er+1.41)/87)-t)/0.8"]
    t: ["5.98*h*exp(-z0*sqrt(er+1.41)/87)-0.8*w"]
  derived:
    wh: {dim: number, label: w/h, name: {en: "Width-to-height ratio", de: "Verhältnis Breite zu Höhe"}, expr: "w/h"}
  checks:
    - {when: "wh < 0.1", warn: {en: "w/h is below 0.1: outside the range the IPC-2141 approximation is quoted for (0.1 to 2.0), expect a larger error.", de: "w/h liegt unter 0,1: außerhalb des Bereichs, für den die IPC-2141-Näherung angegeben wird (0,1 bis 2,0), ist mit einem größeren Fehler zu rechnen."}}
    - {when: "wh > 2", warn: {en: "w/h is above 2.0: outside the range the IPC-2141 approximation is quoted for (0.1 to 2.0), expect a larger error.", de: "w/h liegt über 2,0: außerhalb des Bereichs, für den die IPC-2141-Näherung angegeben wird (0,1 bis 2,0), ist mit einem größeren Fehler zu rechnen."}}
    - {when: "if(er < 1, 1, er > 15)", warn: {en: "ε_r is outside the range 1 to 15 the approximation is quoted for.", de: "ε_r liegt außerhalb des Bereichs 1 bis 15, für den die Näherung angegeben wird."}}
  formula: ["z0 = 87 / sqrt(er + 1.41) * ln(5.98 * h / (0.8 * w + t))"]

- id: coax_impedance
  kind: calculator
  category: rf
  name: {cs: "Impedance koaxiálního kabelu", da: "Koaksialkablets impedans", de: "Wellenwiderstand eines Koaxialkabels", el: "Χαρακτηριστική αντίσταση ομοαξονικού καλωδίου", en: "Coaxial cable impedance", es: "Impedancia de un cable coaxial", fr: "Impédance d'un câble coaxial", hi: "समाक्षीय केबल की प्रतिबाधा", it: "Impedenza del cavo coassiale", ja: "同軸ケーブルの特性インピーダンス", nl: "Impedantie van een coaxkabel", no: "Koaksialkabelens impedans", pl: "Impedancja kabla koncentrycznego", pt: "Impedância de um cabo coaxial", sv: "Koaxialkabelns impedans", zh: "同轴电缆特性阻抗"}
  doc:
    en: "Characteristic impedance of a lossless coaxial line: Z_0 = (η_0 / 2π) / √ε_r × ln(D / d), with η_0 / 2π = 59.958 Ω (η_0 = μ_0·c ≈ 376.73 Ω), the inner diameter D of the shield, the diameter d of the inner conductor and the relative permittivity ε_r of the dielectric. This is the same as the familiar 138 / √ε_r × log10(D / d). The velocity factor is 1 / √ε_r. Example: solid polyethylene (ε_r = 2.25) with D / d = 3.5 gives about 50 Ω (VF 0.667). PTFE has ε_r ≈ 2.1."
    de: "Wellenwiderstand einer verlustfreien Koaxialleitung: Z_0 = (η_0 / 2π) / √ε_r · ln(D / d), mit η_0 / 2π = 59,958 Ω (η_0 = μ_0·c ≈ 376,73 Ω), dem Innendurchmesser D des Außenleiters, dem Durchmesser d des Innenleiters und der relativen Permittivität ε_r des Dielektrikums. Das entspricht der bekannten Form 138 / √ε_r · log10(D / d). Der Verkürzungsfaktor ist 1 / √ε_r. Beispiel: Vollpolyethylen (ε_r = 2,25) mit D / d = 3,5 ergibt etwa 50 Ω (VF 0,667). PTFE hat ε_r ≈ 2,1."
  tags: [coax, coaxial cable, impedance, characteristic impedance, dielectric, velocity factor, 50 ohm, 75 ohm, rg58, transmission line, rf, koaxkabel, koaxialkabel, wellenwiderstand, impedanz, dielektrikum, verkürzungsfaktor, leitung, hf]
  source: "Lossless coaxial line Z0 = (η0/2π)·ln(D/d)/√εr with η0 = μ0·c ≈ 376.73 Ω; D. M. Pozar: Microwave Engineering, ch. 2 (transmission line theory)"
  vars:
    er: {dim: number, label: ε_r, name: {en: "Relative permittivity of the dielectric", de: "Relative Permittivität des Dielektrikums"}, default: 2.25}
    dout: {dim: length, label: D, name: {en: "Inner diameter of the shield", de: "Innendurchmesser des Außenleiters"}, default: "3.5 mm", units: ["", "mil", "in"]}
    din: {dim: length, label: d, name: {en: "Diameter of the inner conductor", de: "Durchmesser des Innenleiters"}, default: "1 mm", units: ["", "mil", "in", "AWG"]}
    z0: {dim: resistance, label: Z_0, name: {en: "Characteristic impedance", de: "Wellenwiderstand"}}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    z0: ["59.95849163/sqrt(er)*ln(dout/din)"]
    er: ["(59.95849163*ln(dout/din)/z0)^2"]
    dout: ["din*exp(z0*sqrt(er)/59.95849163)"]
    din: ["dout/exp(z0*sqrt(er)/59.95849163)"]
  derived:
    vfac: {dim: number, label: VF, name: {en: "Velocity factor", de: "Verkürzungsfaktor"}, expr: "1/sqrt(er)"}
  checks:
    - {when: "din >= dout", warn: {en: "The inner conductor diameter d must be smaller than the inner diameter D of the shield.", de: "Der Durchmesser d des Innenleiters muss kleiner sein als der Innendurchmesser D des Außenleiters."}}
  formula: ["z0 = 59.95849163 / sqrt(er) * ln(dout / din)", "vfac = 1 / sqrt(er)"]

- id: swr_return_loss
  kind: calculator
  category: rf
  name: {cs: "PSV a útlum odrazu", da: "SWR og returtab", de: "SWR und Rückflussdämpfung", el: "SWR και απώλεια επιστροφής", en: "SWR and return loss", es: "ROE y pérdida de retorno", fr: "ROS et perte de retour", hi: "एसडब्ल्यूआर और रिटर्न लॉस", it: "ROS e perdita di ritorno", ja: "VSWRとリターンロス", nl: "SWR en retourverlies", no: "SWR og returtap", pl: "WFS i tłumienie odbicia", pt: "ROE e perda de retorno", sv: "SWR och returförlust", zh: "驻波比与回波损耗"}
  doc:
    en: "A mismatch reflects part of the wave. With the magnitude of the reflection coefficient |Γ|: SWR = (1 + |Γ|) / (1 − |Γ|), return loss RL = −20 log10 |Γ| (larger means a better match) and mismatch loss = −10 log10 (1 − |Γ|²), the power lost to reflection. |Γ|² is the reflected fraction of the power. Enter any one of SWR, |Γ| or RL. Example: SWR 2:1 gives |Γ| = 0.333, RL = 9.54 dB, a mismatch loss of 0.51 dB and 11.1 % reflected power."
    de: "Eine Fehlanpassung reflektiert einen Teil der Welle. Mit dem Betrag des Reflexionsfaktors |Γ| gilt: SWR = (1 + |Γ|) / (1 − |Γ|), Rückflussdämpfung RL = −20 log10 |Γ| (größer heißt besser angepasst) und Fehlanpassungsdämpfung = −10 log10 (1 − |Γ|²), die durch Reflexion verlorene Leistung. |Γ|² ist der reflektierte Anteil der Leistung. Eine der Größen SWR, |Γ| oder RL eingeben. Beispiel: SWR 2:1 ergibt |Γ| = 0,333, RL = 9,54 dB, eine Fehlanpassungsdämpfung von 0,51 dB und 11,1 % reflektierte Leistung."
  tags: [swr, vswr, return loss, reflection coefficient, mismatch, mismatch loss, antenna, transmission line, reflected power, rf, stehwellenverhältnis, rückflussdämpfung, reflexionsfaktor, fehlanpassung, fehlanpassungsdämpfung, antenne, reflektierte leistung, hf]
  source: "Reflection coefficient Γ, standing wave ratio, return loss and mismatch loss (definitions); D. M. Pozar: Microwave Engineering, ch. 2 (transmission line theory)"
  vars:
    swr: {dim: number, label: SWR, name: {en: "Standing wave ratio", de: "Stehwellenverhältnis"}, default: 2}
    gamma: {dim: ratio, label: "|Γ|", name: {en: "Reflection coefficient |Γ|", de: "Reflexionsfaktor |Γ|"}}
    rl: {dim: gain, label: RL, name: {en: "Return loss", de: "Rückflussdämpfung"}}
  dof: 1
  rules:
    swr: ["(1+gamma)/(1-gamma)"]
    gamma: ["(swr-1)/(swr+1)", "10^(-rl/20)"]
    rl: ["-20*log10(gamma)"]
  derived:
    prefl: {dim: ratio, label: "|Γ|²", name: {en: "Reflected power", de: "Reflektierte Leistung"}, expr: "gamma^2", unit: pct}
    ml: {dim: gain, label: ML, name: {en: "Mismatch loss", de: "Fehlanpassungsdämpfung"}, expr: "-10*log10(1-gamma^2)"}
  checks:
    - {when: "swr < 1", warn: {en: "An SWR below 1 is not possible: the SWR is at least 1 (a perfect match).", de: "Ein SWR unter 1 ist nicht möglich: Das SWR beträgt mindestens 1 (perfekte Anpassung)."}}
    - {when: "gamma > 1", warn: {en: "|Γ| above 1 is not possible for a passive load: it cannot reflect more than it receives.", de: "|Γ| über 1 ist bei einer passiven Last nicht möglich: Sie kann nicht mehr reflektieren, als sie erhält."}}
  formula: ["swr = (1 + gamma) / (1 - gamma)", "rl = -20 * log10(gamma)", "ml = -10 * log10(1 - gamma^2)"]

- id: rf_power_levels
  kind: calculator
  category: rf
  name: {cs: "Výkon a napětí v RF (dBm, dBµV)", da: "RF-effekt og -spænding (dBm, dBµV)", de: "HF-Leistung und -Spannung (dBm, dBµV)", el: "Ισχύς και τάση RF (dBm, dBµV)", en: "RF power and voltage (dBm, dBµV)", es: "Potencia y tensión de RF (dBm, dBµV)", fr: "Puissance et tension RF (dBm, dBµV)", hi: "आरएफ शक्ति और वोल्टेज (dBm, dBµV)", it: "Potenza e tensione RF (dBm, dBµV)", ja: "RF電力と電圧（dBm、dBµV）", nl: "RF-vermogen en -spanning (dBm, dBµV)", no: "RF-effekt og -spenning (dBm, dBµV)", pl: "Moc i napięcie RF (dBm, dBµV)", pt: "Potência e tensão de RF (dBm, dBµV)", sv: "RF-effekt och -spänning (dBm, dBµV)", zh: "射频功率与电压（dBm、dBµV）"}
  doc:
    en: "Converts between power, voltage and the logarithmic RF levels of a sine wave across a resistance R (usually 50 Ω): P = V_rms² / R and V_pp = 2√2 × V_rms. dBm is relative to 1 mW (10 log10 (P / 1 mW)), dBµV to 1 µV (20 log10 (V / 1 µV)); across 50 Ω dBµV = dBm + 107. Enter two of P, R, V_rms and V_pp (V_rms and V_pp alone are not enough). To enter a level in dBm choose dBm in the unit menu of the power field. Example: 0 dBm (1 mW) into 50 Ω is 223.6 mV rms, 632.5 mV peak to peak and 107 dBµV."
    de: "Rechnet für eine Sinusspannung an einem Widerstand R (meist 50 Ω) zwischen Leistung, Spannung und den logarithmischen HF-Pegeln um: P = V_eff² / R und V_ss = 2√2 · V_eff. dBm bezieht sich auf 1 mW (10 log10 (P / 1 mW)), dBµV auf 1 µV (20 log10 (V / 1 µV)); an 50 Ω gilt dBµV = dBm + 107. Zwei der Größen P, R, V_eff und V_ss eingeben (V_eff und V_ss allein reichen nicht). Einen Pegel in dBm gibt man über das Einheitenmenü des Leistungsfelds ein. Beispiel: 0 dBm (1 mW) an 50 Ω sind 223,6 mV effektiv, 632,5 mV Spitze-Spitze und 107 dBµV."
  tags: [dbm, dbuv, dbµv, rf power, level, 50 ohm, milliwatt, microvolt, peak to peak, rms, signal level, rf, hf-leistung, pegel, effektivwert, spitze-spitze, signalpegel, hf]
  source: "Definitions: dBm = 10·log10(P / 1 mW), dBµV = 20·log10(V / 1 µV), P = V_rms²/R and V_pp = 2√2·V_rms for a sine wave; decibel per IEC 60027-3"
  vars:
    p: {dim: power, label: P, name: {en: "Power", de: "Leistung"}, default: "1 mW", units: ["", "dBm"]}
    r: {dim: resistance, label: R, name: {en: "Resistance", de: "Widerstand"}, default: "50"}
    vrms: {dim: voltage, label: V_rms, name: {en: "RMS voltage", de: "Effektivspannung"}, units: ["", "dBuV"]}
    vpp: {dim: voltage, label: V_pp, name: {en: "Peak-to-peak voltage", de: "Spitze-Spitze-Spannung"}, units: [""]}
  dof: 2
  rules:
    p: ["vrms^2/r"]
    r: ["vrms^2/p"]
    vrms: ["sqrt(p*r)", "vpp/(2*sqrt(2))"]
    vpp: ["2*sqrt(2)*vrms"]
  derived:
    p_dbm: {dim: power, label: P_dBm, name: {en: "Power level", de: "Leistungspegel"}, expr: "p", unit: dBm}
    v_dbuv: {dim: voltage, label: V_dBµV, name: {en: "Voltage level re 1 µV", de: "Spannungspegel bezogen auf 1 µV"}, expr: "vrms", unit: dBuV}
  formula: ["p = vrms^2 / r", "vpp = 2 * sqrt(2) * vrms"]

- id: fspl
  kind: calculator
  category: rf
  name: {cs: "Útlum volným prostorem", da: "Dæmpning i frit rum", de: "Freiraumdämpfung", el: "Απώλεια διαδρομής ελεύθερου χώρου", en: "Free-space path loss", es: "Pérdida en el espacio libre", fr: "Affaiblissement en espace libre", hi: "मुक्त-स्थान पथ हानि", it: "Attenuazione nello spazio libero", ja: "自由空間伝搬損失", nl: "Vrije-ruimteverlies", no: "Demping i fritt rom", pl: "Tłumienie w wolnej przestrzeni", pt: "Perda no espaço livre", sv: "Frirymdsdämpning", zh: "自由空间路径损耗"}
  doc:
    en: "Free-space path loss between two isotropic antennas in the far field: FSPL = 20 log10 (4π d f / c) in dB, with the distance d, the frequency f and c = 299 792 458 m/s. Each doubling of the distance or the frequency adds 6.02 dB. It is the loss of the path alone, without antenna gains, cable loss or obstacles. Example: 1 km at 2.4 GHz gives 100.05 dB. The formula holds in the far field only (d much larger than λ); for d < λ / (4π) it would turn negative."
    de: "Freiraumdämpfung zwischen zwei isotropen Antennen im Fernfeld: FSPL = 20 log10 (4π d f / c) in dB mit dem Abstand d, der Frequenz f und c = 299 792 458 m/s. Jede Verdopplung von Abstand oder Frequenz fügt 6,02 dB hinzu. Es ist nur die Dämpfung der Strecke, ohne Antennengewinne, Kabeldämpfung oder Hindernisse. Beispiel: 1 km bei 2,4 GHz ergeben 100,05 dB. Die Formel gilt nur im Fernfeld (d deutlich größer als λ); für d < λ / (4π) würde die Dämpfung negativ."
  tags: [fspl, free space path loss, path loss, friis, link budget, attenuation, distance, wireless, radio, rf, freiraumdämpfung, streckendämpfung, funkfeld, dämpfung, entfernung, funk, hf]
  source: "Friis free-space transmission formula (H. T. Friis, 1946), FSPL = (4πdf/c)²; ITU-R Recommendation P.525 (calculation of free-space attenuation)"
  vars:
    d: {dim: length, label: d, name: {en: "Distance", de: "Abstand"}, default: "1 km", units: ["", "ft"]}
    f: {dim: frequency, label: f, name: {en: "Frequency", de: "Frequenz"}, default: "2.4 GHz"}
    loss: {dim: gain, label: FSPL, name: {en: "Free-space path loss", de: "Freiraumdämpfung"}}
  dof: 2
  rules:
    loss: ["20*log10(4*pi*d*f/299792458)"]
    d: ["299792458/(4*pi*f)*10^(loss/20)"]
    f: ["299792458/(4*pi*d)*10^(loss/20)"]
  derived:
    wl: {dim: length, label: λ, name: {en: "Wavelength", de: "Wellenlänge"}, expr: "299792458/f", units: ["", "ft", "in"]}
  checks:
    - {when: "loss < 0", warn: {en: "A negative loss: the distance is shorter than λ / (4π), far outside the far-field range of the formula.", de: "Negative Dämpfung: Der Abstand ist kürzer als λ / (4π), weit außerhalb des Fernfeldbereichs der Formel."}}
  formula: ["loss = 20 * log10(4 * pi * d * f / 299792458)"]

- id: skin_depth
  kind: calculator
  category: rf
  name: {cs: "Hloubka vniku (skinefekt)", da: "Skindybde", de: "Skin-Tiefe (Eindringtiefe)", el: "Βάθος διείσδυσης (επιδερμικό φαινόμενο)", en: "Skin depth", es: "Profundidad de penetración (efecto pelicular)", fr: "Épaisseur de peau", hi: "त्वचा गहराई (स्किन डेप्थ)", it: "Profondità di penetrazione (effetto pelle)", ja: "表皮深さ", nl: "Skindiepte", no: "Skinndybde", pl: "Głębokość wnikania (efekt naskórkowy)", pt: "Profundidade pelicular", sv: "Skinndjup", zh: "趋肤深度"}
  doc:
    en: "The skin depth δ = √(ρ / (π f μ_0 μ_r)) is the depth at which the current density of an alternating current in a good conductor has fallen to 1/e (about 37 %) of its surface value. Most of the current flows within a few δ of the surface, which raises the AC resistance of thick wires; R_s = ρ / δ is the surface resistance per square. Copper, silver, gold and aluminium are non-magnetic (μ_r = 1). The resistivities are values for 20 °C and change by about 0.4 % per kelvin; real wire and plating differ from the pure metal. Example: copper at 1 MHz has δ = 66.1 µm."
    de: "Die Skin-Tiefe δ = √(ρ / (π f μ_0 μ_r)) ist die Tiefe, in der die Stromdichte eines Wechselstroms in einem guten Leiter auf 1/e (etwa 37 %) ihres Wertes an der Oberfläche gefallen ist. Der meiste Strom fließt innerhalb weniger δ unter der Oberfläche, was den Wechselstromwiderstand dicker Drähte erhöht; R_s = ρ / δ ist der Oberflächenwiderstand pro Quadrat. Kupfer, Silber, Gold und Aluminium sind nicht magnetisch (μ_r = 1). Die spezifischen Widerstände gelten für 20 °C und ändern sich um etwa 0,4 % pro Kelvin; echter Draht und Beschichtungen weichen vom reinen Metall ab. Beispiel: Kupfer bei 1 MHz hat δ = 66,1 µm."
  tags: [skin depth, skin effect, penetration depth, conductor, copper, ac resistance, surface resistance, rf, skin-tiefe, skineffekt, eindringtiefe, leiter, kupfer, wechselstromwiderstand, oberflächenwiderstand, hf]
  source: "Skin depth δ = √(ρ/(π f μ0 μr)) in a good conductor (D. M. Pozar: Microwave Engineering, ch. 1) with μ0 = 4π·10^-7 H/m; resistivity at 20 °C: copper 1.7241e-8 Ω·m (annealed copper standard, 58 MS/m, IEC 60028), silver 1.587e-8, gold 2.214e-8 and aluminium 2.65e-8 Ω·m (pure-metal handbook values, e.g. CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics)"
  vars:
    f: {dim: frequency, label: f, name: {en: "Frequency", de: "Frequenz"}, default: "1 MHz"}
    delta: {dim: length, label: δ, name: {en: "Skin depth", de: "Skin-Tiefe"}, units: ["", "mil", "in"]}
  choices:
    material:
      name: {cs: "Materiál", da: "Materiale", de: "Material", el: "Υλικό", en: "Material", es: "Material", fr: "Matériau", hi: "सामग्री", it: "Materiale", ja: "材料", nl: "Materiaal", no: "Materiale", pl: "Materiał", pt: "Material", sv: "Material", zh: "材料"}
      default: copper
      options:
        copper:
          name: {cs: "Měď", da: "Kobber", de: "Kupfer", el: "Χαλκός", en: "Copper", es: "Cobre", fr: "Cuivre", hi: "तांबा", it: "Rame", ja: "銅", nl: "Koper", no: "Kobber", pl: "Miedź", pt: "Cobre", sv: "Koppar", zh: "铜"}
          consts: {rho: 1.7241e-8}
        silver:
          name: {cs: "Stříbro", da: "Sølv", de: "Silber", el: "Άργυρος", en: "Silver", es: "Plata", fr: "Argent", hi: "चांदी", it: "Argento", ja: "銀", nl: "Zilver", no: "Sølv", pl: "Srebro", pt: "Prata", sv: "Silver", zh: "银"}
          consts: {rho: 1.587e-8}
        gold:
          name: {cs: "Zlato", da: "Guld", de: "Gold", el: "Χρυσός", en: "Gold", es: "Oro", fr: "Or", hi: "सोना", it: "Oro", ja: "金", nl: "Goud", no: "Gull", pl: "Złoto", pt: "Ouro", sv: "Guld", zh: "金"}
          consts: {rho: 2.214e-8}
        aluminium:
          name: {cs: "Hliník", da: "Aluminium", de: "Aluminium", el: "Αλουμίνιο", en: "Aluminium", es: "Aluminio", fr: "Aluminium", hi: "एल्युमिनियम", it: "Alluminio", ja: "アルミニウム", nl: "Aluminium", no: "Aluminium", pl: "Aluminium", pt: "Alumínio", sv: "Aluminium", zh: "铝"}
          consts: {rho: 2.65e-8}
  dof: 1
  rules:
    delta: ["sqrt(rho/(pi*f*4*pi*1e-7))"]
    f: ["rho/(pi*delta^2*4*pi*1e-7)"]
  derived:
    rs: {dim: resistance, label: R_s, name: {en: "Surface resistance per square", de: "Oberflächenwiderstand pro Quadrat"}, expr: "rho/delta"}
  formula: ["delta = sqrt(rho / (pi * f * 4 * pi * 1e-7))", "rs = rho / delta"]
```

    {"values": {"vref": 2.5, "bits": 8, "vin": 1, "lsb": 0.009765625, "code": 102, "code_hex": 102, "code_bin": 102}, "ref": "hand: LSB = 2.5 V / 256 = 0.009765625 V; 1 V / LSB = 102.4, floor = 102 = 0x66 (64 + 32 + 4 + 2)"},
    {"values": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 12, "vin": 3.3, "lsb": 0.0008056640625, "code": 4095, "code_hex": 4095, "code_bin": 4095}, "ref": "hand: LSB = 3.3 V / 4096; 3.3 V / LSB = 4096 is above the largest code, so the code is clamped to 4095 = 0xFFF (twelve one bits)"},

    {"inputs": {"vref": 5, "bits": 10, "vin": 2.5}, "expect": {"lsb": 0.0048828125, "code": 512}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: LSB = 5 / 1024 V; 2.5 / LSB = 512 exactly, code 512"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 2.5, "bits": 8, "vin": 1}, "expect": {"lsb": 0.009765625, "code": 102}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: LSB = 2.5 / 256 V; floor(1 / LSB) = floor(102.4) = 102"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 12, "vin": 3.3}, "expect": {"code": 4095}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: V_in = V_ref gives 4096, clamped to 4095; the V_in >= V_ref check fires"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 12, "vin": 5}, "expect": {"code": 4095}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: 5 V / 0.0008056640625 V = 6206 is above the largest code, clamped to 4095; the V_in >= V_ref check fires"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 12, "vin": -0.5}, "expect": {"code": 0}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [1], "ref": "hand: floor(-620.6) = -621, clamped to 0; the negative-input check fires"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 8, "vin": 0.01}, "expect": {"lsb": 0.012890625, "code": 0}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: LSB = 3.3 / 256 = 0.012890625 V; 0.01 V / LSB = 0.7757, floor = 0"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 0, "vin": 1}, "expect": {"lsb": 3.3, "code": 0}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [2], "ref": "hand: 0 bits leave one code: LSB = 3.3 V, code = min(max(floor(0.303), 0), 2^0 - 1) = 0; the bits < 1 check fires"},

{

    {"values": {"vref": 5, "bits": 8, "code": 51, "vout": 0.99609375, "lsb": 0.01953125}, "ref": "hand: LSB = 5 / 256 = 0.01953125 V; V_out = 51 * 0.01953125 = 0.99609375 V"},
    {"values": {"vref": 2.5, "bits": 16, "code": 65535, "vout": 2.4999618530273438, "lsb": 3.814697265625e-05}, "ref": "hand: LSB = 2.5 / 65536 = 0.00003814697265625 V; V_out = 65535 * LSB = 2.5 - LSB = 2.49996185302734375 V (full scale is one LSB below V_ref)"},
    {"values": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 10, "code": 1000, "vout": 3.22265625, "lsb": 0.00322265625}, "ref": "hand: LSB = 3.3 / 1024 = 0.00322265625 V; V_out = 1000 * 0.00322265625 = 3.22265625 V"}
  ],
  "solve": [
    {"inputs": {"vref": 5, "bits": 8, "code": 128}, "expect": {"vout": 2.5, "lsb": 0.01953125}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: V_out = 128 * 5 / 256 = 2.5 V; LSB = 0.01953125 V"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 12, "code": 2048}, "expect": {"vout": 1.65}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: V_out = 2048 * 3.3 / 4096 = 1.65 V (the default example)"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 5, "bits": 8, "code": 51}, "expect": {"vout": 0.99609375}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: V_out = 51 * 5 / 256 = 255 / 256 = 0.99609375 V"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 12, "code": 0}, "expect": {"vout": 0}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: code 0 gives 0 V"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 5, "bits": 8, "code": 256}, "expect": {"vout": 5}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [0], "ref": "hand: code 256 does not fit 8 bits (largest 255); V_out = 256 * 5 / 256 = 5 V and the code check fires"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 5, "bits": 8, "vout": 2.5}, "expect": {"code": 128}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: code = round(2.5 * 256 / 5) = round(128) = 128"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 12, "vout": 1}, "expect": {"code": 1241}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: code = round(1 * 4096 / 3.3) = round(1241.2121) = 1241 (the nearest code, so the real output is 1241 * LSB = 0.99985 V)"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 2.5, "bits": 16, "vout": 2.4999618530273438}, "expect": {"code": 65535}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: code = round(2.49996185302734375 * 65536 / 2.5) = round(65535) = 65535"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 4, "bits": 2, "vout": 1.5}, "expect": {"code": 2}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: LSB = 4 / 4 = 1 V; 1.5 V is exactly half way between codes 1 and 2, round takes the code away from zero: 2"},
    {"inputs": {"bits": 8, "code": 128, "vout": 2.5}, "expect": {"vref": 5}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: V_ref = 2.5 * 256 / 128 = 5 V"},
    {"inputs": {"bits": 12, "code": 2048, "vout": 1.65}, "expect": {"vref": 3.3}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: V_ref = 1.65 * 4096 / 2048 = 3.3 V"},
    {"inputs": {"bits": 10, "code": 1000, "vout": 3.22265625}, "expect": {"vref": 3.3}, "errors": {}, "warnings": [], "ref": "hand: V_ref = 3.22265625 * 1024 / 1000 = 3300 / 1000 = 3.3 V"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "bits": 12, "vout": -1}, "errors": {"code": "range"}, "ref": "hand: code = round(-1 * 4096 / 3.3) = -1241 is not a valid code (below 0), out of range"},
    {"inputs": {"vref": 3.3, "code": 2048, "vout": 1.65}, "errors": {"bits": "undetermined"}, "ref": "hand: the number of bits cannot be computed from the other three, so it stays undetermined"}
  ]
}

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `digital.yaml`**

Create `internal/ecalc/catalog/calculators/digital.yaml` with exactly this content:

```yaml
# Digital calculators. Every name is written in all 16 desktop locales; docs, variable names and warnings in English and
# German (other languages fall back to English). Rules are written out for every direction, in the order the solver
# tries them: the first alternative whose variables are all known wins. Calculators without rules (ADC, UART) are
# forward-only: all inputs, only derived outputs.

- id: adc
  kind: calculator
  category: digital
  name: {cs: "AD převodník (napětí → kód)", da: "AD-konverter (spænding → kode)", de: "ADC (Spannung → Code)", el: "ADC (τάση → κωδικός)", en: "ADC (voltage to code)", es: "ADC (tensión a código)", fr: "CAN (tension vers code)", hi: "ADC (वोल्टेज से कोड)", it: "ADC (tensione → codice)", ja: "ADC（電圧→コード）", nl: "ADC (spanning naar code)", no: "ADC (spenning til kode)", pl: "Przetwornik ADC (napięcie → kod)", pt: "ADC (tensão para código)", sv: "ADC (spänning till kod)", zh: "ADC（电压转数字码）"}
  doc:
    en: "An ideal N-bit analog-to-digital converter divides the reference range V_ref into 2^N steps of one LSB = V_ref / 2^N and outputs the code floor(V_in / LSB), limited to 0 … 2^N − 1 (straight binary, unipolar). The code is shown in decimal, hexadecimal and binary. Real converters add offset, gain and linearity errors, and some round to the nearest code instead of truncating; check the datasheet. Example: 12 bit with V_ref = 3.3 V has an LSB of 0.806 mV, and 1 V reads as code 1241 (0x4D9)."
    de: "Ein idealer N-Bit-Analog-Digital-Wandler teilt den Referenzbereich V_ref in 2^N Stufen zu je einem LSB = V_ref / 2^N und liefert den Code floor(V_in / LSB), begrenzt auf 0 … 2^N − 1 (Straight-Binary, unipolar). Der Code wird dezimal, hexadezimal und binär angezeigt. Reale Wandler haben zusätzlich Offset-, Verstärkungs- und Linearitätsfehler, und manche runden auf den nächsten Code, statt abzuschneiden; das Datenblatt prüfen. Beispiel: 12 Bit mit V_ref = 3,3 V haben ein LSB von 0,806 mV, und 1 V ergibt den Code 1241 (0x4D9)."
  tags: [adc, analog to digital, converter, resolution, lsb, bits, quantization, code, microcontroller, ad-wandler, analog-digital-wandler, auflösung, quantisierung, mikrocontroller]
  source: "Ideal N-bit converter transfer function with LSB = V_ref/2^N (terminology of IEEE Std 1241 for analog-to-digital converters); P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed. (A/D and D/A conversion)"
  vars:
    vref: {dim: voltage, label: V_ref, name: {en: "Reference voltage", de: "Referenzspannung"}, default: "3.3 V"}
    bits: {dim: integer, label: N, name: {en: "Resolution in bits", de: "Auflösung in Bit"}, default: 12, unit: dec, units: ["dec"]}
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "Input voltage", de: "Eingangsspannung"}, default: "1 V"}
  dof: 3
  derived:
    lsb: {dim: voltage, label: LSB, name: {en: "LSB (step size)", de: "LSB (Schrittweite)"}, expr: "vref/2^bits"}
    code: {dim: integer, label: Code, name: {en: "Code (decimal)", de: "Code (dezimal)"}, expr: "min(max(floor(vin/lsb),0),2^bits-1)", unit: dec}
    code_hex: {dim: integer, label: Code_hex, name: {en: "Code (hexadecimal)", de: "Code (hexadezimal)"}, expr: "code", unit: hex}
    code_bin: {dim: integer, label: Code_bin, name: {en: "Code (binary)", de: "Code (binär)"}, expr: "code", unit: bin}
  checks:
    - {when: "vin >= vref", warn: {en: "V_in is at or above V_ref: the code is clamped to full scale (2^N − 1).", de: "V_in liegt bei oder über V_ref: Der Code wird auf Vollausschlag (2^N − 1) begrenzt."}}
    - {when: "vin < 0", warn: {en: "V_in is negative: a unipolar ADC reads code 0.", de: "V_in ist negativ: Ein unipolarer ADC liest den Code 0."}}
    - {when: "bits < 1", warn: {en: "A resolution below 1 bit leaves a single code.", de: "Eine Auflösung unter 1 Bit lässt nur einen einzigen Code übrig."}}
  formula: ["lsb = vref / 2^bits", "code = floor(vin / lsb)"]

- id: dac
  kind: calculator
  category: digital
  name: {cs: "DA převodník (kód → napětí)", da: "DA-konverter (kode → spænding)", de: "DAC (Code → Spannung)", el: "DAC (κωδικός → τάση)", en: "DAC (code to voltage)", es: "DAC (código a tensión)", fr: "CNA (code vers tension)", hi: "DAC (कोड से वोल्टेज)", it: "DAC (codice → tensione)", ja: "DAC（コード→電圧）", nl: "DAC (code naar spanning)", no: "DAC (kode til spenning)", pl: "Przetwornik DAC (kod → napięcie)", pt: "DAC (código para tensão)", sv: "DAC (kod till spänning)", zh: "DAC（数字码转电压）"}
  doc:
    en: "An ideal N-bit digital-to-analog converter outputs V_out = code × V_ref / 2^N for a code of 0 … 2^N − 1 (straight binary, unipolar). One LSB is V_ref / 2^N; the full-scale code gives V_ref − 1 LSB. From V_ref, N and a code the output voltage follows; from V_ref, N and a wanted V_out the nearest code is found (rounded, so the real output of that code differs slightly). The number of bits N must be entered, it cannot be computed. Real converters have offset, gain and linearity errors. Example: 12 bit, V_ref = 3.3 V and code 2048 give 1.65 V."
    de: "Ein idealer N-Bit-Digital-Analog-Wandler liefert V_out = Code × V_ref / 2^N für einen Code von 0 … 2^N − 1 (Straight-Binary, unipolar). Ein LSB ist V_ref / 2^N; der Vollausschlag-Code ergibt V_ref − 1 LSB. Aus V_ref, N und einem Code folgt die Ausgangsspannung; aus V_ref, N und einer gewünschten V_out wird der nächstliegende Code gefunden (gerundet, die echte Ausgangsspannung dieses Codes weicht also etwas ab). Die Bitzahl N muss eingegeben werden, sie lässt sich nicht berechnen. Reale Wandler haben Offset-, Verstärkungs- und Linearitätsfehler. Beispiel: 12 Bit, V_ref = 3,3 V und Code 2048 ergeben 1,65 V."
  tags: [dac, digital to analog, converter, resolution, lsb, bits, code, microcontroller, da-wandler, digital-analog-wandler, auflösung, mikrocontroller]
  source: "Ideal N-bit converter transfer function V_out = code·V_ref/2^N; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed. (A/D and D/A conversion)"
  vars:
    vref: {dim: voltage, label: V_ref, name: {en: "Reference voltage", de: "Referenzspannung"}, default: "3.3 V"}
    bits: {dim: integer, label: N, name: {en: "Resolution in bits", de: "Auflösung in Bit"}, default: 12, unit: dec, units: ["dec"]}
    code: {dim: integer, label: Code, name: {en: "Code", de: "Code"}, default: 2048, unit: dec}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Output voltage", de: "Ausgangsspannung"}}
  dof: 3
  rules:
    vout: ["code*vref/2^bits"]
    code: ["round(vout*2^bits/vref)"]
    vref: ["vout*2^bits/code"]
  derived:
    lsb: {dim: voltage, label: LSB, name: {en: "LSB (step size)", de: "LSB (Schrittweite)"}, expr: "vref/2^bits"}
  checks:
    - {when: "code >= 2^bits", warn: {en: "The code does not fit the resolution: the largest code is 2^N − 1.", de: "Der Code passt nicht zur Auflösung: Der größte Code ist 2^N − 1."}}
  formula: ["vout = code * vref / 2^bits", "lsb = vref / 2^bits"]

- id: i2c_pullup
  kind: calculator
  category: digital
  name: {cs: "Pull-up rezistory sběrnice I²C", da: "I²C pull-up-modstande", de: "I²C-Pull-up-Widerstände", el: "Αντιστάσεις pull-up I²C", en: "I²C pull-up resistors", es: "Resistencias pull-up de I²C", fr: "Résistances de rappel (pull-up) I²C", hi: "I²C पुल-अप प्रतिरोधक", it: "Resistori di pull-up I²C", ja: "I²Cプルアップ抵抗", nl: "I²C-pull-upweerstanden", no: "I²C pull-up-motstander", pl: "Rezystory podciągające I²C", pt: "Resistências de pull-up I²C", sv: "I²C pull-up-motstånd", zh: "I²C上拉电阻"}
  doc:
    en: "The pull-up resistor of an I²C line must be small enough to pull the line up within the allowed rise time and large enough for the driver to sink the current: R_max = t_r / (0.8473 × C_b) from the 30 % to 70 % rise of an RC network, and R_min = (V_DD − V_OL) / I_OL. t_r is the maximum rise time of the mode: 1000 ns (standard-mode), 300 ns (fast-mode) and 120 ns (fast-mode plus). Pick a standard value between R_min and R_max (the nearest E-series values are shown). The drivers of standard and fast-mode sink 3 mA at V_OL = 0.4 V, fast-mode plus drivers 20 mA: enter the value of your driver. Example: 3.3 V, 100 pF, standard-mode and 3 mA give 967 Ω ≤ R ≤ 11.8 kΩ (4.7 kΩ is a common choice)."
    de: "Der Pull-up-Widerstand einer I²C-Leitung muss klein genug sein, um die Leitung innerhalb der erlaubten Anstiegszeit hochzuziehen, und groß genug, dass der Treiber den Strom aufnehmen kann: R_max = t_r / (0,8473 · C_b) aus dem Anstieg eines RC-Glieds von 30 % auf 70 %, und R_min = (V_DD − V_OL) / I_OL. t_r ist die höchste zulässige Anstiegszeit des Modus: 1000 ns (Standard-Mode), 300 ns (Fast-Mode) und 120 ns (Fast-Mode Plus). Einen Normwert zwischen R_min und R_max wählen (die nächsten E-Reihen-Werte werden angezeigt). Die Treiber von Standard- und Fast-Mode nehmen bei V_OL = 0,4 V 3 mA auf, die von Fast-Mode Plus 20 mA: den Wert des eigenen Treibers eingeben. Beispiel: 3,3 V, 100 pF, Standard-Mode und 3 mA ergeben 967 Ω ≤ R ≤ 11,8 kΩ (4,7 kΩ ist eine übliche Wahl)."
  tags: [i2c, iic, twi, pull-up, pullup, resistor, sda, scl, rise time, bus capacitance, open drain, pull-up-widerstand, anstiegszeit, buskapazität, busleitung, open-drain]
  source: "NXP UM10204: I²C-bus specification and user manual (pull-up resistor sizing R_p(max) = t_r/(0.8473·C_b) and R_p(min) = (V_DD − V_OL(max))/I_OL; maximum rise times and bus capacitance of standard-mode, fast-mode and fast-mode plus)"
  vars:
    vdd: {dim: voltage, label: V_DD, name: {en: "Supply voltage", de: "Versorgungsspannung"}, default: "3.3 V"}
    vol: {dim: voltage, label: V_OL, name: {en: "Low-level output voltage", de: "Low-Pegel der Ausgangsspannung"}, default: "0.4 V"}
    iol: {dim: current, label: I_OL, name: {en: "Sink current at V_OL", de: "Senkstrom bei V_OL"}, default: "3 mA"}
    cb: {dim: capacitance, label: C_b, name: {en: "Bus capacitance", de: "Buskapazität"}, default: "100 pF"}
    rmin: {dim: resistance, label: R_min, name: {en: "Smallest pull-up", de: "Kleinster Pull-up"}, eseries: true}
    rmax: {dim: resistance, label: R_max, name: {en: "Largest pull-up", de: "Größter Pull-up"}, eseries: true}
  choices:
    mode:
      name: {cs: "Režim", da: "Tilstand", de: "Modus", el: "Λειτουργία", en: "Mode", es: "Modo", fr: "Mode", hi: "मोड", it: "Modalità", ja: "モード", nl: "Modus", no: "Modus", pl: "Tryb", pt: "Modo", sv: "Läge", zh: "模式"}
      default: standard
      options:
        standard:
          name: {cs: "Standardní režim (100 kHz)", da: "Standardtilstand (100 kHz)", de: "Standard-Mode (100 kHz)", el: "Τυπική λειτουργία (100 kHz)", en: "Standard-mode (100 kHz)", es: "Modo estándar (100 kHz)", fr: "Mode standard (100 kHz)", hi: "मानक मोड (100 kHz)", it: "Modalità standard (100 kHz)", ja: "スタンダードモード（100 kHz）", nl: "Standaardmodus (100 kHz)", no: "Standardmodus (100 kHz)", pl: "Tryb standardowy (100 kHz)", pt: "Modo padrão (100 kHz)", sv: "Standardläge (100 kHz)", zh: "标准模式（100 kHz）"}
          consts: {tr: 1.0e-6, cbmax: 4.0e-10}
        fast:
          name: {cs: "Rychlý režim (400 kHz)", da: "Hurtig tilstand (400 kHz)", de: "Fast-Mode (400 kHz)", el: "Γρήγορη λειτουργία (400 kHz)", en: "Fast-mode (400 kHz)", es: "Modo rápido (400 kHz)", fr: "Mode rapide (400 kHz)", hi: "फ़ास्ट मोड (400 kHz)", it: "Modalità veloce (400 kHz)", ja: "ファストモード（400 kHz）", nl: "Snelle modus (400 kHz)", no: "Rask modus (400 kHz)", pl: "Tryb szybki (400 kHz)", pt: "Modo rápido (400 kHz)", sv: "Snabbläge (400 kHz)", zh: "快速模式（400 kHz）"}
          consts: {tr: 3.0e-7, cbmax: 4.0e-10}
        fastplus:
          name: {cs: "Rychlý režim Plus (1 MHz)", da: "Hurtig tilstand Plus (1 MHz)", de: "Fast-Mode Plus (1 MHz)", el: "Γρήγορη λειτουργία Plus (1 MHz)", en: "Fast-mode Plus (1 MHz)", es: "Modo rápido Plus (1 MHz)", fr: "Mode rapide Plus (1 MHz)", hi: "फ़ास्ट मोड प्लस (1 MHz)", it: "Modalità veloce Plus (1 MHz)", ja: "ファストモードプラス（1 MHz）", nl: "Snelle modus Plus (1 MHz)", no: "Rask modus Plus (1 MHz)", pl: "Tryb szybki Plus (1 MHz)", pt: "Modo rápido Plus (1 MHz)", sv: "Snabbläge Plus (1 MHz)", zh: "快速模式增强版（1 MHz）"}
          consts: {tr: 1.2e-7, cbmax: 5.5e-10}
  dof: 4
  rules:
    rmin: ["(vdd-vol)/iol"]
    iol: ["(vdd-vol)/rmin"]
    vdd: ["vol+rmin*iol"]
    vol: ["vdd-rmin*iol"]
    rmax: ["tr/(0.8473*cb)"]
    cb: ["tr/(0.8473*rmax)"]
  checks:
    - {when: "rmin >= rmax", warn: {en: "R_min is not below R_max: no pull-up resistor meets both limits. Lower the bus capacitance, use a driver with a higher sink current, or choose a slower mode.", de: "R_min liegt nicht unter R_max: Kein Pull-up-Widerstand erfüllt beide Grenzen. Die Buskapazität verringern, einen Treiber mit höherem Senkstrom verwenden oder einen langsameren Modus wählen."}}
    - {when: "cb > cbmax", warn: {en: "C_b exceeds the maximum bus capacitance of the selected mode (400 pF; 550 pF in fast-mode plus).", de: "C_b überschreitet die größte Buskapazität des gewählten Modus (400 pF; 550 pF bei Fast-Mode Plus)."}}
  formula: ["rmin = (vdd - vol) / iol", "rmax = tr / (0.8473 * cb)"]
  schematic: i2c_pullup

- id: level_shift_divider
  kind: calculator
  category: digital
  name: {cs: "Převodník úrovní (odporový dělič)", da: "Niveauomsætter (modstandsdeler)", de: "Pegelwandler (Spannungsteiler)", el: "Μετατροπέας στάθμης (διαιρέτης τάσης)", en: "Level shifter (resistor divider)", es: "Adaptador de nivel (divisor resistivo)", fr: "Adaptateur de niveau (diviseur résistif)", hi: "लेवल शिफ्टर (प्रतिरोधक विभाजक)", it: "Adattatore di livello (partitore resistivo)", ja: "レベルシフタ（抵抗分圧）", nl: "Niveauconverter (weerstandsdeler)", no: "Nivåomformer (motstandsdeler)", pl: "Konwerter poziomów (dzielnik rezystancyjny)", pt: "Conversor de nível (divisor resistivo)", sv: "Nivåomvandlare (motståndsdelare)", zh: "电平转换（电阻分压）"}
  doc:
    en: "A resistor divider shifts a 5 V logic signal down to 3.3 V in one direction: V_out = V_in × R2 / (R1 + R2). The receiver sees a logic high only while V_out stays above its input-high threshold V_IH (take it from the datasheet: 2.0 V for 3.3 V LVTTL inputs, 0.7 × V_DD = 2.31 V is typical for CMOS inputs), and V_out must stay below the absolute maximum input voltage of the pin (often V_DD + 0.3 V). Enter the guaranteed high level of the driver as V_in. A divider loads the driver and slows the edges (R1 ∥ R2 with the pin capacitance); for fast or bidirectional signals such as I²C use a level-shifter IC or a MOSFET shifter. Example: 5 V into 1 kΩ / 2 kΩ gives 3.33 V, which is 1.33 V above V_IH = 2 V, at 1.67 mA."
    de: "Ein Widerstandsteiler setzt ein 5-V-Logiksignal in einer Richtung auf 3,3 V herunter: V_out = V_in · R2 / (R1 + R2). Der Empfänger erkennt nur dann High, wenn V_out über seiner Eingangsschwelle V_IH bleibt (aus dem Datenblatt: 2,0 V bei 3,3-V-LVTTL-Eingängen, 0,7 · V_DD = 2,31 V ist für CMOS-Eingänge typisch), und V_out muss unter der absoluten Höchstspannung des Eingangs bleiben (oft V_DD + 0,3 V). Als V_in den garantierten High-Pegel des Treibers eingeben. Ein Teiler belastet den Treiber und verlangsamt die Flanken (R1 ∥ R2 mit der Pinkapazität); für schnelle oder bidirektionale Signale wie I²C einen Pegelwandler-IC oder einen MOSFET-Pegelwandler verwenden. Beispiel: 5 V an 1 kΩ / 2 kΩ ergeben 3,33 V, also 1,33 V über V_IH = 2 V, bei 1,67 mA."
  tags: [level shifter, level shift, voltage divider, 5v to 3.3v, logic level, vih, gpio, microcontroller, pegelwandler, pegelanpassung, spannungsteiler, logikpegel, mikrocontroller]
  source: "Voltage divider rule; P. Horowitz, W. Hill: The Art of Electronics, 3rd ed. (logic interfacing); the input threshold V_IH comes from the datasheet of the receiving device"
  vars:
    vin: {dim: voltage, label: V_in, name: {en: "High level of the driver", de: "High-Pegel des Treibers"}, default: "5 V"}
    r1: {dim: resistance, label: R_1, name: {en: "Upper resistor", de: "Oberer Widerstand"}, default: "1k", eseries: true}
    r2: {dim: resistance, label: R_2, name: {en: "Lower resistor", de: "Unterer Widerstand"}, default: "2k", eseries: true}
    vih: {dim: voltage, label: V_IH, name: {en: "Input-high threshold of the receiver", de: "High-Schwelle des Empfängers"}, default: "2 V"}
    vout: {dim: voltage, label: V_out, name: {en: "Voltage at the receiver", de: "Spannung am Empfänger"}}
  dof: 4
  rules:
    vout: ["vin*r2/(r1+r2)"]
    r2: ["vout*r1/(vin-vout)"]
    r1: ["r2*(vin-vout)/vout"]
    vin: ["vout*(r1+r2)/r2"]
  derived:
    margin: {dim: voltage, label: ΔV, name: {en: "Margin above V_IH", de: "Reserve über V_IH"}, expr: "vout-vih"}
    i: {dim: current, label: I, name: {en: "Divider current", de: "Querstrom"}, expr: "vin/(r1+r2)"}
  checks:
    - {when: "vout < vih", warn: {en: "V_out is below V_IH: the receiver may not see a logic high.", de: "V_out liegt unter V_IH: Der Empfänger erkennt möglicherweise kein High."}}
    - {when: "vout >= vin", warn: {en: "V_out is not below V_in: a passive divider can only attenuate.", de: "V_out liegt nicht unter V_in: Ein passiver Teiler kann nur abschwächen."}}
  formula: ["vout = vin * r2 / (r1 + r2)", "margin = vout - vih"]
  schematic: level_shift_divider

- id: uart_baud_error
  kind: calculator
  category: digital
  name: {cs: "Chyba přenosové rychlosti UART", da: "UART-baudrate-fejl", de: "UART-Baudratenfehler", el: "Σφάλμα baud rate UART", en: "UART baud rate error", es: "Error de velocidad en baudios de UART", fr: "Erreur de débit en bauds UART", hi: "UART बॉड दर त्रुटि", it: "Errore di baud rate UART", ja: "UARTボーレート誤差", nl: "UART-baudrate-fout", no: "UART-baudratefeil", pl: "Błąd prędkości transmisji UART", pt: "Erro de baud rate da UART", sv: "UART-baudrate-fel", zh: "UART波特率误差"}
  doc:
    en: "A UART derives its bit clock by dividing the peripheral clock: baud = f_clk / (N × divisor), with N = 16 samples per bit (normal) or 8 (double-speed mode) and a whole-number divisor, so the real baud rate differs from the wanted one. The divisor is rounded to the nearest integer and the error is (actual − wanted) / wanted. As a rule of thumb keep it below ±2 %: the errors of sender and receiver add up, and an 8N1 frame tolerates only a few percent in total. Some UARTs have a fractional divider and do better. On some chips the register holds the divisor minus one. Example: 16 MHz and 115 200 Bd with 16× sampling gives divisor 9, 111 111 Bd and −3.55 %; double speed (8×) gives divisor 17 and +2.12 %; an 11.0592 MHz crystal hits 115 200 Bd exactly."
    de: "Ein UART erzeugt seinen Bittakt durch Teilen des Peripherietakts: Baud = f_clk / (N · Teiler) mit N = 16 Abtastungen pro Bit (normal) oder 8 (Double-Speed-Modus) und einem ganzzahligen Teiler, sodass die echte Baudrate von der gewünschten abweicht. Der Teiler wird auf die nächste ganze Zahl gerundet, der Fehler ist (tatsächlich − gewünscht) / gewünscht. Als Faustregel unter ±2 % bleiben: Die Fehler von Sender und Empfänger addieren sich, und ein 8N1-Rahmen verträgt insgesamt nur wenige Prozent. Manche UARTs haben einen gebrochenen Teiler und sind besser. Bei manchen Chips enthält das Register den Teiler minus eins. Beispiel: 16 MHz und 115 200 Bd mit 16-facher Abtastung ergeben Teiler 9, 111 111 Bd und −3,55 %; Double Speed (8×) ergibt Teiler 17 und +2,12 %; ein 11,0592-MHz-Quarz trifft 115 200 Bd genau."
  tags: [uart, usart, baud rate, baud, serial, divisor, error, oversampling, clock, rs232, avr, baudrate, serielle schnittstelle, teiler, fehler, abweichung, taktfrequenz]
  source: "UART baud-rate generator: baud = f_clk/(N·divisor) with N = 16 or 8 samples per bit; e.g. the USART chapter of the ATmega328P datasheet (Microchip), where the register holds the divisor minus one"
  vars:
    fclk: {dim: frequency, label: f_clk, name: {en: "Clock frequency", de: "Taktfrequenz"}, default: "16 MHz"}
    baud: {dim: baudrate, label: Baud, name: {en: "Wanted baud rate", de: "Gewünschte Baudrate"}, default: 115200}
  choices:
    os:
      name: {cs: "Převzorkování", da: "Oversampling", de: "Oversampling (Abtastung pro Bit)", el: "Υπερδειγματοληψία", en: "Oversampling", es: "Sobremuestreo", fr: "Suréchantillonnage", hi: "ओवरसैंपलिंग", it: "Sovracampionamento", ja: "オーバーサンプリング", nl: "Oversampling", no: "Oversampling", pl: "Nadpróbkowanie", pt: "Sobreamostragem", sv: "Översampling", zh: "过采样"}
      default: x16
      options:
        x16:
          name: {cs: "16× (normální)", da: "16× (normal)", de: "16× (normal)", el: "16× (κανονική)", en: "16× (normal)", es: "16× (normal)", fr: "16× (normal)", hi: "16× (सामान्य)", it: "16× (normale)", ja: "16×（通常）", nl: "16× (normaal)", no: "16× (normal)", pl: "16× (normalne)", pt: "16× (normal)", sv: "16× (normal)", zh: "16×（常规）"}
          consts: {os: 16}
        x8:
          name: {cs: "8× (dvojnásobná rychlost)", da: "8× (dobbelt hastighed)", de: "8× (doppelte Geschwindigkeit)", el: "8× (διπλή ταχύτητα)", en: "8× (double speed)", es: "8× (doble velocidad)", fr: "8× (double vitesse)", hi: "8× (दोगुनी गति)", it: "8× (doppia velocità)", ja: "8×（倍速）", nl: "8× (dubbele snelheid)", no: "8× (dobbel hastighet)", pl: "8× (podwójna prędkość)", pt: "8× (velocidade dupla)", sv: "8× (dubbel hastighet)", zh: "8×（双速）"}
          consts: {os: 8}
  dof: 2
  derived:
    div: {dim: integer, label: Divisor, name: {en: "Divisor", de: "Teiler"}, expr: "max(round(fclk/(os*baud)),1)", unit: dec}
    actual: {dim: baudrate, label: Baud_act, name: {en: "Actual baud rate", de: "Tatsächliche Baudrate"}, expr: "fclk/(os*div)"}
    err: {dim: ratio, label: Error, name: {en: "Baud rate error", de: "Baudratenfehler"}, expr: "(actual-baud)/baud", unit: pct}
  checks:
    - {when: "abs(err) > 0.02", warn: {en: "The baud rate error is above ±2 %: the receiver may mis-sample bits (rule of thumb; the errors of both ends add up).", de: "Der Baudratenfehler liegt über ±2 %: Der Empfänger kann Bits falsch abtasten (Faustregel; die Fehler beider Seiten addieren sich)."}}
  formula: ["div = round(fclk / (os * baud))", "actual = fclk / (os * div)", "err = (actual - baud) / baud"]

- id: number_systems
  kind: calculator
  category: digital
  name: {cs: "Číselné soustavy (dec, hex, bin, oct)", da: "Talsystemer (dec, hex, bin, oct)", de: "Zahlensysteme (dec, hex, bin, oct)", el: "Συστήματα αρίθμησης (dec, hex, bin, oct)", en: "Number systems (dec, hex, bin, oct)", es: "Sistemas de numeración (dec, hex, bin, oct)", fr: "Systèmes de numération (dec, hex, bin, oct)", hi: "संख्या पद्धतियाँ (dec, hex, bin, oct)", it: "Sistemi di numerazione (dec, hex, bin, oct)", ja: "数の表記（10進・16進・2進・8進）", nl: "Talstelsels (dec, hex, bin, oct)", no: "Tallsystemer (dec, hex, bin, oct)", pl: "Systemy liczbowe (dec, hex, bin, oct)", pt: "Sistemas de numeração (dec, hex, bin, oct)", sv: "Talsystem (dec, hex, bin, oct)", zh: "数制转换（dec、hex、bin、oct）"}
  doc:
    en: "Shows one whole number in decimal, hexadecimal, binary and octal. Type it into any field: hex takes an optional 0x, bin an optional 0b and oct an optional 0o prefix, and digits may be separated by _ or blanks. The value is limited to 0 … 2^53 − 1 (9 007 199 254 740 991), the range in which whole numbers stay exact in the calculator. Long hex and binary results are grouped for readability. Example: 255 = 0xFF = 0o377 (eight one bits in binary)."
    de: "Zeigt eine ganze Zahl dezimal, hexadezimal, binär und oktal. In ein beliebiges Feld eingeben: Hex nimmt ein optionales 0x, Bin ein optionales 0b und Oct ein optionales 0o als Präfix, die Ziffern dürfen durch _ oder Leerzeichen getrennt sein. Der Wert ist auf 0 … 2^53 − 1 (9 007 199 254 740 991) begrenzt, den Bereich, in dem ganze Zahlen im Rechner exakt bleiben. Lange Hex- und Binärergebnisse werden zur besseren Lesbarkeit gruppiert. Beispiel: 255 = 0xFF = 0o377 (binär acht Einsen)."
  tags: [number systems, hex, hexadecimal, binary, octal, decimal, radix, base conversion, bits, bytes, zahlensystem, hexadezimal, binär, oktal, dezimal, umrechnung, basis]
  source: "Positional number systems with radix 2, 8, 10 and 16; D. E. Knuth: The Art of Computer Programming, vol. 2 (Seminumerical Algorithms), ch. 4.1 (positional number systems)"
  vars:
    dec: {dim: integer, label: DEC, name: {en: "Decimal", de: "Dezimal"}, default: 255, unit: dec, units: ["dec"]}
    hex: {dim: integer, label: HEX, name: {en: "Hexadecimal", de: "Hexadezimal"}, unit: hex, units: ["hex"]}
    bin: {dim: integer, label: BIN, name: {en: "Binary", de: "Binär"}, unit: bin, units: ["bin"]}
    oct: {dim: integer, label: OCT, name: {en: "Octal", de: "Oktal"}, unit: oct, units: ["oct"]}
  dof: 1
  rules:
    dec: ["hex", "bin", "oct"]
    hex: ["dec", "bin", "oct"]
    bin: ["dec", "hex", "oct"]
    oct: ["dec", "hex", "bin"]
  formula: ["dec = hex = bin = oct"]
```

#### Sources and constants to double-check before release

- **IPC-2141 validity range** (0.1 < w/h < 2.0 and 1 < ε_r < 15): the formula itself is the published IPC-2141 microstrip
  approximation; the validity range is the one commonly quoted with it. The standard text was not available, so the doc and
  the `source` say "as commonly quoted".
- **Resistivities of `skin_depth`:** copper 1.7241e-8 Ω·m is the annealed copper standard (58 MS/m, certain). Silver 1.587e-8,
  gold 2.214e-8 and aluminium 2.65e-8 Ω·m are the pure-metal 20 °C handbook values as remembered from the CRC Handbook; gold in
  particular is often quoted as 2.44e-8 elsewhere. No table number is cited.
- **NXP UM10204:** R_p(max) = t_r/(0.8473·C_b), R_p(min) = (V_DD − V_OL)/I_OL, t_r = 1000 / 300 / 120 ns, I_OL = 3 mA (20 mA in
  fast-mode plus) at V_OL = 0.4 V and C_b = 400 pF are the well-known values; the 550 pF limit of fast-mode plus is from memory
  and the least certain.
- **ATmega328P baud-rate table:** the 16 MHz / 115 200 Bd cases (divisor 9, −3.5 % and divisor 17, +2.1 %) match the datasheet
  table as remembered; the vectors do not cite it (they are plain arithmetic).
- **η₀/2π = 59.95849163 Ω:** computed from the exact c and the CODATA 2018 μ₀ = 1.25663706212e-6 H/m (η₀ = 376.7303137 Ω).
- **Free-space loss and dipole:** 468/f(MHz) feet corresponds to K = 468 / 491.79 = 0.9516 (491.79 = 299.792458 / (2 · 0.3048));
  FSPL = 92.4478 dB at 1 km and 1 GHz agrees with the textbook constant 32.45 dB.
